vulg: sic viae omnium qui obliviscuntur Deum et spes hypocritae peribit
clem: Sic vi omnium qui obliviscuntur Deum, et spes hypocrit peribit.
kjv: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־יָקוֹט כִּסְלוֹ וּבֵית עַכָּבִישׁ מִבְטַחוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀοίκητος γὰρ αὐτοῦ ἔσται ὁ οἶκος, ἀράχνη δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀποβήσεται ἡ σκηνή.
vulg: non ei placebit vecordia sua et sicut tela aranearum fiducia eius
clem: Non ei placebit vecordia sua, et sicut tela aranearum fiducia ejus.
kjv: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.

wlc: יִשָּׁעֵן עַל־בֵּיתוֹ וְלֹא יַעֲמֹד יַחֲזִיק בּוֹ וְלֹא יָקוּם ׃
lxx: ἐὰν ὑπερείσῃ τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ, οὐ μὴ στῇ· ἐπιλαβομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ ὑπομείνῃ·
vulg: innitetur super domum suam et non stabit fulciet eam et non consurget
clem: Innitetur super domum suam, et non stabit; fulciet eam, et non consurget.
kjv: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

wlc: רָטֹב הוּא לִפְנֵי־שָׁמֶשׁ וְעַל גַּנָּתוֹ יֹנַקְתּוֹ תֵצֵא ׃
lxx: ὑγρὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὑπὸ ἡλίου, καὶ ἐκ σαπρίας αὐτοῦ ὁ ῤάδαμνος αὐτοῦ ἐξελεύσεται.
vulg: humectus videtur antequam veniat sol et in horto suo germen eius egreditur
clem: Humectus videtur antequam veniat sol, et in ortu suo germen ejus egredietur.
kjv: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

wlc: עַל־גַּל שָׁרָשָׁיו יְסֻבָּכוּ בֵּית אֲבָנִים יֶחֱזֶה ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ συναγωγὴν λίθων κοιμᾶται, ἐν δὲ μέσῳ χαλίκων ζήσεται.
vulg: super acervum petrarum radices eius densabuntur et inter lapides commorabitur
clem: Super acervum petrarum radices ejus densabuntur, et inter lapides commorabitur.
kjv: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.

wlc: אִם־יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וְכִחֶשׁ בּוֹ לֹא רְאִיתִיךָ ׃
lxx: ἐὰν καταπίῃ, ὁ τόπος ψεύσεται αὐτόν· οὐχ ἑόρακας τοιαῦτα.
vulg: si absorbuerit eum de loco suo negabit eum et dicet non novi te
clem: Si absorbuerit eum de loco suo, negabit eum, et dicet: Non novi te.
kjv: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.

wlc: הֶן־הוּא מְשׂוֹשׂ דַּרְכּוֹ וּמֵעָפָר אַחֵר יִצְמָחוּ ׃
lxx: ὅτι καταστροφὴ ἀσεβοῦς τοιαύτη, ἐκ δὲ γῆς ἄλλον ἀναβλαστήσει
vulg: haec est enim laetitia viae eius ut rursum de terra alii germinentur
clem: Hc est enim ltitia vi ejus, ut rursum de terra alii germinentur.
kjv: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

wlc: הֶן־אֵל לֹא יִמְאַס־תָּם וְלֹא־יַחֲזִיק בְּיַד־מְרֵעִים ׃
lxx: ὁ γὰρ κύριος οὐ μὴ ἀποποιήσηται τὸν ἄκακον, πᾶν δὲ δῶρον ἀσεβοῦς οὐ δέξεται.
vulg: Deus non proiciet simplicem nec porriget manum malignis
clem: Deus non projiciet simplicem, nec porriget manum malignis,
kjv: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:

wlc: עַד־יְמַלֵּה שְׂחוֹק פִּיךָ וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ תְרוּעָה ׃
lxx: ἀληθινῶν δὲ στόμα ἐμπλήσει γέλωτος, τὰ δὲ χείλη αὐτῶν ἐξομολογήσεως·
vulg: donec impleatur risu os tuum et labia tua iubilo
clem: donec impleatur risu os tuum, et labia tua jubilo.
kjv: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

wlc: שֹׂנְאֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹשֶׁת וְאֹהֶל רְשָׁעִים אֵינֶנּוּ ׃ פ
lxx: οἱ δὲ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῶν ἐνδύσονται αἰσχύνην. δἰαιτα δὲ ἀσεβοῦς οὐκ ἔσται
vulg: qui oderunt te induentur confusione et tabernaculum impiorum non subsistet
clem: Qui oderunt te induentur confusione, et tabernaculum impiorum non subsistet.]
kjv: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.

wlc: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: ῾γπολαβὼν δὲ Ἰὼβ λέγει
vulg: et respondens Iob ait
clem: Et respondens Job, ait:
kjv: Then Job answered and said,

wlc: אָמְנָם יָדַעְתִּי כִי־כֵן וּמַה־יִּצְדַּק אֱנוֹשׁ עִם־אֵל ׃
lxx: Ἐπ᾿ ἀληθεἰς οἶδα ὅτι οὕτως ἐστίν. πῶς γὰρ ἔσται δίκαιος βροτὸς παρὰ Κυρίῳ;
vulg: vere scio quod ita sit et quod non iustificetur homo conpositus Deo
clem: [Vere scio quod ita sit, et quod non justificetur homo compositus Deo.
kjv: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?

wlc: אִם־יַחְפֹּץ לָרִיב עִמּוֹ לֹא־יַעֲנֶנּוּ אַחַת מִנִּי־אָלֶף ׃
lxx: ἐὰν γὰρ βούληται κριθῆναι αὐτῷ, οὐ μὴ ὑπακούσῃ αὐτῷ, ἳνα μὴ ἀντείπῃ πρὸς ἔνα λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐκ χιλίων.
vulg: si voluerit contendere cum eo non poterit ei respondere unum pro mille
clem: Si voluerit contendere cum eo, non poterit ei respondere unum pro mille.
kjv: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.

wlc: חֲכַם לֵבָב וְאַמִּיץ כֹּחַ מִי־הִקְשָׁה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלָם ׃
lxx: σοφὸς γάρ ἐστιν διανοίᾳ, κραταιός τε καὶ μέγας· τίς σκληρὸς γενόμενος ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ὑπέμεινεν;
vulg: sapiens corde est et fortis robore quis restitit ei et pacem habuit
clem: Sapiens corde est, et fortis robore: quis restitit ei, et pacem habuit?
kjv: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?

wlc: הַמַּעְתִּיק הָרִים וְלֹא יָדָעוּ אֲשֶׁר הֲפָכָם בְּאַפּוֹ ׃
lxx: ὁ παλαιῶν ὄρη, οὐκ οἴδασιν, ὁ καταστρέφων αὐτὰ ὀργῇ·
vulg: qui transtulit montes et nescierunt hii quos subvertit in furore suo
clem: Qui transtulit montes, et nescierunt hi quos subvertit in furore suo.
kjv: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

wlc: הַמַּרְגִּיז אֶרֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָהּ וְעַמּוּדֶיהָ יִתְפַלָּצוּן ׃
lxx: ὁ σείων τὴν ὑπʼ οὐρανὸν ἐκ θεμελίων, οἱ δὲ στύλοι αὐτῆς σαλεύονται·
vulg: qui commovet terram de loco suo et columnae eius concutiuntur
clem: Qui commovet terram de loco suo, et column ejus concutiuntur.
kjv: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

wlc: הָאֹמֵר לַחֶרֶס וְלֹא יִזְרָח וּבְעַד כּוֹכָבִים יַחְתֹּם ׃
lxx: ὁ λέγων τῷ ἡλίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνατέλλει, κατὰ δὲ ἄστρων κατασφραγίζει, κατὰ δὲ ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ σκόλιόν τι ἐπενόησεν,
vulg: qui praecipit soli et non oritur et stellas claudit quasi sub signaculo
clem: Qui prcipit soli, et non oritur, et stellas claudit quasi sub signaculo.
kjv: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.

wlc: נֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם לְבַדּוֹ וְדוֹרֵךְ עַל־בָּמֳתֵי יָם ׃
lxx: ὁ τανύσας τὸν οὐρανὸν μόνος, περιπατῶν ὡς ἐπʼ ἐδάφους ἐπὶ θαλάσσης·
vulg: qui extendit caelos solus et graditur super fluctus maris
clem: Qui extendit clos solus, et graditur super fluctus maris.
kjv: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

wlc: עֹשֶׂה־עָשׁ כְּסִיל וְכִימָה וְחַדְרֵי תֵמָן ׃
lxx: ὁ ποιῶν Πλειάδα καὶ Ἕσπερον καὶ Ἀρκτοῦρον καὶ ταμεῖα Νότου·
vulg: qui facit Arcturum et Oriona et Hyadas et interiora austri
clem: Qui facit Arcturum et Oriona, et Hyadas et interiora austri.
kjv: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.

wlc: עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת עַד־אֵין חֵקֶר וְנִפְלָאוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר ׃
lxx: ὁ ποιῶν μεγάλα καὶ ἀνεξιχνίαστα, ἔνδοξά τε καὶ ἐξαίσια, ὦν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός.
vulg: qui facit magna et inconprehensibilia et mirabilia quorum non est numerus
clem: Qui facit magna, et incomprehensibilia, et mirabilia, quorum non est numerus.
kjv: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

wlc: הֵן יַעֲבֹר עָלַי וְלֹא אֶרְאֶה וְיַחֲלֹף וְלֹא־אָבִין לוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐὸν ὑπερβῇ με. οὐ μὴ ἴδω· καὶ ἐὰν παρέλθῃ με, οὐδʼ ὣς ἔγνων.
vulg: si venerit ad me non videbo si abierit non intellegam eum
clem: Si venerit ad me, non videbo eum; si abierit, non intelligam.
kjv: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

wlc: הֵן יַחְתֹּף מִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ מִי־יֹאמַר אֵלָיו מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה ׃
lxx: ἐὰν ἀπαλλάξῃ, τίς ἀποστρέψεις ἤ τίς ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ Τί ἐποίησας;
vulg: si repente interroget quis respondebit ei vel quis dicere potest cur facis
clem: Si repente interroget, quis respondebit ei? vel quis dicere potest: Cur ita facis?
kjv: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?

wlc: אֱלוֹהַּ לֹא־יָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ תַּחַתוֹ שָׁחֲחוּ עֹזְרֵי רָהַב ׃
lxx: αὐτὸς γὰρ ἀπέστραπται ὀργήν, ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐκάμφθησαν κήτη τὰ ὑπʼ οὐρανόν.
vulg: Deus cuius resistere irae nemo potest et sub quo curvantur qui portant orbem
clem: Deus, cujus ir nemo resistere potest, et sub quo curvantur qui portant orbem.
kjv: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.

wlc: אַף כִּי־אָנֹכִי אֶעֱנֶנּוּ אֶבְחֲרָה דְבָרַי עִמּוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐὸν δέ μου ὑπακούσεται, ἦ διακρινεῖ τὰ ῥήματά μου.
vulg: quantus ergo sum ego qui respondeam ei et loquar verbis meis cum eo
clem: Quantus ergo sum ego, ut respondeam ei, et loquar verbis meis cum eo?
kjv: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?

wlc: אֲשֶׁר אִם־צָדַקְתִּי לֹא אֶעֱנֶה לִמְשֹׁפְטִי אֶתְחַנָּן ׃
lxx: ἐὰν γὰρ δίκαιος, οὐκ εἰσακούσεταί μου, τοῦ κρίματος αὐτοῦ δεηθήσομαι·
vulg: qui etiam si habuero quippiam iustum non respondebo sed meum iudicem deprecabor
clem: qui etiam si habuero quippiam justum, non respondebo: sed meum judicem deprecabor.
kjv: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.

wlc: אִם־קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי לֹא־אַאֲמִין כִּי־יַאֲזִין קוֹלִי ׃
lxx: ἐάν τε καλέσαν καὶ μὴ ὑπακούσῃ, οὐ πιστεύω ὅτι εἰσακήκοεν μου.
vulg: et cum invocantem exaudierit me non credo quod audierit vocem meam
clem: Et cum invocantem exaudierit me, non credo quod audierit vocem meam.
kjv: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־בִּשְׂעָרָה יְשׁוּפֵנִי וְהִרְבָּה פְצָעַי חִנָּם ׃
lxx: μὴ γνόφῳ με ἐκτρίψῃς πολλὰ δέ μου τὰ συντρίμματα πεποίηκεν διά κενῆς.
vulg: in turbine enim conteret me et multiplicabit vulnera mea etiam sine causa
clem: In turbine enim conteret me, et multiplicabit vulnera mea, etiam sine causa.
kjv: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

wlc: לֹא־יִתְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁב רוּחִי כִּי יַשְׂבִּעַנִי מַמְּרֹרִים ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἐῷ γάρ με ἀναπνεῦσαι, ἐνέπλησεν δέ με πικρίας.
vulg: non concedit requiescere spiritum meum et implet me amaritudinibus
clem: Non concedit requiescere spiritum meum, et implet me amaritudinibus.
kjv: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

wlc: אִם־לְכֹחַ אַמִּיץ הִנֵּה וְאִם־לְמִשְׁפָּט מִי יוֹעִידֵנִי ׃
lxx: ὅτι μέν γὰρ ἰσχύει, κρατεῖ τίς οὗν κρίματι αὐτοῦ ἀντιστήσεται;
vulg: si fortitudo quaeritur robustissimus est si aequitas iudicii nemo pro me audet testimonium dicere
clem: Si fortitudo quritur, robustissimus est; si quitas judicii, nemo audet pro me testimonium dicere.
kjv: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

wlc: אִם־אֶצְדָּק פִּי יַרְשִׁיעֵנִי תָּם־אָנִי וַיַּעְקְשֵׁנִי ׃
lxx: ἐὰν γὰρ ὦ δίκαιος, τὸ στόμα μου ἀσεβήσει· ἐάν τε ὦ ἄμεμπτος, σκολιὸς ἀποβήσομαι.
vulg: si iustificare me voluero os meum condemnabit me si innocentem ostendere pravum me conprobabit
clem: Si justificare me voluero, os meum condemnabit me; si innocentem ostendero, pravum me comprobabit.
kjv: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

wlc: תָּם־אָנִי לֹא־אֵדַע נַפְשִׁי אֶמְאַס חַיָּי ׃
lxx: εἴτε γὰρ ἠσέβησα, οὐκ οἶδα τῆ ψυχῇ. πλὴν ἀφαιρεῖταί μου ἡ ζωή.
vulg: etiam si simplex fuero hoc ipsum ignorabit anima mea et taedebit me vitae meae
clem: Etiam si simplex fuero, hoc ipsum ignorabit anima mea, et tdebit me vit me.
kjv: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

wlc: אַחַת הִיא עַל־כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי תָּם וְרָשָׁע הוּא מְכַלֶּה ׃
lxx: διὸ εἶπον Μέγαν καὶ δυνάστην ἀπολλύει ὀργή,
vulg: unum est quod locutus sum et innocentem et impium ipse consumit
clem: Unum est quod locutus sum: et innocentem et impium ipse consumit.
kjv: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

wlc: אִם־שׁוֹט יָמִית פִּתְאֹם לְמַסַּת נְקִיִּם יִלְעָג ׃
lxx: ὅτι φαῦλοι ἐν θανάτῳ ἐξαισίῳ, ἀλλὰ δίκαιοι καταγελῶνται·
vulg: si flagellat occidat semel et non de poenis innocentum rideat
clem: Si flagellat, occidat semel, et non de pnis innocentum rideat.
kjv: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

wlc: אֶרֶץ נִתְּנָה בְיַד־רָשָׁע פְּנֵי־שֹׁפְטֶיהָ יְכַסֶּה אִם־לֹא אֵפוֹא מִי־הוּא ׃
lxx: παραδέδονται γὰρ εἰς χεῖρας ἀσεβοῦς. πρόσωπα κριτῶν αὐτῆς συνκαλύπτει· εἰ δὲ μὴ αὐτός ἐστιν, τίς ἐστιν;
vulg: terra data est in manu impii vultum iudicum eius operit quod si non ille est quis ergo est
clem: Terra data est in manus impii; vultum judicum ejus operit. Quod si non ille est, quis ergo est?
kjv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?

wlc: וְיָמַי קַלּוּ מִנִּי־רָץ בָּרְחוּ לֹא־רָאוּ טוֹבָה ׃
lxx: ὁ δὲ βίος μού ἐστιν ἐλαφρώτερος δρομέως· ἀπέδρασαν, καὶ οὐκ εἴδοσαν.
vulg: dies mei velociores fuerunt cursore fugerunt et non viderunt bonum
clem: Dies mei velociores fuerunt cursore; fugerunt, et non viderunt bonum.
kjv: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.

wlc: חָלְפוּ עִם־אֳנִיּוֹת אֵבֶה כְּנֶשֶׁר יָטוּשׂ עֲלֵי־אֹכֶל ׃
lxx: ἢ καὶ ἔστιν ναυσὶν ἴχνος ὁδοῦ, ἢ ἀετοῦ πετομένου ζητοῦντος βοράν
vulg: pertransierunt quasi naves poma portantes sicut aquila volans ad escam
clem: Pertransierunt quasi naves poma portantes; sicut aquila volans ad escam.
kjv: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

wlc: אִם־אָמְרִי אֶשְׁכְּחָה שִׂיחִי אֶעֶזְבָה פָנַי וְאַבְלִיגָה ׃
lxx: ἐάν τε γὰρ εἴπω, ἐπιλήσομαι λαλῶν, συνκύψας τῷ προσώπῳ στενάξω.
vulg: cum dixero nequaquam ita loquar commuto faciem meam et dolore torqueor
clem: Cum dixero: Nequaquam ita loquar: commuto faciem meam, et dolore torqueor.
kjv: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

wlc: יָגֹרְתִּי כָל־עַצְּבֹתָי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־לֹא תְנַקֵּנִי ׃
lxx: σείομαι πᾶσιν τοῖς μέλεσιν, οἶδα γὰρ ὅτι οὐκ ἀθῷόν με ἐάσεις.
vulg: verebar omnia opera mea sciens quod non parceres delinquenti
clem: Verebar omnia opera mea, sciens quod non parceres delinquenti.
kjv: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

wlc: אָנֹכִי אֶרְשָׁע לָמָּה־זֶּה הֶבֶל אִיגָע ׃
lxx: ἐπειδὴ δέ εἰμι ἀσεβῆς, διὰ τί οὐκ ἀπέθανον;
vulg: si autem et sic impius sum quare frustra laboravi
clem: Si autem et sic impius sum, quare frustra laboravi?
kjv: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

wlc: אִם־הִתְרָחַצְתִּי בְמֵו־שָׁלֶג וַהֲזִכּוֹתִי בְּבֹר כַּפָּי ׃
lxx: ἐὰν γὰρ ἀπολούσωμαι χιόνι, καὶ ἀποκαθάρωμαι χερσὶν καθαραῖς,
vulg: si lotus fuero quasi aquis nivis et fulserint velut mundissimae manus meae
clem: Si lotus fuero quasi aquis nivis, et fulserint velut mundissim manus me,
kjv: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

wlc: אָז בַּשַּׁחַת תִּטְבְּלֵנִי וְתִעֲבוּנִי שַׂלְמוֹתָי ׃
lxx: ἱκανῶς ἐν ῥύπῳ με ἔβαψας, ἐβδελύξατο δέ με ἡ στολή.
vulg: tamen sordibus intingues me et abominabuntur me vestimenta mea
clem: tamen sordibus intinges me, et abominabuntur me vestimenta mea.
kjv: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.

wlc: כִּי־לֹא־אִישׁ כָּמֹנִי אֶעֱנֶנּוּ נָבוֹא יַחְדָּו בַּמִּשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: οὐ γὰρ εἶ ἄνθρωπος κατʼ ἐμὲ ᾧ ἀντικρινομαι, ἳνα ἔλθωμεν ὁμοθυμαδὸν εἰς κρίσιν.
vulg: neque enim viro qui similis mei est respondebo nec qui mecum in iudicio ex aequo possit audiri
clem: Neque enim viro qui similis mei est, respondebo; nec qui mecum in judicio ex quo possit audiri.
kjv: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.

wlc: לֹא יֵשׁ־בֵּינֵינוּ מוֹכִיחַ יָשֵׁת יָדוֹ עַל־שְׁנֵינוּ ׃
lxx: εἲθε ἦν ὁ μεσίτης ἡμῶν καὶ ἐλέγχων καὶ διακούων ἀνὰ μέσον ἀμφοτέρων·
vulg: non est qui utrumque valeat arguere et ponere manum suam in ambobus
clem: Non est qui utrumque valeat arguere, et ponere manum suam in ambobus.
kjv: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

wlc: יָסֵר מֵעָלַי שִׁבְטוֹ וְאֵמָתוֹ אַל־תְּבַעֲתַנִּי ׃
lxx: ἀπαλλαξάτω ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ τὴν ῥάβδον, ὁ δὲ φόβος αὐτοῦ μή με στροβείτω,
vulg: auferat a me virgam suam et pavor eius non me terreat
clem: Auferat a me virgam suam, et pavor ejus non me terreat.
kjv: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

wlc: אַדַבְּרָה וְלֹא אִירָאֶנּוּ כִּי לֹא־כֵן אָנֹכִי עִמָּדִי ׃
lxx: καὶ οὐ μὴ φοβηθῶ ἀλλὰ λαλήσω· οὐ γὰρ οὕτω συνεπίσταμαι,
vulg: loquar et non timebo eum neque enim possum metuens respondere
clem: Loquar, et non timebo eum; neque enim possum metuens respondere.]
kjv: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.

wlc: נָקְטָה נַפְשִׁי בְּחַיָּי אֶעֶזְבָה עָלַי שִׂיחִי אֲדַבְּרָה בְּמַר נַפְשִׁי ׃
lxx: κάμνων τῇ ψυχῇ μου. στένων ἐπαφήσω ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὰ ῥήματά μου· λαλήσαω πικρίᾳ ψυχῆς μου συνεχόμενος.
vulg: taedet animam meam vitae meae dimittam adversum me eloquium meum loquar in amaritudine animae meae
clem: [Tdet animam meam vit me; dimittam adversum me eloquium meum: loquar in amaritudine anim me.
kjv: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

wlc: אֹמַר אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ אַל־תַּרְשִׁיעֵנִי הוֹדִיעֵנִי עַל מַה־תְּרִיבֵנִי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐρῶ πρὸς Κύριον Μή με ἀσεβεῖν δίδασκε· καὶ διὰ τί με οὕτως ἔκρινας;
vulg: dicam Deo noli me condemnare indica mihi cur me ita iudices
clem: Dicam Deo: Noli me condemnare; indica mihi cur me ita judices.
kjv: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.

wlc: הֲטוֹב לְךָ כִּי־תַעֲשֹׁק כִּי־תִמְאַס יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ וְעַל־עֲצַת רְשָׁעִים הוֹפָעְתָּ ׃
lxx: ἢ καλόν σοι ἐὰν ἀδικήσω; ὅτι ἀπείπω ἔργα χειρῶν σου, βουλῆ δὲ ἀσεβῶν προσέσχες;
vulg: numquid bonum tibi videtur si calumnieris et opprimas me opus manuum tuarum et consilium impiorum adiuves
clem: Numquid bonum tibi videtur, si calumnieris me, et opprimas me opus manuum tuarum, et consilium impiorum adjuves?
kjv: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

wlc: הַעֵינֵי בָשָׂר לָךְ אִם־כִּרְאוֹת אֱנוֹשׁ תִּרְאֶה ׃
lxx: ἢ ὥσπερ βροτὸς ὁρᾷ καθορᾷς; ἢ καθὼς ὁρᾷ ἄνθρωπος βλέψῃς
vulg: numquid oculi carnei tibi sunt aut sicut videt homo et tu videbis
clem: Numquid oculi carnei tibi sunt? aut sicut videt homo, et tu videbis?
kjv: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

wlc: הֲכִימֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יָמֶיךָ אִם־שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ כִּימֵי גָבֶר ׃
lxx: ἢ ὁ βίος σου ἀνθρώπινός ἐστιν, ἢ τὰ ἔτη σου ἀνδρός;
vulg: numquid sicut dies hominis dies tui et anni tui sicut humana sunt tempora
clem: Numquid sicut dies hominis dies tui, et anni tui sicut humana sunt tempora,
kjv: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's days,

wlc: כִּי־תְבַקֵּשׁ לַעֲוֹנִי וּלְחַטָּאתִי תִדְרוֹשׁ ׃
lxx: ὃτι ἀνεζήτησας τὴν ἀνομίαν μου, καὶ τὰς ἁμαρτίας μου ἐξιχνίασας;
vulg: ut quaeras iniquitatem meam et peccatum meum scruteris
clem: ut quras iniquitatem meam, et peccatum meum scruteris,
kjv: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?

wlc: עַל־דַּעְתְּךָ כִּי־לֹא אֶרְשָׁע וְאֵין מִיָּדְךָ מַצִּיל ׃
lxx: οἲδας γὰρ ὅτι οὐκ ἠσέβησα· ἀλλὰ τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν σου ἐξαιρούμενος
vulg: et scias quia nihil impium fecerim cum sit nemo qui de manu tua possit eruere
clem: et scias quia nihil impium fecerim, cum sit nemo qui de manu tua possit eruere?
kjv: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.

wlc: יָדֶיךָ עִצְּבוּנִי וַיַּעֲשׂוּנִי יַחַד סָבִיב וַתְּבַלְּעֵנִי ׃
lxx: αἱ χεῖρές σου ἔπλασάν με καὶ ἐποίησάν με. μετὰ ταῦτα μεταβαλὼν με ἔπαισας.
vulg: manus tuae plasmaverunt me et fecerunt me totum in circuitu et sic repente praecipitas me
clem: Manus tu fecerunt me, et plasmaverunt me totum in circuitu: et sic repente prcipitas me?
kjv: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

wlc: זְכָר־נָא כִּי־כַחֹמֶר עֲשִׂיתָנִי וְאֶל־עָפָר תְּשִׁיבֵנִי ׃
lxx: 9μνήσθητι ὅτι πηλόν με ἔπλασας, εἰς δὲ γῆν με πάλιν ἀποστρέφεις.
vulg: memento quaeso quod sicut lutum feceris me et in pulverem reduces me
clem: Memento, quso, quod sicut lutum feceris me, et in pulverem reduces me.
kjv: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?

wlc: הֲלֹא כֶחָלָב תַּתִּיכֵנִי וְכַגְּבִנָּה תַּקְפִּיאֵנִי ׃
lxx: ἢ οὐχ ὥσπερ γάλα με ἤμελξας, ἐτύρωσας δέ με ἲσα τυρῷ ;
vulg: nonne sicut lac mulsisti me et sicut caseum me coagulasti
clem: Nonne sicut lac mulsisti me, et sicut caseum me coagulasti?
kjv: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

wlc: עוֹר וּבָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁנִי וּבַעֲצָמוֹת וְגִידִים תְּסֹכְכֵנִי ׃
lxx: δέρμα δὲ καὶ κρέα με ἐνέδυσας, ὀστέοις δέ καὶ νεύροις με ἔνειρας·
vulg: pelle et carnibus vestisti me et ossibus et nervis conpegisti me
clem: Pelle et carnibus vestisti me; ossibus et nervis compegisti me.
kjv: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.

wlc: חַיִּים וָחֶסֶד עָשִׂיתָ עִמָּדִי וּפְקֻדָּתְךָ שָׁמְרָה רוּחִי ׃
lxx: ζωὴν δὲ καὶ ἔλεος ἔθου παρʼ ἐμοί, ἡ δὲ ἐπισκοπή σου ἐφύλαξέν μου τὸ πνεῦμα.
vulg: vitam et misericordiam tribuisti mihi et visitatio tua custodivit spiritum meum
clem: Vitam et misericordiam tribuisti mihi, et visitatio tua custodivit spiritum meum.
kjv: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה צָפַנְתָּ בִלְבָבֶךָ יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־זֹאת עִמָּךְ ׃
lxx: ταῦτα ἔχων ἐν σεαυτῷ οἶδα ὅτι πάντα δύνασαι· ἀδυνατεῖ δέ σοι οὐθέν.
vulg: licet haec celes in corde tuo tamen scio quia universorum memineris
clem: Licet hc celes in corde tuo, tamen scio quia universorum memineris.
kjv: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.

wlc: אִם־חָטָאתִי וּשְׁמַרְתָּנִי וּמֵעֲוֹנִי לֹא תְנַקֵּנִי ׃
lxx: ἐάν τε γὰρ ἁμάρτω, φυλάσσεις με, ἀπὸ δὲ ἀνομίας οὐκ ἀθῷόν με πεποίηκας.
vulg: si peccavi et ad horam pepercisti mihi cur ab iniquitate mea mundum me esse non pateris
clem: Si peccavi, et ad horam pepercisti mihi, cur ab iniquitate mea mundum me esse non pateris?
kjv: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

wlc: אִם־רָשַׁעְתִּי אַלְלַי לִי וְצָדַקְתִּי לֹא־אֶשָּׂא רֹאשִׁי שְׂבַע קָלוֹן וּרְאֵה עָנְיִי ׃
lxx: ἐάν τε γὰρ ἀσεβήσω, οἲμοι· ἐὰν δὲ δἰκαιος, οὐ δύναμαι ἀνακύψαι. πλήρης γὰρ ἀτιμίας εἰμί.
vulg: et si impius fuero vae mihi est et si iustus non levabo caput saturatus adflictione et miseria
clem: Et si impius fuero, v mihi est; et si justus, non levabo caput, saturatus afflictione et miseria.
kjv: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;

wlc: וְיִגְאֶה כַּשַּׁחַל תְּצוּדֵנִי וְתָשֹׁב תִּתְפַּלָּא־בִי ׃
lxx: ἀγρεύομαι γὰρ ὥσπερ λέων εἰς σφαγήν· πάλιν γὰρ μεταβαλὼν δεινῶς με ὀλέκεις.
vulg: et propter superbiam quasi leaenam capies me reversusque mirabiliter me crucias
clem: Et propter superbiam quasi lenam capies me, reversusque mirabiliter me crucias.
kjv: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

wlc: תְּחַדֵּשׁ עֵדֶיךָ נֶגְדִּי וְתֶרֶב כַּעַשְׂךָ עִמָּדִי חֲלִיפוֹת וְצָבָא עִמִּי ׃
lxx: ἐπανακαινίζων ἐπʼ ἐμὲ τὴν ἔτασίν μου· ὀργῇ δὲ μεγάλη μοι ἐχρήσω. ἐπήγαγες δὲ ἐπʼ ἐμέ πειρατήρια.
vulg: instauras testes tuos contra me et multiplicas iram tuam adversum me et poenae militant in me
clem: Instauras testes tuos contra me, et multiplicas iram tuam adversum me, et pn militant in me.
kjv: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.

wlc: וְלָמָּה מֵרֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָנִי אֶגְוַע וְעַיִן לֹא־תִרְאֵנִי ׃
lxx: ἲνα τί οὖν ἐκ κοιλίας με ἐξήγαγες, καὶ οὐκ ἀπέθανον, ὀφθαλμὸς δέ με οὐκ εἶδεν,
vulg: quare de vulva eduxisti me qui utinam consumptus essem ne oculus me videret
clem: Quare de vulva eduxisti me? qui utinam consumptus essem, ne oculus me videret.
kjv: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

wlc: כַּאֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיִיתִי אֶהְיֶה מִבֶּטֶן לַקֶּבֶר אוּבָל ׃
lxx: καὶ ὥσπερ οὐκ ὤν ἐγενόμην διὰ τί γὰρ ἐκ γαστρὸς εἰς μνῆμα οὐκ ἀπηλλάγην;
vulg: fuissem quasi qui non essem de utero translatus ad tumulum
clem: Fuissem quasi non essem, de utero translatus ad tumulum.
kjv: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

wlc: הֲלֹא־מְעַט יָמַי יַחֲדָל *וְשִׁית מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה מְּעָט ׃
lxx: ἤ οὐκ ὀλίγος ἐστὶν ὁ βίος τοῦ χρόνου μου ἔασόν με ἀναπαύσασθαι μικρὸν
vulg: numquid non paucitas dierum meorum finietur brevi dimitte ergo me ut plangam paululum dolorem meum
clem: Numquid non paucitas dierum meorum finietur brevi? dimitte ergo me, ut plangam paululum dolorem meum,
kjv: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

wlc: בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְלֹא אָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת ׃
lxx: πρὸ τοῦ με πορευθῆναι ὅθεν οὐκ ἀναστρέψω, εἰς γῆν σκοτινὴν καὶ γνοφεράν, (22)εἰς γῆν σκότους αἰωνίου, οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν φέγγος οὐδὲ ὁρᾶν ζωὴν βροτῶν.
vulg: antequam vadam et non revertar ad terram tenebrosam et opertam mortis caligine
clem: antequam vadam, et non revertar, ad terram tenebrosam, et opertam mortis caligine:
kjv: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

wlc: אֶרֶץ עֵיפָתָה כְּמוֹ אֹפֶל צַלְמָוֶת וְלֹא סְדָרִים וַתֹּפַע כְּמוֹ־אֹפֶל ׃ פ
vulg: terram miseriae et tenebrarum ubi umbra mortis et nullus ordo et sempiternus horror inhabitans
clem: terram miseri et tenebrarum, ubi umbra mortis et nullus ordo, sed sempiternus horror inhabitat.]
kjv: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

wlc: וַיַּעַן צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: ᾿γπολαβὼν δὲ Σωφὰρ ὁ Μειναῖος λέγει
vulg: respondens autem Sophar Naamathites dixit
clem: Respondens autem Sophar Naamathites, dixit:
kjv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

wlc: הֲרֹב דְּבָרִים לֹא יֵעָנֶה וְאִם־אִישׁ שְׂפָתַיִם יִצְדָּק ׃
lxx: Ὁ τὰ πολλὰ λέγων καὶ ἀντακούσεται· ἤ καὶ ὁ εὔλαλος οἴεται εἶναι δίκαιος
vulg: numquid qui multa loquitur non et audiet aut vir verbosus iustificabitur
clem: [Numquid qui multa loquitur, non et audiet? aut vir verbosus justificabitur?
kjv: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?

wlc: בַּדֶּיךָ מְתִים יַחֲרִישׁו וַתִּלְעַג וְאֵין מַכְלִם ׃
lxx: εὐλογημένος γεννητὸς γυναικὸς ὀλιγόβιος. μὴ πολὺς ἐν ῥήμασιν γίνου, οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ἀντικρινόμενός σοι.
vulg: tibi soli tacebunt homines et cum ceteros inriseris a nullo confutaberis
clem: Tibi soli tacebunt homines? et cum ceteros irriseris, a nullo confutaberis?
kjv: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

wlc: וַתֹּאמֶר זַךְ לִקְחִי וּבַר הָיִיתִי בְעֵינֶיךָ ׃
lxx: μὴ γὰρ λέγε ὅτι Καθαρός εἰμι τοῖς ἔργοις καὶ ἄμεμπτος ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ.
vulg: dixisti enim purus est sermo meus et mundus sum in conspectu tuo
clem: Dixisti enim: Purus est sermo meus, et mundus sum in conspectu tuo.
kjv: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.

wlc: וְאוּלָם מִי־יִתֵּן אֱלוֹהַּ דַּבֵּר וְיִפְתַּח שְׂפָתָיו עִמָּךְ ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ πῶς ἂν ὁ κύριος λαλήσαι πρὸς σέ; καὶ ἀνοίξει χείλη αὐτοῦ μετὰ σοῦ;
vulg: atque utinam Deus loqueretur tecum et aperiret labia sua tibi
clem: Atque utinam Deus loqueretur tecum, et aperiret labia sua tibi,
kjv: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

wlc: וְיַגֶּד־לְךָ תַּעֲלֻמוֹת חָכְמָה כִּי־כִפְלַיִם לְתוּשִׁיָּה וְדַע כִּי־יַשֶּׁה לְךָ אֱלוֹהַ מֵעֲוֹנֶךָ ׃
lxx: εἶτα ἀναγγελεῖ σοι δύναμιν σοφίας. ὅτι διπλοῦς ἔσται τῶν κατὰ σέ· καὶ τότε γνώσῃ ὅτι ἄξιά σοι ἀπέβη ἀπὸ Κυρίου ὧν ἡμάρτηκας
vulg: ut ostenderet tibi secreta sapientiae et quod multiplex esset lex eius et intellegeres quod multo minora exigaris a Deo quam meretur iniquitas tua
clem: ut ostenderet tibi secreta sapienti, et quod multiplex esset lex ejus: et intelligeres quod multo minora exigaris ab eo quam meretur iniquitas tua!
kjv: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

wlc: הַחֵקֶר אֱלוֹהַ תִּמְצָא אִם עַד־תַּכְלִית שַׁדַּי תִּמְצָא ׃
lxx: ἤ ἴχνος Κυρίου εὑρήσεις; ἢ εἰς τὰ ἔσχατα ἀφίκου ἄ ἐποίησεν ὁ παντοκράτωρ;
vulg: forsitan vestigia Dei conprehendes et usque ad perfectum Omnipotentem repperies
clem: Forsitan vestigia Dei comprehendes, et usque ad perfectum Omnipotentem reperies?
kjv: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

wlc: גָּבְהֵי שָׁמַיִם מַה־תִּפְעָל עֲמֻקָּה מִשְּׁאוֹל מַה־תֵּדָע ׃
lxx: ὑψηλὸς ὁ οὐρανός, καὶ τἰ ποιήσεις; βαθύτερα δὲ τῶν ἐν ᾅδου· τἰ οἰδας;
vulg: excelsior caelo est et quid facies profundior inferno et unde cognosces
clem: Excelsior clo est, et quid facies? profundior inferno, et unde cognosces?
kjv: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?

wlc: אֲרֻכָּה מֵאֶרֶץ מִדָּהּ וּרְחָבָה מִנִּי־יָם ׃
lxx: ἤ μακρότερα μέτρου γῆς ἤ εὔρους θαλάσσης.
vulg: longior terrae mensura eius et latior mari
clem: Longior terra mensura ejus, et latior mari.
kjv: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

wlc: אִם־יַחֲלֹף וְיַסְגִּיר וְיַקְהִיל וּמִי יְשִׁיבֶנּוּ ׃
lxx: ὲὰαταστρέψῃ τὰ πάντα, τίς ἐρεῖ αὐτῷ Γί ἐποίησας;
vulg: si subverterit omnia vel in unum coartaverit quis contradicet ei
clem: Si subverterit omnia, vel in unum coarctaverit, quis contradicet ei?
kjv: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?

wlc: כִּי־הוּא יָדַע מְתֵי־שָׁוְא וַיַּרְא־אָוֶן וְלֹא יִתְבּוֹנָן ׃
lxx: αὐτὸς γὰρ οἶδεν ἔργα ἀνόμων, ἰδὼν δὲ ἄτοπα οὐ παρόψεται.
vulg: ipse enim novit hominum vanitatem et videns iniquitatem nonne considerat
clem: Ipse enim novit hominum vanitatem; et videns iniquitatem, nonne considerat?
kjv: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?

wlc: וְאִישׁ נָבוּב יִלָּבֵב וְעַיִר פֶּרֶא אָדָם יִוָּלֵד ׃
lxx: ἄνθρωπος δὲ ἄλλως νήχεται λόγοις· βροτὸς δέ γεννητὸς γυναικὸς ἴσα ἄνῳ ἐρημίτῃ.
vulg: vir vanus in superbiam erigitur et tamquam pullum onagri se liberum natum putat
clem: Vir vanus in superbiam erigitur, et tamquam pullum onagri se liberum natum putat.
kjv: For vain men would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.

wlc: אִם־אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ לִבֶּךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ אֵלָיו כַּפֶּךָ ׃
lxx: εἰ γὰρ σὺ καθαρὰν ἔθου τὴν καρδίαν σου, ὑπτιάζεις δέ χεῖρας πρὸς αὐτόν·
vulg: tu autem firmasti cor tuum et expandisti ad eum manus tuas
clem: Tu autem firmasti cor tuum, et expandisti ad eum manus tuas.
kjv: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;

wlc: אִם־אָוֶן בְּיָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵהוּ וְאַל־תַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאֹהָלֶיךָ עַוְלָה ׃
lxx: εἰ ἄνομόν τί ἐστιν ἐν χερσίν σου, πόρρω ποίησον αὐτὸ ἀπὸ σοῦ, ἀδικία δὲ ἐν διαίτῃ σου μὴ αὐλισθήτω.
vulg: si iniquitatem quod est in manu tua abstuleris a te et non manserit in tabernaculo tuo iniustitia
clem: Si iniquitatem qu est in manu tua abstuleris a te, et non manserit in tabernaculo tuo injustitia,
kjv: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.

wlc: כִּי־אָז תִּשָּׂא פָנֶיךָ מִמּוּם וְהָיִיתָ מֻצָק וְלֹא תִירָא ׃
lxx: οὕτως γὰρ ἀναλάμψει σου τὸ πρόσωπον ὥσπερ ὕδωρ καθαρόν, ἐκδύσῃ δὲ ῥύπον καὶ οὐ μὴ φοβηθῇς·
vulg: tum levare poteris faciem tuam absque macula et eris stabilis et non timebis
clem: tunc levare poteris faciem tuam absque macula; et eris stabilis, et non timebis.
kjv: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

wlc: כִּי־אַתָּה עָמָל תִּשְׁכָּח כְּמַיִם עָבְרוּ תִזְכֹּר ׃
lxx: καὶ τὸν κόπον ἐπιλήσῃ ὥσπερ κῦμα παρελθόν, καὶ οὐ πτοηθήσῃ·
vulg: miseriae quoque oblivisceris et quasi aquarum quae praeterierint recordaberis
clem: Miseri quoque oblivisceris, et quasi aquarum qu prterierunt recordaberis.
kjv: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:

wlc: וּמִצָּהֳרַיִם יָקוּם חָלֶד תָּעֻפָה כַּבֹּקֶר תִּהְיֶה ׃
lxx: ἡ δὲ εὐχή σου ὥσπερ ἑωσφόρος. ἐκ δὲ μεσημβρίας ἀνατελεῖ σοι ζωή·
vulg: et quasi meridianus fulgor consurget tibi ad vesperam et cum te consumptum putaveris orieris ut lucifer
clem: Et quasi meridianus fulgor consurget tibi ad vesperam; et cum te consumptum putaveris, orieris ut lucifer.
kjv: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday: thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.

wlc: וּבָטַחְתָּ כִּי־יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה וְחָפַרְתָּ לָבֶטַח תִּשְׁכָּב ׃
lxx: πεποιθώς τε ἔσῃ ὅτι ἔστιν σοι ἐλπίς, ἐκ δὲ μερίμνης καὶ φροντίδος ἀναφανεῖταί σοι εἰρήνη.
vulg: et habebis fiduciam proposita tibi spe et defossus securus dormies
clem: Et habebis fiduciam, proposita tibi spe: et defossus securus dormies.
kjv: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

wlc: וְרָבַצְתָּ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְחִלּוּ פָנֶיךָ רַבִּים ׃
lxx: ἡσυχάσεις γάρ, καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ πολεμῶν σε· μεταβαλόμενοι δὲ πολλοί σου δεηθήσονται.
vulg: requiesces et non erit qui te exterreat et deprecabuntur faciem tuam plurimi
clem: Requiesces, et non erit qui te exterreat; et deprecabuntur faciem tuam plurimi.
kjv: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

wlc: וְעֵינֵי רְשָׁעִים תִּכְלֶינָה וּמָנוֹס אָבַד מִנְהֶם וְתִקְוָתָם מַפַּח־נָפֶשׁ ׃ פ
lxx: σωτηρία δὲ αὐτοὺς ἀπολείψει· ἡ γὰρ ἐλπὶς αὐτῶν ἀπώλεια, ὀφθαλμοὶ δὲ ἀσεβῶν τακήσονται.
vulg: oculi autem impiorum deficient et effugium peribit ab eis et spes eorum abominatio animae
clem: Oculi autem impiorum deficient, et effugium peribit ab eis: et spes illorum abominatio anim.]
kjv: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.

wlc: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: ῾γπολαβὼν δὲ Ἰὼβ λέγει
vulg: respondens autem Iob dixit
clem: Respondens autem Job, dixit:
kjv: And Job answered and said,

wlc: אָמְנָם כִּי אַתֶּם־עָם וְעִמָּכֶם תָּמוּת חָכְמָה ׃
lxx: Εἶτα ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἄνθρωποι· ἦ μεθʼ ὑμῶν τελευτήσει σοφία.
vulg: ergo vos estis soli homines et vobiscum morietur sapientia
clem: [Ergo vos estis soli homines, et vobiscum morietur sapientia?
kjv: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

wlc: גַּם־לִי לֵבָב כְּמוֹכֶם לֹא־נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּם וְאֶת־מִי־אֵין כְּמוֹ־אֵלֶּה ׃
lxx: κἀμοὶ μὲν καρδἰα καθʼ ὑμᾶς ἐστιν.
vulg: et mihi est cor sicut et vobis nec inferior vestri sum quis enim haec quae nostis ignorat
clem: Et mihi est cor sicut et vobis, nec inferior vestri sum; quis enim hc qu nostis ignorat?
kjv: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

wlc: שְׂחֹק לְרֵעֵהוּ אֶהְיֶה קֹרֵא לֶאֱלוֹהַּ וַיַּעֲנֵהוּ שְׂחוֹק צַדִּיק תָּמִים ׃
lxx: δίκαιος γὰρ ἀνὴρ καὶ ἄμεμπτος ἐγενήθη εἰς χλεύασμα·
vulg: qui deridetur ab amico suo sicut ego invocabit Deum et exaudiet eum deridetur enim iusti simplicitas
clem: Qui deridetur ab amico suo, sicut ego, invocabit Deum, et exaudiet eum: deridetur enim justi simplicitas.
kjv: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

wlc: לַפִּיד בּוּז לְעַשְׁתּוּת שַׁאֲנָן נָכוֹן לְמוֹעֲדֵי רָגֶל ׃
lxx: εἰς χρόνον γὰρ τακτὸν ἡτοίμαστο πεσεῖν ὑπὸ ἄλλων. (6) οἴκους τε αὐτοῦ ἐκπορθεῖσθαι ὑπὸ ἀνόμων.
vulg: lampas contempta apud cogitationes divitum parata ad tempus statutum
clem: Lampas contempta apud cogitationes divitum parata ad tempus statutum.
kjv: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

wlc: יִשְׁלָיוּ אֹהָלִים לְשֹׁדְדִים וּבַטֻּחוֹת לְמַרְגִּיזֵי אֵל לַאֲשֶׁר הֵבִיא אֱלוֹהַּ בְּיָדוֹ ׃
lxx: οὐ μὴν δὲ ἀλλὰ μηδεὶς πεποιθέτω πονηρὸς ὢν ἀθῷος ἔσεσθαι, ὅσοι παροργίζουσιν τὸν κύριον, ὡς οὐχὶ καὶ ἔτασις αὐτῶν ἔσται.
vulg: abundant tabernacula praedonum et audacter provocant Deum cum ipse dederit omnia in manibus eorum
clem: Abundant tabernacula prdonum, et audacter provocant Deum, cum ipse dederit omnia in manus eorum.
kjv: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

wlc: וְאוּלָם שְׁאַל־נָא בְהֵמוֹת וְתֹרֶךָּ וְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וְיַגֶּד־לָךְ ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ δὴ ἐρώτησον τετράποδα ἐάν σοι εἴπωσιν. πετεινὰ δὲ οὐρανοῦ ἐάν σοι ἀπαγγείλωσιν·
vulg: nimirum interroga iumenta et docebunt te et volatilia caeli et indicabunt tibi
clem: Nimirum interroga jumenta, et docebunt te; et volatilia cli, et indicabunt tibi.
kjv: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

wlc: אוֹ שִׂיחַ לָאָרֶץ וְתֹרֶךָּ וִיסַפְּרוּ לְךָ דְּגֵי הַיָּם ׃
lxx: ἐκδιήγησαι γῇ ἐάν σοι φράσῃ, καὶ ἐξηγήσονταί σοι οἱ ἰχθύες τῆς θαλάσσης.
vulg: loquere terrae et respondebit tibi et narrabunt pisces maris
clem: Loquere terr, et respondebit tibi, et narrabunt pisces maris.
kjv: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

wlc: מִי לֹא־יָדַע בְּכָל־אֵלֶּה כִּי יַד־יְהוָה עָשְׂתָה זֹּאת ׃
lxx: τίς οὖν οὐκ ἔγνω ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις ὅτι χεὶρ Κυρίου ἐποίησεν ταῦτα;
vulg: quis ignorat quod omnia haec manus Domini fecerit
clem: Quis ignorat quod omnia hc manus Domini fecerit?
kjv: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the Lord hath wrought this?

wlc: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כָּל־חָי וְרוּחַ כָּל־בְּשַׂר־אִישׁ ׃
lxx: εἰ μὴ ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ψυχὴ πάντων ζώντων καὶ πνεῦμα παντὸς ἀνθρώπου;
vulg: in cuius manu anima omnis viventis et spiritus universae carnis hominis
clem: In cujus manu anima omnis viventis, et spiritus univers carnis hominis.
kjv: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

wlc: הֲלֹא־אֹזֶן מִלִּין תִּבְחָן וְחֵךְ אֹכֶל יִטְעַם־לוֹ ׃
lxx: νοῦς μὲν γὰρ ῥήματα διακρίνει, λάρυγξ δὲ σῖτα γεύεται.
vulg: nonne auris verba diiudicat et fauces comedentis saporem
clem: Nonne auris verba dijudicat? et fauces comedentis, saporem?
kjv: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

wlc: בִּישִׁישִׁים חָכְמָה וְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים תְּבוּנָה ׃
lxx: ἐν πολλῷ χρόνῳ σοφία, ἐν δὲ πολλῷ βἰῳ ἐπιστήμη.
vulg: in antiquis est sapientia et in multo tempore prudentia
clem: In antiquis est sapientia, et in multo tempore prudentia.
kjv: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

wlc: עִמּוֹ חָכְמָה וּגְבוּרָה לוֹ עֵצָה וּתְבוּנָה ׃
lxx: παρʼ αὐτῷ σοφία καὶ δύναμις, αὐτῷ βουλὴ καὶ σύνεσις.
vulg: apud ipsum est sapientia et fortitudo ipse habet consilium et intellegentiam
clem: Apud ipsum est sapientia et fortitudo; ipse habet consilium et intelligentiam.
kjv: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

wlc: הֵן יַהֲרוֹס וְלֹא יִבָּנֶה יִסְגֹּר עַל־אִישׁ וְלֹא יִפָּתֵחַ ׃
lxx: ἐὰν καταβάλῃ, τίς οἰκοδομήσει; ἐὰν κλείσῃ κατὰ ἀνθρώπων, τίς ἀνοίξει;
vulg: si destruxerit nemo est qui aedificet et si incluserit hominem nullus est qui aperiat
clem: Si destruxerit, nemo est qui dificet; si incluserit hominem, nullus est qui aperiat.
kjv: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

wlc: הֵן יַעְצֹר בַּמַּיִם וְיִבָשׁוּ וִישַׁלְּחֵם וְיַהַפְכוּ אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ἐὰν κωλύσῃ τὸ ὕδωρ, ξηρανεῖ τὴν γῆν· ἐὰν δὲ ἐπαφῇ, ἀπώλεσεν αὐτὴν καταστρέψας.
vulg: si continuerit aquas omnia siccabuntur et si emiserit eas subvertent terram
clem: Si continuerit aquas, omnia siccabuntur; et si emiserit eas, subvertent terram.
kjv: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

wlc: עִמּוֹ עֹז וְתוּשִׁיָּה לוֹ שֹׁגֵג וּמַשְׁגֶּה ׃
lxx: παρʼ αὐτῷ κράτος καὶ ἰσχύς, αὐτῷ ἐπιστήμη καὶ σύνεσις.
vulg: apud ipsum est fortitudo et sapientia ipse novit et decipientem et eum qui decipitur
clem: Apud ipsum est fortitudo et sapientia; ipse novit et decipientem, et eum qui decipitur.
kjv: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

wlc: מוֹלִיךְ יוֹעֲצִים שׁוֹלָל וְשֹׁפְטִים יְהוֹלֵל ׃
lxx: διάγων βουλευτὰς αἰχμαλώτους, κριτὰς δὲ γῆς ἐξέστησεν.
vulg: adducit consiliarios in stultum finem et iudices in stuporem
clem: Adducit consiliarios in stultum finem, et judices in stuporem.
kjv: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

wlc: מוּסַר מְלָכִים פִּתֵּחַ וַיֶּאְסֹר אֵזוֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: καθιζάνων βασιλεῖς ἐπὶ θρόνους, καὶ περιέδησεν ζώνῃ ὀσφύας αὐτῶν
vulg: balteum regum dissolvit et praecingit fune renes eorum
clem: Balteum regum dissolvit, et prcingit fune renes eorum.
kjv: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

wlc: מוֹלִיךְ כֹּהֲנִים שׁוֹלָל וְאֵתָנִים יְסַלֵּף ׃
lxx: ἐξαποστέλλων ἱερεῖς αἰχμαλώτους, δυνάστας δὲ γῆς κατέστρεψεν.
vulg: ducit sacerdotes inglorios et optimates subplantat
clem: Ducit sacerdotes inglorios, et optimates supplantat:
kjv: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

wlc: מֵסִיר שָׂפָה לְנֶאֱמָנִים וְטַעַם זְקֵנִים יִקָּח ׃
lxx: διαλλάσσων χείλη πιστῶν σύνεσιν δὲ πρεσβυτέρων ἔγνω.
vulg: commutans labium veracium et doctrinam senum auferens
clem: commutans labium veracium, et doctrinam senum auferens.
kjv: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

wlc: שׁוֹפֵךְ בּוּז עַל־נְדִיבִים וּמְזִיחַ אֲפִיקִים רִפָּה ׃
lxx: ἐκχέων ἀτιμίαν ἐπʼ ἄρχοντας, ταπεινοὺς δὲ ἰάσατο.
vulg: effundit despectionem super principes et eos qui oppressi fuerant relevans
clem: Effundit despectionem super principes, eos qui oppressi fuerant relevans.
kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

wlc: מְגַלֶּה עֲמֻקוֹת מִנִּי־חֹשֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵא לָאוֹר צַלְמָוֶת ׃
lxx: ἀνακαλύπτων βαθέα ἐκ σκότους ἐξήγαγεν δὲ εἰς φῶς σκιὰν θανάτου.
vulg: qui revelat profunda de tenebris et producit in lucem umbram mortis
clem: Qui revelat profunda de tenebris, et producit in lucem umbram mortis.
kjv: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

wlc: מַשְׂגִּיא לַגּוֹיִם וַיְאַבְּדֵם שֹׁטֵחַ לַגּוֹיִם וַיַּנְחֵם ׃
lxx: καταστρωννύων ἔθνη καὶ καθοδηγῶν αὐτά.
vulg: qui multiplicat gentes et perdet eas et subversas in integrum restituet
clem: Qui multiplicat gentes, et perdit eas, et subversas in integrum restituit.
kjv: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.

wlc: מֵסִיר לֵב רָאשֵׁי עַם־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא־דָרֶךְ ׃
lxx: διαλλάσσων καρδίας ἀρχόντων γῆς, ἐπλάνησεν δὲ αὐτοὺς ἐν ὁδῷ ἦ οὐκ ἤδεισαν·
vulg: qui inmutat cor principum populi terrae et decipit eos ut frustra incedant per invium
clem: Qui immutat cor principum populi terr, et decipit eos ut frustra incedant per invium:
kjv: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

wlc: יְמַשְׁשׁוּ־חֹשֶׁךְ וְלֹא־אוֹר וַיַּתְעֵם כַּשִּׁכּוֹר ׃
lxx: ψηλαφήσαισαν σκότος καὶ μὴ φῶς, πλανηθείησαν δὲ ὥσπερ ὁ μεθύων.
vulg: palpabunt quasi in tenebris et non in luce et errare eos faciet quasi ebrios
clem: palpabunt quasi in tenebris, et non in luce, et errare eos faciet quasi ebrios.]
kjv: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.

wlc: הֶן־כֹּל רָאֲתָה עֵינִי שָׁמְעָה אָזְנִי וַתָּבֶן לָהּ ׃
lxx: ἰδοὺ ταῦτα ἑόρακέν μου ὁ ὀφθαλμὸς καὶ ἀκήκοεν μου τὸ οὖς·
vulg: ecce omnia et vidit oculus meus et audivit auris mea et intellexi singula
clem: [Ecce omnia hc vidit oculus meus, et audivit auris mea, et intellexi singula.
kjv: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.

wlc: כְּדַעְתְּכֶם יָדַעְתִּי גַם־אָנִי לֹא־נֹפֵל אָנֹכִי מִכֶּם ׃
lxx: καὶ οἶδα ὅσα καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπίστασθε, καὶ οὐκ ἀσυνετώτερός εἰμι ὑμῶν.
vulg: secundum scientiam vestram et ego novi nec inferior vestri sum
clem: Secundum scientiam vestram et ego novi: nec inferior vestri sum.
kjv: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

wlc: אוּלָם אֲנִי אֶל־שַׁדַּי אֲדַבֵּר וְהוֹכֵחַ אֶל־אֵל אֶחְפָּץ ׃
lxx: οὐ μὴν δὲ ἀλλ᾿ ἐγὼ πρὸς Κύριον λαλήσω, ἐλέγξω δὲ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ἐὰν βούληται.
vulg: sed tamen ad Omnipotentem loquar et disputare cum Deo cupio
clem: Sed tamen ad Omnipotentem loquar, et disputare cum Deo cupio:
kjv: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.

wlc: וְאוּלָם אַתֶּם טֹפְלֵי־שָׁקֶר רֹפְאֵי אֱלִל כֻּלְּכֶם ׃
lxx: ὑμεῖς δέ ἐστε ἰατροὶ ἄδικοι καὶ ἰαταὶ κακῶν πάντες
vulg: prius vos ostendens fabricatores mendacii et cultores perversorum dogmatum
clem: prius vos ostendens fabricatores mendacii, et cultores perversorum dogmatum.
kjv: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

wlc: מִי־יִתֵּן הַחֲרֵשׁ תַּחֲרִישׁוּן וּתְהִי לָכֶם לְחָכְמָה ׃
lxx: εἴῃ δὲ ὑμῖν κωφεῦσαι, καὶ ἀποβήσεται ὑμῖν σοφία.
vulg: atque utinam taceretis ut putaremini esse sapientes
clem: Atque utinam taceretis, ut putaremini esse sapientes.
kjv: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.

wlc: שִׁמְעוּ־נָא תוֹכַחְתִּי וְרִבוֹת שְׂפָתַי הַקְשִׁיבוּ ׃
lxx: ἀκούσατε ἔλεγχον τοῦ στόματός μου, κρίσιν δέ χειλέων μου σροσέχετε.
vulg: audite ergo correptiones meas et iudicium labiorum meorum adtendite
clem: Audite ergo correptionem meam, et judicium labiorum meorum attendite.
kjv: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

wlc: הַלְאֵל תְּדַבְּרוּ עַוְלָה וְלוֹ תְּדַבְּרוּ רְמִיָּה ׃
lxx: πότερον οὐκ ἔναντι Κυρίου λαλεῖτε,
vulg: numquid Deus indiget vestro mendacio ut pro illo loquamini dolos
clem: Numquid Deus indiget vestro mendacio, ut pro illo loquamini dolos?
kjv: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

wlc: הֲפָנָיו תִּשָּׂאוּן אִם־לָאֵל תְּרִיבוּן ׃
lxx: ἔναντι δὲ αὐτοῦ φθέγγεσθε δόλον; 8ἢ ἡποστελεῖσθε; ὑμεῖς δὲ αὐτοὶ κριταὶ γένεσθε.
vulg: numquid faciem eius accipitis et pro Deo iudicare nitimini
clem: numquid faciem ejus accipitis, et pro Deo judicare nitimini?
kjv: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?

wlc: הֲטוֹב כִּי־יַחְקֹר אֶתְכֶם אִם־כְּהָתֵל בֶּאֱנוֹשׁ תְּהָתֵלּוּ בוֹ ׃
lxx: καλὸν γὰρ ἐὰν ἐξιχνιάσῃ ὑμᾶς; εἰ γὰρ τὰ πάντα ποιοῦντες προστεθήσεσθε αὐτῷ,
vulg: aut placebit ei quem celare nihil potest aut decipietur ut homo vestris fraudulentiis
clem: aut placebit ei quem celare nihil potest? aut decipietur, ut homo, vestris fraudulentiis?
kjv: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?

wlc: הוֹכֵחַ יוֹכִיחַ אֶתְכֶם אִם־בַּסֵּתֶר פָּנִים תִּשָּׂאוּן ׃
lxx: οὐθὲν ἦττον ἐλέγξει ὑμᾶς· εἰ δὲ καὶ κρυφῇ πρόσωπα θαυμάσεσθε,
vulg: ipse vos arguet quoniam in abscondito faciem eius accipitis
clem: Ipse vos arguet, quoniam in abscondito faciem ejus accipitis.
kjv: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

wlc: הֲלֹא שְׂאֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵת אֶתְכֶם וּפַחְדּוֹ יִפֹּל עֲלֵיכֶם ׃
lxx: πότερον οὐχὶ δεινὰ αὐτοῦ στροβήσει ὑμᾶς; ὁ φόβος δὲ παρʼ αὐτοῦ ἐπιπεσεῖται ὑμῖν,
vulg: statim ut se commoverit turbabit vos et terror eius inruet super vos
clem: Statim ut se commoverit, turbabit vos, et terror ejus irruet super vos.
kjv: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

wlc: זִכְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי־אֵפֶר לְגַבֵּי־חֹמֶר גַּבֵּיכֶם ׃
lxx: ἀποβήσεται δὲ ὑμῶν τὸ ἀγαυρίαμα ἴσα σποδῷ, τὸ δὲ σῶμα πήλινον.
vulg: memoria vestra conparabitur cineri et redigentur in lutum cervices vestrae
clem: Memoria vestra comparabitur cineri, et redigentur in lutum cervices vestr.
kjv: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.

wlc: הַחֲרִישׁוּ מִמֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־אָנִי וְיַעֲבֹר עָלַי מָה ׃
lxx: κωφεύσατε, ἵνα λαλήσω καὶ ἀναπαύσωμαι θυμοῦ,
vulg: tacete paulisper ut loquar quodcumque mihi mens suggesserit
clem: Tacete paulisper, ut loquar quodcumque mihi mens suggesserit.
kjv: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.

wlc: עַל־מָה אֶשָּׂא בְשָׂרִי בְשִׁנָּי וְנַפְשִׁי אָשִׂים בְּכַפִּי ׃
lxx: ἀναλαβὼν τὰς σάρκας μου τοῖς ὀδοῦσιν, ψυχὴν δέ μου θήσω ἐν χερί.
vulg: quare lacero carnes meas dentibus meis et animam meam porto in manibus meis
clem: Quare lacero carnes meas dentibus meis, et animam meam porto in manibus meis?
kjv: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?

wlc: הֵן יִקְטְלֵנִי לֹא אֲיַחֵל אַךְ־דְּרָכַי אֶל־פָּנָיו אוֹכִיחַ ׃
lxx: ἐάν με χειρώσηται ὁ δυνάστης, ἐπεὶ καὶ ἦρκται, ἦ μὴν λαλήσω καὶ ἐλέγξω ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ·
vulg: etiam si occiderit me in ipso sperabo verumtamen vias meas in conspectu eius arguam
clem: Etiam si occiderit me, in ipso sperabo: verumtamen vias meas in conspectu ejus arguam.
kjv: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.

wlc: גַּם־הוּא־לִי לִישׁוּעָה כִּי־לֹא לְפָנָיו חָנֵף יָבוֹא ׃
lxx: καὶ τοῦτό μοι ἀποβήσεται εἰς σωτηρίαν, οὐ γὰρ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ δόλος εἰσελεύσεται.
vulg: et ipse erit salvator meus non enim veniet in conspectu eius omnis hypocrita
clem: Et ipse erit salvator meus: non enim veniet in conspectu ejus omnis hypocrita.
kjv: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.

wlc: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ מִלָּתִי וְאַחֲוָתִי בְּאָזְנֵיכֶם ׃
lxx: ἀκούσατε, ἀκούσατε τὰ ῥήματά μου, ἀναγγελῶ γὰρ ὑμῶν ἀκουόντων.
vulg: audite sermonem meum et enigmata percipite auribus vestris
clem: Audite sermonem meum, et nigmata percipite auribus vestris.
kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

wlc: הִנֵּה־נָא עָרַכְתִּי מִשְׁפָּט יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־אֲנִי אֶצְדָּק ׃
lxx: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐγγύς εἰμι τοῦ κρίματός μου. οἶδα ἐγὼ ὅτι δίκαιος ἀναφανοῦμαι.
vulg: si fuero iudicatus scio quod iustus inveniar
clem: Si fuero judicatus, scio quod justus inveniar.
kjv: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

wlc: מִי־הוּא יָרִיב עִמָּדִי כִּי־עַתָּה אַחֲרִישׁ וְאֶגְוָע ׃
lxx: τίς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ κριθησόμενός μοι, ὅτι νῦν κωφεύσω καὶ ἐκλείψω;
vulg: quis est qui iudicetur mecum veniat quare tacens consumor
clem: Quis est qui judicetur mecum? veniat: quare tacens consumor?
kjv: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

wlc: אַךְ־שְׁתַּיִם אַל־תַּעַשׂ עִמָּדִי אָז מִפָּנֶיךָ לֹא אֶסָּתֵר ׃
lxx: δυεῖν δέ μοι χυήσῃ, τότε ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου σου οὐ κρυβήσομαι·
vulg: duo tantum ne facias mihi et tunc a facie tua non abscondar
clem: Duo tantum ne facias mihi, et tunc a facie tua non abscondar:
kjv: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.

wlc: כַּפְּךָ מֵעָלַי הַרְחַק וְאֵמָתְךָ אַל־תְּבַעֲתַנִּי ׃
lxx: τὴν χεῖρα ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ ἀπέχου, καὶ ὁ φόβος σου μὴ με καταπλησσέτω.
vulg: manum tuam longe fac a me et formido tua non me terreat
clem: manum tuam longe fac a me, et formido tua non me terreat.
kjv: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.

wlc: וּקְרָא וְאָנֹכִי אֶעֱנֶה אוֹ־אֲדַבֵּר וַהֲשִׁיבֵנִי ׃
lxx: εἶτ᾿ ἂν καλέσεις, ἐγὼ δέ σοι ὑπακούσομαι· ἤ λαλήσεις, ἐγὼ δέ σοι δώσω ἀνταπόκρισιν.
vulg: et voca me et respondebo tibi aut certe loquar et tu responde mihi
clem: Voca me, et ego respondebo tibi: aut certe loquar, et tu responde mihi.
kjv: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.

wlc: כַּמָּה לִי עֲוֹנוֹת וְחַטָּאוֹת פִּשְׁעִי וְחַטָּאתִי הֹדִיעֵנִי ׃
lxx: πόσαι εἰσὶν αἵ ἁμαρτίαι μου καὶ αἱ ἀνομίαι μου; δίδαξόν με τἰνες εἰσίν.
vulg: quantas habeo iniquitates et peccata scelera mea et delicta ostende mihi
clem: Quantas habeo iniquitates et peccata? scelera mea et delicta ostende mihi.
kjv: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.

wlc: לָמָּה־פָנֶיךָ תַסְתִּיר וְתַחְשְׁבֵנִי לְאוֹיֵב לָךְ ׃
lxx: διὰ τί ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ κρύπτῃ, ἥγησαι δέ με ὑπεναντίον σοι;
vulg: cur faciem tuam abscondis et arbitraris me inimicum tuum
clem: Cur faciem tuam abscondis, et arbitraris me inimicum tuum?
kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?

wlc: הֶעָלֶה נִדָּף תַּעֲרוֹץ וְאֶת־קַשׁ יָבֵשׁ תִּרְדֹּף ׃
lxx: ἤ ὡς φύλλον κινούμενον ὑπὸ ἀνέμου εὐλαβηθήσῃ, ἤ ὡς χόρτῳ φερομένῳ ὑπὸ πνεύματος ἀντίκεισαί μοι;
vulg: contra folium quod vento rapitur ostendis potentiam tuam et stipulam siccam persequeris
clem: Contra folium, quod vento rapitur, ostendis potentiam tuam, et stipulam siccam persequeris:
kjv: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

wlc: כִּי־תִכְתֹּב עָלַי מְרֹרוֹת וְתוֹרִישֵׁנִי עֲוֹנוֹת נְעוּרָי ׃
lxx: ὅτι κατέγραψας κατʼ ἐμοῦ κακά, περιέθηκας δέ μοι νεότητος ἁμαρτίας·
vulg: scribis enim contra me amaritudines et consumere me vis peccatis adulescentiae meae
clem: scribis enim contra me amaritudines, et consumere me vis peccatis adolescenti me.
kjv: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

wlc: וְתָשֵׂם בַּסַּד רַגְלַי וְתִשְׁמוֹר כָּל־אָרְחוֹתָי עַל־שָׁרְשֵׁי רַגְלַי תִּתְחַקֶּה ׃
lxx: ἔθου δέ μου τὸν πόδα ἐν κωλύματι, ἐφύλαξας δέ μου πάντα τὰ ἔργα, εἰς δὲ ῤίζας τῶν ποδῶν μου ἀφίκου·
vulg: posuisti in nervo pedem meum et observasti omnes semitas meas et vestigia pedum meorum considerasti
clem: Posuisti in nervo pedem meum, et observasti omnes semitas meas, et vestigia pedum meorum considerasti:
kjv: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.

wlc: וְהוּא כְּרָקָב יִבְלֶה כְּבֶגֶד אֲכָלוֹ עָשׁ ׃
lxx: ὄ παλαιοῦται ἴσα ἀσκῷ, ἡ ὥσπερ ἱμάτιον σητόβρωτον.
vulg: qui quasi putredo consumendus sum et quasi vestimentum quod comeditur a tinea
clem: qui quasi putredo consumendus sum, et quasi vestimentum quod comeditur a tinea.]
kjv: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.

wlc: אָדָם יְלוּד אִשָּׁה קְצַר יָמִים וּשְׂבַע־רֹגֶז ׃
lxx: βροτὸς γὰρ γεννητὸς γυναικὸς ὀλιγόβιος καὶ πλήρης ἀργῆς,
vulg: homo natus de muliere brevi vivens tempore repletus multis miseriis
clem: [Homo natus de muliere, brevi vivens tempore, repletur multis miseriis.
kjv: Man that is born of a woman is of few days and full of trouble.

wlc: כְּצִיץ יָצָא וַיִּמָּל וַיִּבְרַח כַּצֵּל וְלֹא יַעֲמוֹד ׃
lxx: ἤ ὥσπερ ἄνθος ἀνθῆσαν ἐξέπεσεν, ἀπέδρα δὲ ὥσπερ σκιὰ καὶ οὐ μὴ στῇ.
vulg: quasi flos egreditur et conteritur et fugit velut umbra et numquam in eodem statu permanet
clem: Qui quasi flos egreditur et conteritur, et fugit velut umbra, et numquam in eodem statu permanet.
kjv: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

wlc: אַף־עַל־זֶה פָּקַחְתָּ עֵינֶךָ וְאֹתִי תָבִיא בְמִשְׁפָּט עִמָּךְ ׃
lxx: οὐχὶ καὶ τούτου λόγον ἐποιήσω, καὶ τούτου ἐποίησας εἰσελθῖν ἐν κρίματι ἐνώπιόν σου
vulg: et dignum ducis super huiuscemodi aperire oculos tuos et adducere eum tecum in iudicium
clem: Et dignum ducis super hujuscemodi aperire oculos tuos, et adducere eum tecum in judicium?
kjv: And doth thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

wlc: מִי־יִתֵּן טָהוֹר מִטָּמֵא לֹא אֶחָד ׃
lxx: τίς γὰρ καθαρὸς ἔσται ἀπὸ ῥύπου ; ἀλλ᾿ οὐθεἰς,
vulg: quis potest facere mundum de inmundo conceptum semine nonne tu qui solus es
clem: Quis potest facere mundum de immundo conceptum semine? nonne tu qui solus es?
kjv: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

wlc: אִם חֲרוּצִים יָמָיו מִסְפַּר־חֳדָשָׁיו אִתָּךְ חֻקּוֹ עָשִׂיתָ וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר ׃
lxx: ἐὰν καὶ μία ἡμέρα ὁ βίος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· ἀριθμητοὶ δέ μῆνες αὐτοῦ παρʼ αὐτοῦ, εἰς χρόνον ἔθου καὶ οὐ μὴ ὑπερβῇ.
vulg: breves dies hominis sunt numerus mensuum eius apud te est constituisti terminos eius qui praeterire non poterunt
clem: Breves dies hominis sunt: numerus mensium ejus apud te est: constituisti terminos ejus, qui prteriri non poterunt.
kjv: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

wlc: שְׁעֵה מֵעָלָיו וְיֶחְדָּל עַד־יִרְצֶה כְּשָׂכִיר יוֹמוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀπόστα ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἳνα ἡσυχάσῃ καὶ εὐδοκήση τὸν βίον, ὥσπερ ὁ μισθωτός. ἔστιν γὰρ δένδρῳ ἐλπίς· ἐὰν γὰρ ἐκκοπῇ, ἔτι ἐπανθήσει, καὶ ὁ ῤάδαμνος αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ ἐκλείπῃ·
vulg: recede paululum ab eo ut quiescat donec optata veniat sicut mercennarii dies eius
clem: Recede paululum ab eo, ut quiescat, donec optata veniat, sicut mercenarii, dies ejus.
kjv: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

wlc: כִּי יֵשׁ לָעֵץ תִּקְוָה אִם־יִכָּרֵת וְעוֹד יַחֲלִיף וְיֹנַקְתּוֹ לֹא תֶחְדָּל ׃
vulg: lignum habet spem si praecisum fuerit rursum virescit et rami eius pullulant
clem: Lignum habet spem: si prcisum fuerit, rursum virescit, et rami ejus pullulant.
kjv: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

wlc: אִם־יַזְקִין בָּאָרֶץ שָׁרְשׁוֹ וּבֶעָפָר יָמוּת גִּזְעוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐὰν γὰρ γηράσῃ ἐν γῇ ἡ ῥίζα αὐτοῦ, ἐν δὲ πέτρᾳ τελευτήσῃ τὸ στέλεχος αὐτοῦ,
vulg: si senuerit in terra radix eius et in pulvere emortuus fuerit truncus illius
clem: Si senuerit in terra radix ejus, et in pulvere emortuus fuerit truncus illius,
kjv: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

wlc: מֵרֵיחַ מַיִם יַפְרִחַ וְעָשָׂה קָצִיר כְּמוֹ־נָטַע ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ ὀσμῆς ὕδατος ἀνθήσει, ποιήσει δὲ θερισμὸν ὥσπερ νεόφυτον.
vulg: ad odorem aquae germinabit et faciet comam quasi cum primum plantatum est
clem: ad odorem aqu germinabit, et faciet comam, quasi cum primum plantatum est.
kjv: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

wlc: וְגֶבֶר יָמוּת וַיֶּחֱלָשׁ וַיִּגְוַע אָדָם וְאַיּוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀνήρ δὲ τελευτήσας ᾤχετο, πεσὼν δὲ βροτὸς οὐκέτι ἐστίν.
vulg: homo vero cum mortuus fuerit et nudatus atque consumptus ubi quaeso est
clem: Homo vero cum mortuus fuerit, et nudatus, atque consumptus, ubi, quso, est?
kjv: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

wlc: אָזְלוּ־מַיִם מִנִּי־יָם וְנָהָר יֶחֱרַב וְיָבֵשׁ ׃
lxx: χρόνῳ γὰρ σπανίζεται θάλασσα, ποταμὸς δὲ ἐρημωθεὶς ἐξηράνθη.
vulg: quomodo si recedant aquae de mari et fluvius vacuefactus arescat
clem: Quomodo si recedant aqu de mari, et fluvius vacuefactus arescat:
kjv: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:

wlc: וְאִישׁ שָׁכַב וְלֹא־יָקוּם עַד־בִּלְתִּי שָׁמַיִם לֹא יָקִיצוּ וְלֹא־יֵעֹרוּ מִשְּׁנָתָם ׃
lxx: ἄνθρωπος δὲ κοιμηθεὶς οὐ μὴ ἀναστῇ ἕως ἂν ὁ οὐρανὸς οὐ μὴ συνραφῇ, καὶ οὐκ ἐξυπνισθήσονται ἐξ ὕπνου αὐτῶν
vulg: sic homo cum dormierit non resurget donec adteratur caelum non evigilabit nec consurget de somno suo
clem: sic homo, cum dormierit, non resurget: donec atteratur clum, non evigilabit, nec consurget de somno suo.
kjv: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

wlc: מִי יִתֵּן בִּשְׁאוֹל תַּצְפִּנֵנִי תַּסְתִּירֵנִי עַד־שׁוּב אַפֶּךָ תָּשִׁית לִי חֹק וְתִזְכְּרֵנִי ׃
lxx: εἰ γὰρ ὄφελον ἐν ᾄδῃ με ἐφύλαξας. ἔκρυψας δέ με ἕως ἂν παύσηταί σου ἡ ὀργή. καὶ τάξῃ μοι χρόνον ἐν ᾧ μνείαν μου ποιήσῃ.
vulg: quis mihi hoc tribuat ut in inferno protegas me ut abscondas me donec pertranseat furor tuus et constituas mihi tempus in quo recorderis mei
clem: Quis mihi hoc tribuat, ut in inferno protegas me, et abscondas me donec pertranseat furor tuus, et constituas mihi tempus in quo recorderis mei?
kjv: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

wlc: אִם־יָמוּת גֶּבֶר הֲיִחְיֶה כָּל־יְמֵי צְבָאִי אֲיַחֵל עַד־בּוֹא חֲלִיפָתִי ׃
lxx: ἐὰν γὰρ ἀποθάνῃ ἄνθρωπος. ζήσεται. συντελέσας ἡμέρας τοῦ βίου αὐτοῦ· ὑπομενῶ ἕως πάλιν γένωμαι.
vulg: putasne mortuus homo rursum vivet cunctis diebus quibus nunc milito expecto donec veniat inmutatio mea
clem: Putasne mortuus homo rursum vivat? cunctis diebus quibus nunc milito, expecto donec veniat immutatio mea.
kjv: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

wlc: תִּקְרָא וְאָנֹכִי אֶעֱנֶךָּ לְמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ תִכְסֹף ׃
lxx: εἶτα καλέσεις, ἐγὼ δέ σοι ὑπακούσομαι. τὰ δὲ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου μὴ ἀποποιοῦ.
vulg: vocabis et ego respondebo tibi operi manuum tuarum porriges dexteram
clem: Vocabis me, et ego respondebo tibi: operi manuum tuarum porriges dexteram.
kjv: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

wlc: כִּי־עַתָּה צְעָדַי תִּסְפּוֹר לֹא־תִשְׁמוֹר עַל־חַטָּאתִי ׃
lxx: ἠρίθμησας δέ μου τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα, καὶ οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ σε οὐδὲν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν μου·
vulg: tu quidem gressus meos dinumerasti sed parces peccatis meis
clem: Tu quidem gressus meos dinumerasti: sed parce peccatis meis.
kjv: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

wlc: חָתֻם בִּצְרוֹר פִּשְׁעִי וַתִּטְפֹּל עַל־עֲוֹנִי ׃
lxx: ἐσφράγισας δέ μου τὰς ἀνομίας ἐν βαλλαντίῳ, ἐπεσημήνω δὲ εἰ τι ἄκων παρέβην.
vulg: signasti quasi in sacculo delicta mea sed curasti iniquitatem meam
clem: Signasti quasi in sacculo delicta mea, sed curasti iniquitatem meam.
kjv: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

wlc: וְאוּלָם הַר־נוֹפֵל יִבּוֹל וְצוּר יֶעְתַּק מִמְּקֹמוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ πλὴν ὄρος πίπτον διαπεσεῖται, καὶ πέτρα παλαιωθήσεται ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῆς
vulg: mons cadens defluet et saxum transfertur de loco suo
clem: Mons cadens defluit, et saxum transfertur de loco suo:
kjv: And surely the mountains falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.

wlc: אֲבָנִים שָׁחֲקוּ מַיִם תִּשְׁטֹף־סְפִיחֶיהָ עֲפַר־אָרֶץ וְתִקְוַת אֱנוֹשׁ הֶאֱבַדְתָּ ׃
lxx: λίθους ἐλέαναν ὕδατα, καὶ κατέκλυσεν ὕδατα ὕπτια τοῦ χώματος τῆς γῆς· καὶ ὑπομονὴν ἀνθρώπου ἀπώλεσας.
vulg: lapides excavant aquae et adluvione paulatim terra consumitur et homines ergo similiter perdes
clem: lapides excavant aqu, et alluvione paulatim terra consumitur: et hominem ergo similiter perdes.
kjv: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.

wlc: תִּתְקְפֵהוּ לָנֶצַח וַיַּהֲלֹךְ מְשַׁנֶּה פָנָיו וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵהוּ ׃
lxx: ὦσας αὐτὸν εἰς τέλος, καὶ ᾤχετο· ἐπέστησας αὐτῷ τὸ πρόσωπον, καὶ ἐξαπέστειλας·
vulg: roborasti eum paululum ut in perpetuum pertransiret inmutabis faciem eius et emittes eum
clem: Roborasti eum paululum, ut in perpetuum transiret: immutabis faciem ejus, et emittes eum.
kjv: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

wlc: יִכְבְּדוּ בָנָיו וְלֹא יֵדָע וְיִצְעֲרוּ וְלֹא־יָבִין לָמוֹ ׃
lxx: πολλῶν δὲ γενομένων τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ οὐκ οἶδεν, ἐὸν δὲ ὀλίγοι γένωνται, οὐκ ἐπίσταται·
vulg: sive nobiles fuerint filii eius sive ignobiles non intelleget
clem: Sive nobiles fuerint filii ejus, sive ignobiles, non intelliget.
kjv: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

wlc: אַךְ־בְּשָׂרוֹ עָלָיו יִכְאָב וְנַפְשׁוֹ עָלָיו תֶּאֱבָל ׃ פ
lxx: ἀλλ᾿ ἤ αἱ σάρκες αὐτοῦ ἤλγησαν, ἡ δὲ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ ἐπένθησεν.
vulg: attamen caro eius dum vivet dolebit et anima illius super semet ipso lugebit
clem: Attamen caro ejus, dum vivet, dolebit, et anima illius super semetipso lugebit.]
kjv: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.

wlc: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: γπολαβὼν δὲ Ἐλειφὰς ὁ Θαιμανείτης λέγει
vulg: respondens autem Eliphaz Themanites dixit
clem: Respondens autem Eliphaz Themanites, dixit:
kjv: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

wlc: הֶחָכָם יַעֲנֶה דַעַת־רוּחַ וִימַלֵּא קָדִים בִּטְנוֹ ׃
lxx: Πότερον σοφὸς ἀπόκρισιν δώσει συνέσεως πνεύματος, καὶ ἐνέπλησεν πόνον γαστρός,
vulg: numquid sapiens respondebit quasi in ventum loquens et implebit ardore stomachum suum
clem: [Numquid sapiens respondebit quasi in ventum loquens, et implebit ardore stomachum suum?
kjv: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

wlc: הוֹכֵחַ בְּדָבָר לֹא יִסְכּוֹן וּמִלִּים לֹא־יוֹעִיל בָּם ׃
lxx: ἐλέγχων ἐν ῥήμασιν οἷς οὐ δεῖ ἐν λόγοις οἷς οὐδεν ὄφελος;
vulg: arguis verbis eum qui non est aequalis tui et loqueris quod tibi non expedit
clem: Arguis verbis eum qui non est qualis tibi, et loqueris quod tibi non expedit.
kjv: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

wlc: אַף־אַתָּה תָּפֵר יִרְאָה וְתִגְרַע שִׂיחָה לִפְנֵי־אֵל ׃
lxx: οὐ καὶ σὺ ἀπεποιήσω φόβον, συνετελέσω δὲ ῥήματα τοιαῦτα ἔναντι τοῦ κυρίου;
vulg: quantum in te est evacuasti timorem et tulisti preces coram Deo
clem: Quantum in te est, evacuasti timorem, et tulisti preces coram Deo.
kjv: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.

wlc: כִּי יְאַלֵּף עֲוֹנְךָ פִיךָ וְתִבְחַר לְשׁוֹן עֲרוּמִים ׃
lxx: ἔνοχος εἶ ῥήμασιν στόματός σου, οὐδὲ διέκρινας ῥήματα δυναστῶν·
vulg: docuit enim iniquitas tua os tuum et imitaris linguam blasphemantium
clem: Docuit enim iniquitas tua os tuum, et imitaris linguam blasphemantium.
kjv: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

wlc: יַרְשִׁיעֲךָ פִיךָ וְלֹא־אָנִי וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ יַעֲנוּ־בָךְ ׃
lxx: ἐλέγξαι σε τὸ σὸν στόμα καὶ μὴ ἐγώ, τὰ δέ χείλη σου καταμαρτυρήσουσίν σου.
vulg: condemnabit te os tuum et non ego et labia tua respondebunt tibi
clem: Condemnabit te os tuum, et non ego: et labia tua respondebunt tibi.
kjv: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

wlc: הֲרִאישׁוֹן אָדָם תִּוָּלֵד וְלִפְנֵי גְבָעוֹת חוֹלָלְתָּ ׃
lxx: τί γάρ; μὴ πρῶτος ἀνθρώπων ἐγενήθης; ἤ πρὸ θινῶν ἐπάγης
vulg: numquid primus homo tu natus es et ante colles formatus
clem: Numquid primus homo tu natus es, et ante colles formatus?
kjv: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

wlc: הַבְסוֹד אֱלוֹהַ תִּשְׁמָע וְתִגְרַע אֵלֶיךָ חָכְמָה ׃
lxx: ἤ σύνταγμα Κυρίου ἀκήκοας εἰς δὲ σὲ ἀφίκετο σοφία;
vulg: numquid consilium Dei audisti et inferior te erit eius sapientia
clem: numquid consilium Dei audisti, et inferior te erit ejus sapientia?
kjv: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

wlc: מַה־יָּדַעְתָּ וְלֹא נֵדָע תָּבִין וְלֹא־עִמָּנוּ הוּא ׃
lxx: τί γὰρ οἶδας ὅ οὐκ οἴδαμεν; ἤ τί συνίεις ὅ οὐ καὶ ἡμεῖς;
vulg: quid nosti quod ignoremus quid intellegis quod nesciamus
clem: Quid nosti quod ignoremus? quid intelligis quod nesciamus?
kjv: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?

wlc: גַּם־שָׂב גַּם־יָשִׁישׁ בָּנוּ כַּבִּיר מֵאָבִיךָ יָמִים ׃
lxx: καί γε πρεσβύτης καί γε παλαιὸς ἐν ἡμῖν, βαρύτερος τοῦ πατρός σου ἡμέραις.
vulg: et senes et antiqui sunt in nobis multo vetustiores quam patres tui
clem: Et senes et antiqui sunt in nobis, multo vetustiores quam patres tui.
kjv: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.

wlc: הַמְעַט מִמְּךָ תַּנְחֻמוֹת אֵל וְדָבָר לָאַט עִמָּךְ ׃
lxx: ὀλίγα ὧν ἡμάρτηκας μεμαστίγωσαι, μεγάλως ὑπερβαλλόντως λελάληκας.
vulg: numquid grande est ut consoletur te Deus sed verba tua prava hoc prohibent
clem: Numquid grande est ut consoletur te Deus? sed verba tua prava hoc prohibent.
kjv: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?

wlc: מַה־יִּקָּחֲךָ לִבֶּךָ וּמַה־יִּרְזְמוּן עֵינֶיךָ ׃
lxx: τί ἐτόλμησεν ἡ καρδία σου ἤ τί ἐπήνεγκαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου,
vulg: quid te elevat cor tuum et quasi magna cogitans adtonitos habes oculos
clem: Quid te elevat cor tuum, et quasi magna cogitans attonitos habes oculos?
kjv: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,

wlc: כִּי־תָשִׁיב אֶל־אֵל רוּחֶךָ וְהֹצֵאתָ מִפִּיךָ מִלִּין ׃
lxx: ὅτι θυμὸν ἔρρηξας ἔναντι Κυρίου, ἐξήγαγες δὲ ἐκ στόματος ῥήματα τοιαῦτα;
vulg: quid tumet contra Deum spiritus tuus ut proferas de ore huiuscemodi sermones
clem: Quid tumet contra Deum spiritus tuus, ut proferas de ore tuo hujuscemodi sermones?
kjv: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

wlc: מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי־יִזְכֶּה וְכִי־יִצְדַּק יְלוּד אִשָּׁה ׃
lxx: τίς γὰρ ὤν βροτός, ὅτι ἔσται ἄμεμπτος, ἤ ὡς ἐσόμενος δίκαιος γεννητὸς γυναικός
vulg: quid est homo ut inmaculatus sit et ut iustus appareat natus de muliere
clem: Quid est homo ut immaculatus sit, et ut justus appareat natus de muliere?
kjv: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

wlc: הֵן בִּקְדֹשׁוֹ לֹא יַאֲמִין וְשָׁמַיִם לֹא־זַכּוּ בְעֵינָיו ׃
lxx: εἰ κατὰ ἁγίων οὐ πιστεύει, οὐρανὸς δὲ οὐ καθαρὸς ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ.
vulg: ecce inter sanctos eius nemo inmutabilis et caeli non sunt mundi in conspectu eius
clem: Ecce inter sanctos ejus nemo immutabilis, et cli non sunt mundi in conspectu ejus.
kjv: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

wlc: אַף כִּי־נִתְעָב וְנֶאֱלָח אִישׁ־שֹׁתֶה כַמַּיִם עַוְלָה ׃
lxx: ἴα δὲ ἐβδελυγμένος καὶ ἀκάθαρτος, ἀνὴρ πίνων ἀδικίας ἴσα ποτῷ.
vulg: quanto magis abominabilis et inutilis homo qui bibit quasi aquas iniquitatem
clem: Quanto magis abominabilis et inutilis homo, qui bibit quasi aquam iniquitatem?
kjv: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?

wlc: אֲחַוְךָ שְׁמַע־לִי וְזֶה־חָזִיתִי וַאֲסַפֵּרָה ׃
lxx: ἀναγγελῶ δέ σοι, ἄκουέ μου. ἂ δὴ ἑώρακα ἀναγγελῶ σοι.
vulg: ostendam tibi audi me quod vidi narrabo tibi
clem: Ostendam tibi: audi me: quod vidi, narrabo tibi.
kjv: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־חֲכָמִים יַגִּידוּ וְלֹא כִחֲדוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָם ׃
lxx: ἃ σοφοὶ ἐροῦσιν, οὐκ ἔκρυψαν πατέρας αὐτῶν·
vulg: sapientes confitentur et non abscondunt patres suos
clem: Sapientes confitentur, et non abscondunt patres suos:
kjv: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

wlc: לָהֶם לְבַדָּם נִתְּנָה הָאָרֶץ וְלֹא־עָבַר זָר בְּתוֹכָם ׃
lxx: αὐτοῖς μόνοις ἐδόθη ἡ γῆ, καὶ οὐκ ἐπῆλθεν ἀλλογενὴς ἐπʼ αὐτούς.
vulg: quibus solis data est terra et non transibit alienus per eos
clem: quibus solis data est terra, et non transivit alienus per eos.
kjv: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

wlc: כָּל־יְמֵי רָשָׁע הוּא מִתְחוֹלֵל וּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים נִצְפְּנוּ לֶעָרִיץ ׃
lxx: πᾶς ὁ βἰος ἀσεβοῦς ἐν φροντίδι, ἔτη δὲ ἀριθμητὰ δεδομένα δυνάστῃ,
vulg: cunctis diebus suis impius superbit et numerus annorum incertus est tyrannidis eius
clem: Cunctis diebus suis impius superbit, et numerus annorum incertus est tyrannidis ejus.
kjv: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

wlc: קוֹל־פְּחָדִים בְּאָזְנָיו בַּשָּׁלוֹם שׁוֹדֵד יְבוֹאֶנּוּ ׃
lxx: ὁ δὲ φόβος αὐτοῦ ἐν ὠσὶν αὐτοῦ· ὅταν δοκῆ ἤδη εἰρηνεύειν. ἤξει αὐτοῦ ἡ καταστροφή.
vulg: sonitus terroris semper in auribus illius et cum pax sit ille insidias suspicatur
clem: Sonitus terroris semper in auribus illius: et cum pax sit, ille semper insidias suspicatur.
kjv: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

wlc: לֹא־יַאֲמִין שׁוּב מִנִּי־חֹשֶׁךְ וְצָפוּ הוּא אֱלֵי־חָרֶב ׃
lxx: μὴ πιστευέτω ἀποστραφῆναι ἀπὸ σκότους· ἐντέταλται γἃρ ἤδη εἰς χεῖρας σιδήρου.
vulg: non credit quod reverti possit de tenebris circumspectans undique gladium
clem: Non credit quod reverti possit de tenebris ad lucem, circumspectans undique gladium.
kjv: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

wlc: נֹדֵד הוּא לַלֶּחֶם אַיֵּה יָדַע כִּי־נָכוֹן בְּיָדוֹ יוֹם־חֹשֶׁךְ ׃
lxx: κατατέτακται δὲ εἰς σῖτα γυψίν· οἶδεν δὲ ἐν ἑαυτῷ ὅτι μένει εἰς πτῶμα. ἡμέρα δὲ αὐτὸν σκοτινὴ στροβήσει,
vulg: cum se moverit ad quaerendum panem novit quod paratus sit in manu eius tenebrarum dies
clem: Cum se moverit ad qurendum panem, novit quod paratus sit in manu ejus tenebrarum dies.
kjv: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

wlc: יְבַעֲתֻהוּ צַר וּמְצוּקָה תִּתְקְפֵהוּ כְּמֶלֶךְ עָתִיד לַכִּידוֹר ׃
lxx: ἀνάγκη δὲ καὶ θλίψις αὐτὸν καθέξει ὥσπερ στρατηγὸς πρωτοστάτης πίπτων·
vulg: terrebit eum tribulatio et angustia vallabit eum sicut regem qui praeparatur ad proelium
clem: Terrebit eum tribulatio, et angustia vallabit eum, sicut regem qui prparatur ad prlium.
kjv: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

wlc: כִּי־נָטָה אֶל־אֵל יָדוֹ וְאֶל־שַׁדַּי יִתְגַּבָּר ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἦρκεν χεῖρας ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου, ἔναντι δέ Κυρίου Παντοκράτορος ἐτραχηλίασεν,
vulg: tetendit enim adversus Deum manum suam et contra Omnipotentem roboratus est
clem: Tetendit enim adversus Deum manum suam, et contra Omnipotentem roboratus est.
kjv: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

wlc: יָרוּץ אֵלָיו בְּצַוָּאר בַּעֲבִי גַּבֵּי מָגִנָּיו ׃
lxx: ἔδραμεν δὲ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ὕβρει, ἐν πάχει νώτου ἀσπίδος αὐτοῦ·
vulg: cucurrit adversus eum erecto collo et pingui cervice armatus est
clem: Cucurrit adversus eum erecto collo, et pingui cervice armatus est.
kjv: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

wlc: כִּי־כִסָּה פָנָיו בְּחֶלְבּוֹ וַיַּעַשׂ פִּימָה עֲלֵי־כָסֶל ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἐκάλυψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐν στέατι αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐποίησεν περιστόμιον ἐπὶ τῶν μηρίων.
vulg: operuit faciem eius crassitudo et de lateribus eius arvina dependet
clem: Operuit faciem ejus crassitudo, et de lateribus ejus arvina dependet.
kjv: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.

wlc: וַיִּשְׁכּוֹן עָרִים נִכְחָדוֹת בָּתִּים לֹא־יֵשְׁבוּ לָמוֹ אֲשֶׁר הִתְעַתְּדוּ לְגַלִּים ׃
lxx: αὐλισθείη δὲ πόλεις ἐρήμους. εἰσέλθοι δὲ εἰς οἴκους ἀοικήτους· ἄ δὲ ἐκεῖνοι ἡτοίμασαν, ἄλλοι ἀποίσονται.
vulg: habitavit in civitatibus desolatis et in domibus desertis quae in tumulos sunt redactae
clem: Habitavit in civitatibus desolatis, et in domibus desertis, qu in tumulos sunt redact.
kjv: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

wlc: לֹא־יֶעְשַׁר וְלֹא־יָקוּם חֵילוֹ וְלֹא־יִטֶּה לָאָרֶץ מִנְלָם ׃
lxx: οὔτε μὴ πλουτισθῇ, οὔτε μὴ μείνῃ αὐτοῦ τὰ ὑπάρχοντα· οὐ μὴ βάλῃ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν σκιάν,
vulg: non ditabitur nec perseverabit substantia eius nec mittet in terra radicem suam
clem: Non ditabitur, nec perseverabit substantia ejus, nec mittet in terra radicem suam.
kjv: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

wlc: לֹא־יָסוּר מִנִּי־חֹשֶׁךְ יֹנַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּשׁ שַׁלְהָבֶת וְיָסוּר בְּרוּחַ פִּיו ׃
lxx: οὐδὲ μὴ ἐκφύγῃ τὸ σκότος· τὸν βλαστὸν αὐτοῦ μαράναι ἄνεμος, ἐκπέσοι δὲ αὐτοῦ τὸ ἄνθος.
vulg: non recedet de tenebris ramos eius arefaciet flamma et auferetur spiritu oris sui
clem: Non recedet de tenebris: ramos ejus arefaciet flamma, et auferetur spiritu oris sui.
kjv: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

wlc: אַל־יַאֲמֵן בַּשּׁוֹ נִתְעָה כִּי־שָׁוְא תִּהְיֶה תְמוּרָתוֹ ׃
lxx: μὴ πιστευέτω ὅτι ὑπομενεῖ, κενὰ γὰρ ἀποβήσεται αὐτῷ·
vulg: non credat frustra errore deceptus quod aliquo pretio redimendus sit
clem: Non credet, frustra errore deceptus, quod aliquo pretio redimendus sit.
kjv: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

wlc: בְּלֹא־יוֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵא וְכִפָּתוֹ לֹא רַעֲנָנָה ׃
lxx: ἡ τομὴ αὐτοῦ πρὸ ὥρας φθαρήσεται, καὶ ὁ ῥάδαμνος αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ πυκάσῃ·
vulg: antequam dies eius impleantur peribit et manus eius arescet
clem: Antequam dies ejus impleantur peribit, et manus ejus arescent.
kjv: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

wlc: יַחְמֹס כַּגֶּפֶן בִּסְרוֹ וְיַשְׁלֵךְ כַּזַּיִת נִצָּתוֹ ׃
lxx: τρυγηθείη) δὲ ὡς ὄμφαξ πρὸ ὥρας. ἐκπέσοι δὲ ὡς ἄνθος ἐλαίας.
vulg: laedetur quasi vinea in primo flore botrus eius et quasi oliva proiciens florem suum
clem: Ldetur quasi vinea in primo flore botrus ejus, et quasi oliva projiciens florem suum.
kjv: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

wlc: כִּי־עֲדַת חָנֵף גַּלְמוּד וְאֵשׁ אָכְלָה אָהֳלֵי־שֹׁחַד ׃
lxx: μαρτύριον γὰρ ἀσεβοῦς θάνατος, πῦρ δὲ καύσει οἴκους δωροδεκτῶν.
vulg: congregatio enim hypocritae sterilis et ignis devorabit tabernacula eorum qui munera libenter accipiunt
clem: Congregatio enim hypocrit sterilis, et ignis devorabit tabernacula eorum qui munera libenter accipiunt.
kjv: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

wlc: הָרֹה עָמָל וְיָלֹד אָוֶן וּבִטְנָם תָּכִין מִרְמָה ׃ ס
lxx: ἐν γαστρὶ δὲ λήμψεται ὀδύνας,
vulg: concepit dolorem et peperit iniquitatem et uterus eius praeparat dolos
clem: Concepit dolorem, et peperit iniquitatem, et uterus ejus prparat dolos.]
kjv: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.

wlc: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: ῾γπολαβὼν δὲ ᾿Ιὼβ λέγει
vulg: respondens autem Iob dixit
clem: Respondens autem Job, dixit:
kjv: Then Job answered and said,

wlc: שָׁמַעְתִּי כְאֵלֶּה רַבּוֹת מְנַחֲמֵי עָמָל כֻּלְּכֶם ׃
lxx: Ἀκήκοα τοιαῦτα πολλά· παρακλήτοπες κακῶν πάντες.
vulg: audivi frequenter talia consolatores onerosi omnes vos estis
clem: [Audivi frequenter talia: consolatores onerosi omnes vos estis.
kjv: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.

wlc: הֲקֵץ לְדִבְרֵי־רוּחַ אוֹ מַה־יַּמְרִיצְךָ כִּי תַעֲנֶה ׃
lxx: τί γάρ; μὴ τάξις ἐσὶν ῥήμασιν πνεύματος; ἤ τί παρακλήτορες κακῶν πάντες. ἤ τί παρενοχλήσει σοι ὅτι ἀποκρίνῃ;
vulg: numquid habebunt finem verba ventosa aut aliquid tibi molestum est si loquaris
clem: Numquid habebunt finem verba ventosa? aut aliquid tibi molestum est, si loquaris?
kjv: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

wlc: גַּם אָנֹכִי כָּכֶם אֲדַבֵּרָה לוּ־יֵשׁ נַפְשְׁכֶם תַּחַת נַפְשִׁי אַחְבִּירָה עֲלֵיכֶם בְּמִלִּים וְאָנִיעָה עֲלֵיכֶם בְּמוֹ רֹאשִׁי ׃
lxx: κἀγὼ καθʼ ὑμᾶς λαλήσω. εἰ ὑπέκειτό γε ἡ ψυχὴ ὑμῶν ἀντὶ τῆς ἐμῆς.
vulg: poteram et ego similia vestri loqui atque utinam esset anima vestra pro anima mea
clem: Poteram et ego similia vestri loqui, atque utinam esset anima vestra pro anima mea:
kjv: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

wlc: אֲאַמִּצְכֶם בְּמוֹ־פִי וְנִיד שְׂפָתַי יַחְשֹׂךְ ׃
lxx: εἶτ᾿ ἐναλοῦμαι ὑμῖν ῥήμασιν, κινήσω δὲ καθʼ ὑμῶν κεφαλήν.
vulg: consolarer et ego vos sermonibus et moverem caput meum super vos
clem: consolarer et ego vos sermonibus, et moverem caput meum super vos;
kjv: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.

wlc: אִם־אֲדַבְּרָה לֹא־יֵחָשֵׂךְ כְּאֵבִי וְאַחְדְּלָה מַה־מִנִּי יַהֲלֹךְ ׃
lxx: εἴη δὲ ἰσχὺς ἐν τῷ στόματί μου. κίνησιν δέ χειλέων οὐ φείσομαι.
vulg: roborarem vos ore meo et moverem labia quasi parcens vobis
clem: roborarem vos ore meo, et moverem labia mea, quasi parcens vobis.
kjv: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

wlc: אַךְ־עַתָּה הֶלְאָנִי הֲשִׁמּוֹתָ כָּל־עֲדָתִי ׃
lxx: ἐὰν γὰρ λαλήσω, οὐκ ἀλγήσω τὸ τραῦμα· ἐὰν δὲ καὶ σιωπήσω, τί ἔλαττον τρωθήσομαι;
vulg: sed quid agam si locutus fuero non quiescet dolor meus et si tacuero non recedet a me
clem: Sed quid agam? Si locutus fuero, non quiescet dolor meus, et si tacuero, non recedet a me.
kjv: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

wlc: וַתִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵד הָיָה וַיָּקָם בִּי כַחֲשִׁי בְּפָנַי יַעֲנֶה ׃
lxx: νῦυ δὲ κατάκοπόν με πεποίηκεν, μωρόν, σεσηπότα,
vulg: nunc autem oppressit me dolor meus et in nihili redacti sunt omnes artus mei
clem: Nunc autem oppressit me dolor meus, et in nihilum redacti sunt omnes artus mei.
