wlc: כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי אֲכַנֶּה כִּמְעַט יִשָּׂאֵנִי עֹשֵׂנִי ׃
lxx: οὐ γὰρ ἐπίσταμαι θαυμάσαι πρόσωπα· εἰ δὲ μή, καὶ ἐμὲ σῆτες ἔδονται.
vulg: nescio enim quamdiu subsistam et si post modicum tollat me factor meus
clem: Nescio enim quamdiu subsistam, et si post modicum tollat me factor meus.]
kjv: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.

wlc: וְאוּלָם שְׁמַע־נָא אִיּוֹב מִלָּי וְכָל־דְּבָרַי הַאֲזִינָה ׃
lxx: οὐ μὴν δὲ ἀλλὰ ἄκουσον, Ἰὼβ, τὰ ῥήματά μου. καὶ λαλιὰν ἐνωτίζου μου·
vulg: audi igitur Iob eloquia mea et omnes sermones meos ausculta
clem: [Audi igitur, Job, eloquia mea, et omnes sermones meos ausculta.
kjv: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

wlc: הִנֵּה־נָא פָּתַחְתִּי פִי דִּבְּרָה לְשׁוֹנִי בְחִכִּי ׃
lxx: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἤνοξα τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἐλάλησεν ἡ γλῶσσά μου.
vulg: ecce aperui os meum loquatur lingua mea in faucibus meis
clem: Ecce aperui os meum: loquatur lingua mea in faucibus meis.
kjv: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

wlc: יֹשֶׁר־לִבִּי אֲמָרָי וְדַעַת שְׂפָתַי בָּרוּר מִלֵּלוּ ׃
lxx: καθαρά μου ἡ καρδία ῥήμασιν, σύνεσις δέ χειλέων μου καθαρὰ νοήσει.
vulg: simplici corde meo sermones mei et sententiam labia mea puram loquentur
clem: Simplici corde meo sermones mei, et sententiam puram labia mea loquentur.
kjv: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

wlc: רוּחַ־אֵל עָשָׂתְנִי וְנִשְׁמַת שַׁדַּי תְּחַיֵּנִי ׃
lxx: πνεῦμα θεῖον τὸ ποιῆσάν με, πνοὴ δὲ αντοκράτορος ἡ διδάσκουσά με.
vulg: spiritus Dei fecit me et spiraculum Omnipotentis vivificavit me
clem: Spiritus Dei fecit me, et spiraculum Omnipotentis vivificavit me.
kjv: The spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

wlc: אִם־תּוּכַל הֲשִׁיבֵנִי עֶרְכָה לְפָנַי הִתְיַצָּבָה ׃
lxx: ἐὸ δός μοι ἀπόκρισιν πρὸς ταῦτα· ὑπόμεινον, στῆθι κατʼ ἐμέ καὶ ἐγὼ κατὰ σέ.
vulg: si potes responde mihi et adversus faciem meam consiste
clem: Si potes, responde mihi, et adversus faciem meam consiste.
kjv: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.

wlc: הֵן־אֲנִי כְפִיךָ לָאֵל מֵחֹמֶר קֹרַצְתִּי גַם־אָנִי ׃
lxx: ἐκ πηλοῦ διήρτισαι σὺ ὡς καὶ ἐγώ· ἐκ τοῦ αὐτοῦ διηρτίσμεθα.
vulg: ecce et me sicut et te fecit Deus et de eodem luto ego quoque formatus sum
clem: Ecce, et me sicut et te fecit Deus, et de eodem luto ego quoque formatus sum.
kjv: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

wlc: הִנֵּה אֵמָתִי לֹא תְבַעֲתֶךָּ וְאַכְפִּי עָלֶיךָ לֹא־יִכְבָּד ׃
lxx: οὐχ ὁ φόβος μού σε στροβήσει, οὐδὲ ἡ χείρ μου βαρεῖα ἔσται ἐπὶ σοί.
vulg: verumtamen miraculum meum non te terreat et eloquentia mea non sit tibi gravis
clem: Verumtamen miraculum meum non te terreat, et eloquentia mea non sit tibi gravis.
kjv: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

wlc: אַךְ אָמַרְתָּ בְאָזְנָי וְקוֹל מִלִּין אֶשְׁמָע ׃
lxx: χλὴν εἶπας ἐν ὠσίν μου, φωνὴν ῥημάτων ἀκήκοα
vulg: dixisti ergo in auribus meis et vocem verborum audivi
clem: Dixisti ergo in auribus meis, et vocem verborum tuorum audivi:
kjv: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,

wlc: זַךְ אֲנִי בְּלִי פָשַׁע חַף אָנֹכִי וְלֹא עָוֹן לִי ׃
lxx: διότι λέγεις Καθαρός εἰμι, οὐχ ἁμαρτών· ἄμεμπτός εἰμι, οὐ γὰρ ἠνόμησα.
vulg: mundus sum ego absque delicto inmaculatus et non est iniquitas in me
clem: Mundus sum ego, et absque delicto: immaculatus, et non est iniquitas in me.
kjv: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

wlc: הֵן תְּנוּאוֹת עָלַי יִמְצָא יַחְשְׁבֵנִי לְאוֹיֵב לוֹ ׃
lxx: μέμψιν δὲ κατʼ ἐμοῦ εὖρεν, ἥγηται δέ με ὥσπερ ὑπεναντίον·
vulg: quia querellas in me repperit ideo arbitratus est me inimicum sibi
clem: Quia querelas in me reperit, ideo arbitratus est me inimicum sibi.
kjv: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

wlc: יָשֵׂם בַּסַּד רַגְלָי יִשְׁמֹר כָּל־אָרְחֹתָי ׃
lxx: ἔθετο δὲ ἐν ξύλῳ τὸν πόδα μου. ἐφύλαξεν δέ μου πάσας τὰς ὁδούς.
vulg: posuit in nervo pedes meos custodivit omnes semitas meas
clem: Posuit in nervo pedes meos; custodivit omnes semitas meas.
kjv: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

wlc: הֶן־זֹאת לֹא־צָדַקְתָּ אֶעֱנֶךָּ כִּי־יִרְבֶּה אֱלוֹהַ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ ׃
lxx: πῶς γὰρ λέγεις Δίκαιός εἰμι, καὶ οὐκ ἐπακήκοέν μου αἰώνιος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ἐπάνω βροτῶν.
vulg: hoc est ergo in quo non es iustificatus respondebo tibi quia maior sit Deus homine
clem: Hoc est ergo in quo non es justificatus: respondebo tibi, quia major sit Deus homine.
kjv: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

wlc: מַדּוּעַ אֵלָיו רִיבוֹתָ כִּי כָל־דְּבָרָיו לֹא־יַעֲנֶה ׃
lxx: λέγεις δέ Διὰ τί τῆς δίκης μου οὐκ ἐπακήκοέν μου πᾶν ῥῆμα
vulg: adversum eum contendis quod non ad omnia verba responderit tibi
clem: Adversus eum contendis, quod non ad omnia verba responderit tibi?
kjv: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

wlc: כִּי־בְאַחַת יְדַבֶּר־אֵל וּבִשְׁתַּיִם לֹא יְשׁוּרֶנָּה ׃
lxx: ἐν γὰρ τῷ ἅπαξ λαλήσαι ὁ κύριος. ἐν δὲ τῷ δευτέρῳ·
vulg: semel loquitur Deus et secundo id ipsum non repetit
clem: Semel loquitur Deus, et secundo idipsum non repetit.
kjv: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

wlc: בַּחֲלוֹם חֶזְיוֹן לַיְלָה בִּנְפֹל תַּרְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁים בִּתְנוּמוֹת עֲלֵי מִשְׁכָּב ׃
lxx: ἐνύπνιον, ἤ ἐν μελέτῃ νυκτερινῇ. ὡς ὅταν ἐπιπίπτῃ δεινὸς φόβος ἐπʼ ἀνθρώπους, ἐπὶ νυσταγμάτων ἐπὶ κοίτης·
vulg: per somnium in visione nocturna quando inruit sopor super homines et dormiunt in lectulo
clem: Per somnium, in visione nocturna, quando irruit sopor super homines, et dormiunt in lectulo,
kjv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

wlc: אָז יִגְלֶה אֹזֶן אֲנָשִׁים וּבְמֹסָרָם יַחְתֹּם ׃
lxx: τότε ἀνακαλύπτει νοῦν ἀνθρώπων, ἐν εἴδεσιν φόβου τοιούτοις αὐτοὺς ἐξεφόβησεν.
vulg: tunc aperit aures virorum et erudiens eos instruit disciplinam
clem: tunc aperit aures virorum, et erudiens eos instruit disciplina,
kjv: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

wlc: לְהָסִיר אָדָם מַעֲשֶׂה וְגֵוָה מִגֶּבֶר יְכַסֶּה ׃
lxx: ἀποστρέψαι ἄνθρωπον ἀπὸ ἀδικίας· τὸ δὲ σῶμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ πτώματος ἐρρύσατο.
vulg: ut avertat hominem ab his quae facit et liberet eum de superbia
clem: ut avertat hominem ab his qu facit, et liberet eum de superbia,
kjv: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

wlc: יַחְשֹׂךְ נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁחַת וְחַיָּתוֹ מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּׁלַח ׃
lxx: ἐφείσατο δὲ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ θανάτου, καὶ μὴ πεσεῖν αὐτὸν ἐν πολεμῇ.
vulg: eruens animam eius a corruptione et vitam illius ut non transeat in gladium
clem: eruens animam ejus a corruptione, et vitam illius ut non transeat in gladium.
kjv: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

wlc: וְהוּכַח בְּמַכְאוֹב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ וְרִיב עֲצָמָיו אֵתָן ׃
lxx: πάλιν δὲ ἤλεγξεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ μαλακίᾳ ἐπὶ κοίτης. καὶ πλῆθος ὀστῶν αὐτοῦ ἐνάρκησεν·
vulg: increpat quoque per dolorem in lectulo et omnia ossa eius marcescere facit
clem: Increpat quoque per dolorem in lectulo, et omnia ossa ejus marcescere facit.
kjv: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

wlc: וְזִהֲמַתּוּ חַיָּתוֹ לָחֶם וְנַפְשׁוֹ מַאֲכַל תַּאֲוָה ׃
lxx: πᾶν δὲ βρωτὸν σίτου οὐ μὴ δύνηται προσδέξασθαι, καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ βρῶσιν ἐπιθυμήσει·
vulg: abominabilis ei fit in vita sua panis et animae illius cibus ante desiderabilis
clem: Abominabilis ei fit in vita sua panis, et anim illius cibus ante desiderabilis.
kjv: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.

wlc: יִכֶל בְּשָׂרוֹ מֵרֹאִי וּשְׁפִי עַצְמוֹתָיו לֹא רֻאוּ ׃
lxx: ἕως ἂν σαπῶσιν αὐτοῦ αἱ σάρκες, καὶ ἀποδείξῃ τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτοῦ κενά.
vulg: tabescet caro eius et ossa quae tecta fuerant nudabuntur
clem: Tabescet caro ejus, et ossa, qu tecta fuerant, nudabuntur.
kjv: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

wlc: וַתִּקְרַב לַשַּׁחַת נַפְשׁוֹ וְחַיָּתוֹ לַמְמִתִים ׃
lxx: ἤγγισεν δὲ εἰς θάνατον ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ, ἥδε ἡ ςωὴ αὐταῦ ν ᾅδῃ·
vulg: adpropinquabit corruptioni anima eius et vita illius mortiferis
clem: Appropinquavit corruptioni anima ejus, et vita illius mortiferis.
kjv: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

wlc: אִם־יֵשׁ עָלָיו מַלְאָךְ מֵלִיץ אֶחָד מִנִּי־אָלֶף לְהַגִּיד לְאָדָם יָשְׁרוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐὰν ὢσιν χίλιοι ἄγγελοι θανατηφόροι, εἶς αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ τρώσῃ αὐτόν. ἐὰν νοήσῃ τῇ καρδίᾳ ἐπιστραφῆναι πρὸς Κύριρν, ἀναγγείλῃ δὲ ἀνθρώπῳ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ μέμψιν, τὴν δὲ ἄνοιαν αὐτοῦ δείξῃ,
vulg: si fuerit pro eo angelus loquens unum de milibus ut adnuntiet hominis aequitatem
clem: Si fuerit pro eo angelus loquens, unus de millibus, ut annuntiet hominis quitatem,
kjv: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

wlc: וַיְחֻנֶּנּוּ וַיֹּאמֶר פְּדָעֵהוּ מֵרֶדֶת שָׁחַת מָצָאתִי כֹפֶר ׃
lxx: ἀνθέξεται τοῦ μὴ πεσεῖν εἰς θάνατον· ἀνανεώσει δὲ αὐτοῦ τὸ σῶμα ὥσπερ ἀλοιφὴν ἐπὶ τοίχου, τὰ δὲ ὀστᾶ αὐτοῦ ἐμπλήσει μυελοῦ·
vulg: miserebitur eius et dicet libera eum et non descendat in corruptionem inveni in quo ei propitier
clem: miserebitur ejus, et dicet: Libera eum, ut non descendat in corruptionem: inveni in quo ei propitier.
kjv: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

wlc: רֻטֲפַשׁ בְּשָׂרוֹ מִנֹּעַר יָשׁוּב לִימֵי עֲלוּמָיו ׃
lxx: ἁπαλυνεῖ δὲ αὐτοῦ τὰς σάρκας ὥσπερ νηπίου, ἀποκαταστήσει δὲ αὐτὸν ἀνδρωθέντα ἐν ἀνθρώποις.
vulg: consumpta est caro eius a suppliciis revertatur ad dies adulescentiae suae
clem: Consumpta est caro ejus a suppliciis: revertatur ad dies adolescenti su.
kjv: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:

wlc: יֶעְתַּר אֶל־אֱלוֹהַּ וַיִּרְצֵהוּ וַיַּרְא פָּנָיו בִּתְרוּעָה וַיָּשֶׁב לֶאֱנוֹשׁ צִדְקָתוֹ ׃
lxx: εὐξάμενος δὲ πρὸς Κύριον, καὶ δεκτὰ αὐτῷ ἔσται, εἰσελεύσεται δὲ προσώπῳ ἱλαρῷ σὺν ἐξηγορίᾳ· ἀποδώσει δὲ ἀνθρώποις δικαιοσύνην.
vulg: deprecabitur Deum et placabilis ei erit et videbit faciem eius in iubilo et reddet homini iustitiam suam
clem: Deprecabitur Deum, et placabilis ei erit: et videbit faciem ejus in jubilo, et reddet homini justitiam suam.
kjv: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

wlc: יָשֹׁר עַל־אֲנָשִׁים וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָאתִי וְיָשָׁר הֶעֱוֵיתִי וְלֹא־שָׁוָה לִי ׃
lxx: εἶτα τότε ἀπομέμψεται ἄνθρωπος αὐτὸς ἑαυτῷ λέγων Οἶα συνετέλουν; καὶ οὐκ ἄξια ἤτασέν με ὧν ἥμαρτον.
vulg: respiciet homines et dicet peccavi et vere deliqui et ut eram dignus non recepi
clem: Respiciet homines, et dicet: Peccavi, et vere deliqui, et ut eram dignus, non recepi.
kjv: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;

wlc: פָּדָה נַפְשׁיֹ מֵעֲבֹר בַּשָּׁחַת וְחַיָּתיֹ בָּאוֹר תִּרְאֶה ׃
lxx: σῶσον ψυχὴν μου τοῦ μὴ ἐλθεῖν εἰς διαφθοράν, καὶ ἡ ζωή μου φῶς ὄψεται.
vulg: liberavit animam suam ne pergeret in interitum sed vivens lucem videret
clem: Liberavit animam suam, ne pergeret in interitum, sed vivens lucem videret.
kjv: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

wlc: הֶן־כָּל־אֵלֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵל פַּעֲמַיִם שָׁלוֹשׁ עִם־גָּבֶר ׃
lxx: ἰδοὺ ταῦτα πάντα ἐργᾶται ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ὁδοὺς τρεῖς μετὰ ἀνδρός·
vulg: ecce haec omnia operatur Deus tribus vicibus per singulos
clem: Ecce hc omnia operatur Deus tribus vicibus per singulos,
kjv: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,

wlc: לְהָשִׁיב נַפְשׁוֹ מִנִּי־שָׁחַת לֵאוֹר בְּאוֹר הַחַיִּים ׃
lxx: ἀλλ’ ἐρὔσατο τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ θανάτου, ἵνα ἡ ζωή μου ἐν φωτὶ αἰνῇ αὐτόν.
vulg: ut revocet animas eorum a corruptione et inluminet luce viventium
clem: ut revocet animas eorum a corruptione, et illuminet luce viventium.
kjv: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

wlc: הַקְשֵׁב אִיּוֹב שְׁמַע־לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר ׃
lxx: ἐνωτίζου, Ἰὼβ, καὶ ἄκουέ μου· κώφευσον, καὶ ἐγώ εἰμι λαλήσω. λάλησον, θέλω γὰρ δικαιωθῆναί σε.
vulg: adtende Iob et audi me et tace dum ego loquar
clem: Attende, Job, et audi me: et tace, dum ego loquor.
kjv: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

wlc: אִם־יֵשׁ־מִלִּין הֲשִׁיבֵנִי דַּבֵּר כִּי־חָפַצְתִּי צַדְּקֶךָּ ׃
vulg: si autem habes quod loquaris responde mihi loquere volo enim te apparere iustum
clem: Si autem habes quod loquaris, responde mihi: loquere, volo enim te apparere justum.
kjv: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

wlc: אִם־אַיִן אַתָּה שְׁמַע־לִי הַחֲרֵשׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ חָכְמָה ׃ ס
lxx: εἰ μή, σὺ ἄκουσόν μου· κώφευσον, καὶ διδάξω σε.
vulg: quod si non habes audi me tace et docebo te sapientiam
clem: Quod si non habes, audi me: tace, et docebo te sapientiam.]
kjv: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.

wlc: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּא וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: ῾ Υπολαβὼν δὲ Ἐλιοῦς λέγει
vulg: pronuntians itaque Heliu etiam haec locutus est
clem: Pronuntians itaque Eliu, etiam hc locutus est:
kjv: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

wlc: שִׁמְעוּ חֲכָמִים מִלָּי וְיֹדְעִים הַאֲזִינוּ לִי ׃
lxx: Ἀκούσατέ μου, σοφοί ἐπιστάμενοι, ἐνωτίζεσθε·
vulg: audite sapientes verba mea et eruditi auscultate me
clem: [Audite, sapientes, verba mea: et eruditi, auscultate me.
kjv: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

wlc: כִּי־אֹזֶן מִלִּין תִּבְחָן וְחֵךְ יִטְעַם לֶאֱכֹל ׃
lxx: ὅτι οὖς λόγους δοκιμάζει, καὶ λάρυγξ γεύεται βρῶσιν.
vulg: auris enim verba probat et guttur escas gustu diiudicat
clem: Auris enim verba probat, et guttur escas gustu dijudicat.
kjv: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

wlc: מִשְׁפָּט נִבְחֲרָה־לָּנוּ נֵדְעָה בֵינֵינוּ מַה־טּוֹב ׃
lxx: κρίσιν ἑλώμεθα ἑαυτοῖς, γνῶμεν ἀνὰ μέσον ἑαυτῶν ὅ τι καλόν.
vulg: iudicium eligamus nobis et inter nos videamus quid sit melius
clem: Judicium eligamus nobis, et inter nos videamus quid sit melius.
kjv: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.

wlc: כִּי־אָמַר אִיּוֹב צָדַקְתִּי וְאֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִי ׃
lxx: ὅτι εἴρηκεν Ἰώβ Δίκαιός εἰμι, ὁ κύριος ἀπήλλαξέν μου τὸ κρίμα.
vulg: quia dixit Iob iustus sum et Deus subvertit iudicium meum
clem: Quia dixit Job: Justus sum, et Deus subvertit judicium meum.
kjv: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.

wlc: עַל־מִשְׁפָּטִי אֲכַזֵּב אָנוּשׁ חִצִּי בְלִי־פָשַׁע ׃
lxx: ἐψεύσατο δὲ τῷ κρίματί μου· βίαιον τὸ βέλος μου ἄνευ ἀδικίας.
vulg: in iudicando enim me mendacium est violenta sagitta mea absque ullo peccato
clem: In judicando enim me mendacium est: violenta sagitta mea absque ullo peccato.
kjv: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.

wlc: מִי־גֶבֶר כְּאִיּוֹב יִשְׁתֶּה־לַּעַג כַּמָּיִם ׃
lxx: τίς ἀνὴρ ὥσπερ Ἰὼβ, πίνων μυκτηρισμὸν ὥσπερ ὕδωρ;
vulg: quis est vir ut est Iob qui bibit subsannationem quasi aquam
clem: Quis est vir ut est Job, qui bibit subsannationem quasi aquam:
kjv: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?

wlc: וְאָרַח לְחֶבְרָה עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וְלָלֶכֶת עִם־אַנְשֵׁי־רֶשַׁע ׃
lxx: οὐχ ἁμαρτὼν οὐδὲ ἀσεβήσας, ἤ ὁδοῦ κοινωνήσας μετὰ ποιούντων τὰ ἄνομα, τοῦ πορευθῆναι μετὰ ἀσεβῶν.
vulg: qui graditur cum operantibus iniquitatem et ambulat cum viris impiis
clem: qui graditur cum operantibus iniquitatem, et ambulat cum viris impiis?
kjv: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

wlc: כִּי־אָמַר לֹא יִסְכָּן־גָּבֶר בִּרְצֹתוֹ עִם־אֱלֹהִים ׃
lxx: μὴ γὰρ εἴπῃς ὅτι Οὐκ ἔσται ἐπισκοπὴ ἀνδρός· καὶ ἐπισκοπὴ αὐτῷ παρὰ Κυρίου.
vulg: dixit enim non placebit vir Deo etiam si cucurrerit cum eo
clem: Dixit enim: Non placebit vir Deo, etiam si cucurrerit cum eo.
kjv: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.

wlc: לָכֵן אַנֲשֵׁי לֵבָב שִׁמְעוּ לִי חָלִלָה לָאֵל מֵרֶשַׁע וְשַׁדַּי מֵעָוֶל ׃
lxx: διό, συνετοὶ καρδίας, ἀκούσατέ μου Μή μοι εἴη) ἔναντι Κυρίου ἀσεβῆσαι, καὶ ἔναντι Παντοκράτορος ταράξαι τὸ δίκαιον·
vulg: ideo viri cordati audite me absit a Deo impietas et ab Omnipotente iniquitas
clem: Ideo, viri cordati, audite me: absit a Deo impietas, et ab Omnipotente iniquitas.
kjv: Therefore hearken unto me ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

wlc: כִּי פֹעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ וּכְאֹרַח אִישׁ יַמְצִאֶנּוּ ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ ἀποδιδοῖ ἀνθρώπῳ καθὰ ποιεῖ ἕκαστος αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν τρίβῳ ἀνδρὸς εὑρήσει αὐτόν.
vulg: opus enim hominis reddet ei et iuxta vias singulorum restituet
clem: Opus enim hominis reddet ei, et juxta vias singulorum restituet eis.
kjv: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

wlc: אַף־אָמְנָם אֵל לֹא־יַרְשִׁיעַ וְשַׁדַּי לֹא־יְעַוֵּת מִשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: οἴῃ δὲ τὸν κύριον ἄτοπα ποιήσειν ἤ ὁ παντοκράτωρ ταράξει κρίσιν,
vulg: vere enim Deus non condemnabit frustra nec Omnipotens subvertet iudicium
clem: Vere enim Deus non condemnabit frustra, nec Omnipotens subvertet judicium.
kjv: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.

wlc: מִי־פָקַד עָלָיו אָרְצָה וּמִי שָׂם תֵּבֵל כֻּלָּהּ ׃
lxx: ὅς ἐποίησεν τὴν γῆν τίς δέ ἐστιν ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ὐπʼ οὐρανὸν καὶ τὰ ἐνόντα πάντα;
vulg: quem constituit alium super terram aut quem posuit super orbem quem fabricatus est
clem: Quem constituit alium super terram? aut quem posuit super orbem quem fabricatus est?
kjv: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?

wlc: אִם־יָשִׂים אֵלָיו לִבּוֹ רוּחוֹ וְנִשְׁמָתוֹ אֵלָיו יֶאֱסֹף ׃
lxx: εἰ γὰρ βούλοιτο συνέχειν, καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα παρʼ αὐτῷ κατασχεῖν,
vulg: si direxerit ad eum cor suum spiritum illius et flatum ad se trahet
clem: Si direxerit ad eum cor suum, spiritum illius et flatum ad se trahet.
kjv: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

wlc: יִגְוַע כָּל־בָּשָׂר יָחַד וְאָדָם עַל־עָפָר יָשׁוּב ׃
lxx: τελευτήσει πᾶσα σὰρξ ὁμοθυμαδόν, πᾶς δὲ βροτὸς εἰς γῆν ἀπελεύσεται ὅθεν καὶ ἐπλάσθη.
vulg: deficiet omnis caro simul et homo in cinerem revertetur
clem: Deficiet omnis caro simul, et homo in cinerem revertetur.
kjv: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.

wlc: וְאִם־בִּינָה שִׁמְעָה־זֹּאת הַאֲזִינָה לְקוֹל מִלָּי ׃
lxx: εἰ δὲ μὴ νουθετῇ, ἄκουε ταῦτα, ἐνωτίζου φωνὴν ῥημάτων.
vulg: si habes ergo intellectum audi quod dicitur et ausculta vocem eloquii mei
clem: Si habes ergo intellectum, audi quod dicitur, et ausculta vocem eloquii mei:
kjv: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.

wlc: הַאַף שׂוֹנֵא מִשְׁפָּט יַחֲבוֹשׁ וְאִם־צַדִּיק כַּבִּיר תַּרְשִׁיעַ ׃
lxx: ἴδε σὺ τὸν μισοῦντα ἄνομα καὶ τὸν ὀλλύντα τοὺς πονηρούς, ὄντα αἰώνιον δίκαιον.
vulg: numquid qui non amat iudicium sanare potest et quomodo tu eum qui iustus est in tantum condemnas
clem: numquid qui non amat judicium sanari potest? et quomodo tu eum qui justus est in tantum condemnas?
kjv: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?

wlc: הַאֲמֹר לְמֶלֶךְ בְּלִיָּעַל רָשָׁע אֶל־נְדִיבִים ׃
lxx: ἀσεβὴς ὁ λέγων βασιλεῖ Παρανομεῖς. Ἀσεβέστατε, τοῖς ἄρχουσιν·
vulg: qui dicit regi apostata qui vocat duces impios
clem: Qui dicit regi: Apostata; qui vocat duces impios;
kjv: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?

wlc: אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשָׂא פְּנֵי שָׂרִים וְלֹא נִכַּר־שׁוֹעַ לִפְנֵי־דָל כִּי־מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו כֻּלָּם ׃
lxx: ὃς οὐκ ἐπαισχυνθῇ πρόσωπον ἐντίμου, οὐδὲ οἶδεν τιμὴν θέσθαι ἁδροῖς, θαυμασθῆναι πρόσωπα αὐτῶν.
vulg: qui non accipit personas principum nec cognovit tyrannum cum disceptaret contra pauperem opus enim manuum eius sunt universi
clem: qui non accipit personas principum, nec cognovit tyrannum cum disceptaret contra pauperem: opus enim manuum ejus sunt universi.
kjv: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.

wlc: רֶגַע יָמֻתוּ וַחֲצוֹת לָיְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁוּ עָם וְיַעֲבֹרוּ וְיָסִירוּ אַבִּיר לֹא בְיָד ׃
lxx: κενὰ δὲ αὐτοῖς ἀποβήσεται τὸ κεκραγέναι καὶ δεῖσθαι ἀνδρός· ἐχρήσαντο γὰρ παρανόμως, ἐκκλινομένων ἀδυνάτων.
vulg: subito morientur et in media nocte turbabuntur populi et pertransibunt et auferent violentum absque manu
clem: Subito morientur, et in media nocte turbabuntur populi: et pertransibunt, et auferent violentum absque manu.
kjv: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.

wlc: כִּי־עֵינָיו עַל־דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ וְכָל־צְעָדָיו יִרְאֶה ׃
lxx: αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁρατής ἐστιν ἔργων ἀνθρώπων, λέληθεν δὲ αὐτὸν οὐδὲν ὦν πράσσουσιν·
vulg: oculi enim eius super vias hominum et omnes gressus eorum considerat
clem: Oculi enim ejus super vias hominum, et omnes gressus eorum considerat.
kjv: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.

wlc: אֵין־חֹשֶׁךְ וְאֵין צַלְמָוֶת לְהִסָּתֶר שָׁם פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן ׃
lxx: οὐδὲ ἔσται τόπος τοῦ κρυβῆναι τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὰ ἄνομα·
vulg: non sunt tenebrae et non est umbra mortis ut abscondantur ibi qui operantur iniquitatem
clem: Non sunt tenebr, et non est umbra mortis, ut abscondantur ibi qui operantur iniquitatem,
kjv: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

wlc: כִּי לֹא עַל־אִישׁ יָשִׂים עוֹד לַהֲלֹךְ אֶל־אֵל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: ὅτι οὐκ ἐπʼ ἄνδρα θήσει ἔτι. ὁ γὰρ κύριος πάντας ἐφορᾷ,
vulg: neque enim ultra in hominis potestate est ut veniat ad Deum in iudicium
clem: neque enim ultra in hominis potestate est, ut veniat ad Deum in judicium.
kjv: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.

wlc: יָרֹעַ כַּבִּירִים לֹא־חֵקֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד אֲחֵרִים תַּחְתָּם ׃
lxx: ὁ καταλαμβάνων ἀνεξιχνίαστα, ἔνδοξά τε καὶ ἐξαίσια, ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός·
vulg: conteret multos innumerabiles et stare faciet alios pro eis
clem: Conteret multos, et innumerabiles, et stare faciet alios pro eis.
kjv: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.

wlc: לָכֵן יַכִּיר מַעְבָּדֵיהֶם וְהָפַךְ לַיְלָה וְיִדַּכָּאוּ ׃
lxx: ὁ γνωρίζων αὐτῶν τὰ ἔργα, καὶ στρέψει νύκτα, καὶ ταπεινωθήσεται.
vulg: novit enim opera eorum et idcirco inducet noctem et conterentur
clem: Novit enim opera eorum, et idcirco inducet noctem, et conterentur.
kjv: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

wlc: תַּחַת־רְשָׁעִים סְפָקָם בִּמְקוֹם רֹאִים ׃
lxx: ἔσβεσεν δὲ ἀσεβεῖς, ὁρατοὶ δὲ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ·
vulg: quasi impios percussit eos in loco videntium
clem: Quasi impios percussit eos in loco videntium:
kjv: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

wlc: אֲשֶׁר עַל־כֵּן סָרוּ מֵאַחֲרָיו וְכָל־דְּרָכָיו לֹא הִשְׂכִּילוּ ׃
lxx: δικαιώματα δὲ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐπέγνωσαν.
vulg: qui quasi de industria recesserunt ab eo et omnes vias eius intellegere noluerunt
clem: qui quasi de industria recesserunt ab eo, et omnes vias ejus intelligere noluerunt:
kjv: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:

wlc: לְהָבִיא עָלָיו צַעֲקַת־דָּל וְצַעֲקַת עֲנִיִּים יִשְׁמָע ׃
lxx: τοῦ ἐπαγαγεῖν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν κραυγὴν πενήτων. καὶ κραυγὴν πτωχῶν εἰσακούσεται.
vulg: ut pervenire facerent ad eum clamorem egeni et audiret vocem pauperum
clem: ut pervenire facerent ad eum clamorem egeni, et audiret vocem pauperum.
kjv: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

wlc: וְהוּא יַשְׁקִט וּמִי יַרְשִׁעַ וְיַסְתֵּר פָּנִים וּמִי יְשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְעַל־גּוֹי וְעַל־אָדָם יָחַד ׃
lxx: καὶ αὐτὸς ἡσυχίαν παρέξει, καὶ τίς καταδικάσεταις καὶ κρύψει πρόσωπον, καὶ τίς ὄψεται αὐτόν; καὶ κατὰ ἔθνους καὶ κατὰ ἀνθρώπου ὁμοῦ·
vulg: ipso enim concedente pacem quis est qui condemnet ex quo absconderit vultum quis est qui contempletur eum et super gentem et super omnes homines
clem: Ipso enim concedente pacem, quis est qui condemnet? ex quo absconderit vultum, quis est qui contempletur eum, et super gentes, et super omnes homines?
kjv: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:

wlc: מִמְּלֹךְ אָדָם חָנֵף מִמֹּקְשֵׁי עָם ׃
lxx: βασιλεύων ἄνθρωπον ὑποκριτὴν ἀπὸ δυσκολίας λαοῦ.
vulg: qui regnare facit hominem hypocritam propter peccata populi
clem: Qui regnare facit hominem hypocritam propter peccata populi.
kjv: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

wlc: כִּי־אֶל־אֵל הֶאָמַר נָשָׂאתִי לֹא אֶחְבֹּל ׃
lxx: ὅτι πρὸς τὸν ἰσχυρὸν ὁ λέγων Εἴληφα, οὐκ ἐνεχυράσωἄνευ
vulg: quia ergo ego locutus sum ad Deum te quoque non prohibeo
clem: Quia ergo ego locutus sum ad Deum, te quoque non prohibebo.
kjv: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:

wlc: בִּלְעֲדֵי אֶחֱזֶה אַתָּה הֹרֵנִי אִם־עָוֶל פָּעַלְתִּי לֹא אֹסִיף ׃
lxx: ἐμαυτοῦ ὄψομαι, σὺ δεῖξόν μοι εἰ ἀδικίαν ἠργασάμην, οὐ μὴ προσθήσω.
vulg: si erravi tu doce me si iniquitatem locutus sum ultra non addam
clem: Si erravi, tu doce me; si iniquitatem locutus sum, ultra non addam.
kjv: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

wlc: הַמֵעִמְּךָ יְשַׁלְמֶנָּה כִּי־מָאַסְתָּ כִּי־אַתָּה תִבְחַר וְלֹא־אָנִי וּמַה־יָדַעְתָּ דַבֵּר ׃
lxx: μὴ ἀπὸ σοῦ ἀποτίσει αὐτήν, ὅτι ἀπώσῃς ὅτι σὺ ἐκλέξῃ καὶ οὐκ ἐγώ· καὶ τί ἔγνως λάλησον.
vulg: numquid a te Deus expetit eam quia displicuit tibi tu enim coepisti loqui et non ego quod si quid nosti melius loquere
clem: Numquid a te Deus expetit eam, quia displicuit tibi? tu enim cpisti loqui, et non ego: quod si quid nosti melius, loquere.
kjv: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.

wlc: אַנְשֵׁי לֵבָב יֹאמְרוּ לִי וְגֶבֶר חָכָם שֹׁמֵעַ לִי ׃
lxx: διὸ συνετοὶ καρδίας ἐροῦσιν ταῦτα, ἀνήρ δὲ σοφὸς ἀκήκοέν μου τὸ ῥῆμα.
vulg: viri intellegentes loquantur mihi et vir sapiens audiat me
clem: Viri intelligentes loquantur mihi, et vir sapiens audiat me.
kjv: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.

wlc: אִיּוֹב לֹא־בְדַעַת יְדַבֵּר וּדְבָרָיו לֹא בְהַשְׂכֵּיל ׃
lxx: Ἰὼβ δὲ οὐκ ἐν συνέσει ἐλάλησεν, τὰ δήματα αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐν ἐπιστήμῃ.
vulg: Iob autem stulte locutus est et verba illius non sonant disciplinam
clem: Job autem stulte locutus est, et verba illius non sonant disciplinam.
kjv: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.

wlc: אָבִי יִבָּחֵן אִיּוֹב עַד־נֶצַח עַל־תְּשֻׁבֹת בְּאַנְשֵׁי־אָוֶן ׃
lxx: οὐ μὴν δὲ ἀλλὰ μάθε. Ἰώβ, μὴ δῷς ἔτι ἀνταπόκρισιν ὥσπερ οἱ ἄφρονες
vulg: pater mi probetur Iob usque ad finem ne desinas in hominibus iniquitatis
clem: Pater mi, probetur Job usque ad finem: ne desinas ab homine iniquitatis:
kjv: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.

wlc: כִּי יֹסִיף עַל־חַטָּאתוֹ פֶשַׁע בֵּינֵינוּ יִסְפּוֹק וְיֶרֶב אֲמָרָיו לָאֵל ׃ ס
lxx: ἴνα μὴ προσθῶμεν ἐφʼ ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν, ἀνομία δὲ ἐφʼ ἡμῖν λογισθήσεται, πολλὰ λαλούντων ὀήματα ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου.
vulg: quia addit super peccata sua blasphemiam inter nos interim constringatur et tunc ad iudicium provocet sermonibus suis Deum
clem: quia addit super peccata sua blasphemiam, inter nos interim constringatur: et tunc ad judicium provocet sermonibus suis Deum.]
kjv: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.

wlc: וַיַּעַן אֱלִיהוּ וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: Ὑκπολαβὰν δὲ Ἐλιοῦς λέγει
vulg: igitur Heliu haec rursum locutus est
clem: Igitur Eliu hc rursum locutus est:
kjv: Elihu spake moreover, and said,

wlc: הֲזֹאת חָשַׁבְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּט אָמַרְתָּ צִדְקִי מֵאֵל ׃
lxx: Τί τοῦτο ἡγήσω ἐν κρίσεις σύ τἰς εἶ ὅτι εἶπας Δίκαιός εἰμι ἔναντι Κυρίου
vulg: numquid aequa tibi videtur tua cogitatio ut diceres iustior Deo sum
clem: [Numquid qua tibi videtur tua cogitatio, ut diceres: Justior sum Deo?
kjv: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?

wlc: כִּי־תֹאמַר מַה־יִּסְכָּן־לָךְ מָה־אֹעִיל מֵחַטָּאתִי ׃
vulg: dixisti enim non tibi placet quod rectum est vel quid tibi proderit si ego peccavero
clem: Dixisti enim: Non tibi placet quod rectum est: vel quid tibi proderit, si ego peccavero?
kjv: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?

wlc: אֲנִי אֲשִׁיבְךָ מִלִּין וְאֶת־רֵעֶיךָ עִמָּךְ ׃
lxx: ἐγὼ σοὶ δώσω ἀπόκρισιν καὶ τοῖς τρισὶν φίλοις σου.
vulg: itaque ego respondebo sermonibus tuis et amicis tuis tecum
clem: Itaque ego respondebo sermonibus tuis, et amicis tuis tecum.
kjv: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.

wlc: הַבֵּט שָׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וְשׁוּר שְׁחָקִים גָּבְהוּ מִמֶּךָּ ׃
lxx: ἀνάβλεψον εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἵδε, κατάμαθε δὲ νέφη ὡς ὑψηλὰ ἀπὸ σοῦ.
vulg: suspice caelum et intuere et contemplare aethera quod altior te sit
clem: Suspice clum, et intuere: et contemplare thera quod altior te sit.
kjv: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.

wlc: אִם־חָטָאתָ מַה־תִּפְעָל־בּוֹ וְרַבּוּ פְשָׁעֶיךָ מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ ׃
lxx: εἰ ἥμαρτες, τί πράξεις εἰ δὲ καὶ πολλὰ ἠνόμησας, τί δύνασαι ποιῆσαι;
vulg: si peccaveris quid ei nocebis et si multiplicatae fuerint iniquitates tuae quid facies contra eum
clem: Si peccaveris, quid ei nocebis? et si multiplicat fuerint iniquitates tu, quid facies contra eum?
kjv: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

wlc: אִם־צָדַקְתָּ מַה־תִּתֶּן־לוֹ אוֹ מַה־מִיָּדְךָ יִקָּח ׃
lxx: ἐπεὶ δὲ οὖν δίκαιος εἶ, τί δώσεις αὐτῷ, ἢ τί ἐκ χειρός σου λήμψεταις
vulg: porro si iuste egeris quid donabis ei aut quid de manu tua accipiet
clem: Porro si juste egeris, quid donabis ei? aut quid de manu tua accipiet?
kjv: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?

wlc: לְאִישׁ־כָּמוֹךָ רִשְׁעֶךָ וּלְבֶן־אָדָם צִדְקָתֶךָ ׃
lxx: ἀνδρὶ τῷ ὁμοίῳ σου ἡ ἀσέβειά σου, καὶ υἱῷ ἀνθρώπου ἡ δικαιοσύνη σου.
vulg: homini qui similis tui est nocebit impietas tua et filium hominis adiuvabit iustitia tua
clem: Homini qui similis tui est, nocebit impietas tua: et filium hominis adjuvabit justitia tua.
kjv: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.

wlc: מֵרֹב עֲשׁוּקִים יַזְעִיקוּ יְשַׁוְּעוּ מִזְּרוֹעַ רַבִּים ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ πλήθους συκοφαντούμενοι κεκράξονται, βοήσονται ἀπὸ βραχίονος πολλῶν.
vulg: propter multitudinem calumniatorum clamabunt et heiulabunt propter vim brachii tyrannorum
clem: Propter multitudinem calumniatorum clamabunt, et ejulabunt propter vim brachii tyrannorum.
kjv: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

wlc: וְלֹא־אָמַר אַיֵּה אֱלוֹהַּ עֹשָׂי נֹתֵן זְמִרוֹת בַּלָּיְלָה ׃
lxx: καὶ οὐκ εἶπεν Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς ὁ ποιήσας με, ὁ κατατάσσαων φυλακὰς υυκτερινάς,
vulg: et non dixit ubi est Deus qui fecit me qui dedit carmina in nocte
clem: Et non dixit: Ubi est Deus qui fecit me, qui dedit carmina in nocte;
kjv: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;

wlc: מַלְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמוֹת אָרֶץ וּמֵעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם יְחַכְּמֵנוּ ׃
lxx: ὁ διορίζων με ἀπὸ τετραπόδων γῆς, ἀπὸ δὲ πετεινῶν οὐρανοῦ;
vulg: qui docet nos super iumenta terrae et super volucres caeli erudit nos
clem: qui docet nos super jumenta terr, et super volucres cli erudit nos?
kjv: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?

wlc: שָׁם יִצְעֲקוּ וְלֹא יַעֲנֶה מִפְּנֵי גְּאוֹן רָעִים ׃
lxx: ἐκεῖ κεκράξονται, καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσακούσῃ, καὶ ἀπὸ ὕβρεως πονηρῶν.
vulg: ibi clamabunt et non exaudiet propter superbiam malorum
clem: Ibi clamabunt, et non exaudiet, propter superbiam malorum.
kjv: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.

wlc: אַךְ־שָׁוְא לֹא־יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְשַׁדַּי לֹא יְשׁוּרֶנָּה ׃
lxx: ἄτοπα γὰρ οὐ βούλεται ὁ κύριος ἰδεῖναὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ παντοκράτωρ ὄρατής ἐστιν
vulg: non ergo frustra audiet Deus et Omnipotens singulorum causas intuebitur
clem: Non ergo frustra audiet Deus, et Omnipotens causas singulorum intuebitur.
kjv: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

wlc: אַף כִּי־תֹאמַר לֹא תְשׁוּרֶנּוּ דִּין לְפָנָיו וּתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ ׃
lxx: τῶν συντελούντων τὰ ἄνομα, καὶ σώσει με. κρίθητι δὲ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ, εἰ δύνασαι αἰνέσαι αὐτὸν ὡς ἔστιν.
vulg: etiam cum dixeris non considerat iudicare coram eo et expecta eum
clem: Etiam cum dixeris: Non considerat: judicare coram illo, et expecta eum.
kjv: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.

wlc: וְעַתָּה כִּי־אַיִן פָּקַד אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָדַע בַּפַּשׁ מְאֹד ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπισκεπτόμενος ὄργὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔγνω παράπτωμά τι
vulg: nunc enim non infert furorem suum nec ulciscitur scelus valde
clem: Nunc enim non infert furorem suum, nec ulciscitur scelus valde.
kjv: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:

wlc: וְאִיּוֹב הֶבֶל יִפְצֶה־פִּיהוּ בִּבְלִי־דַעַת מִלִּין יַכְבִּר ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ Ἰὼβ ματαίως ἀνοίγει τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ, ἐν ἀγνωσίᾳ ῥήματα βαρύνει.
vulg: ergo Iob frustra aperit os suum et absque scientia verba multiplicat
clem: Ergo Job frustra aperit os suum, et absque scientia verba multiplicat.]
kjv: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.

wlc: וַיֹּסֶף אֱלִיהוּא וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: Προσθεὶς δὲ Ἐλιοῦς ἔτι λέγει
vulg: addens quoque Heliu haec locutus est
clem: Addens quoque Eliu, hc locutus est:
kjv: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

wlc: כַּתַּר־לִי זְעֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּךָּ כִּי עוֹד לֶאֱלוֹהַּ מִלִּים ׃
lxx: Μεῖνόν με μικρὸν ἔτι ἵνα διδάξω σε· ἔτι γὰρ ἐν ἐμοί ἐστιν λέξις.
vulg: sustine me paululum et indicabo tibi adhuc enim habeo quod pro Deo loquar
clem: [Sustine me paululum, et indicabo tibi: adhuc enim habeo quod pro Deo loquar.
kjv: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.

wlc: אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי לְמֵרָחוֹק וְלְפֹעֲלִי אֶתֵּן־צֶדֶק ׃
lxx: ἀναλαβὼν τὴν ἐπιστήμην μου μακράν, ἔργοις δέ μου δίκαια ἐρῶ ἐπʼ ἀληθεἰς
vulg: repetam scientiam meam a principio et operatorem meum probabo iustum
clem: Repetam scientiam meam a principio, et operatorem meum probabo justum.
kjv: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

wlc: כִּי־אָמְנָם לֹא־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּי תְּמִים דֵּעוֹת עִמָּךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ οὐκ ἄδικα ῥήματα· ἀδίκως συνίεις.
vulg: vere enim absque mendacio sermones mei et perfecta scientia probabitur tibi
clem: Vere enim absque mendacio sermones mei, et perfecta scientia probabitur tibi.
kjv: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

wlc: הֶן־אֵל כַּבִּיר וְלֹא יִמְאָס כַּבִּיר כֹּחַ לֵב ׃
lxx: γίγνωσκε δὲ ὅτι ὁ κύριος οὐ μὴ ἀποποιήσηται τὸν ἄκακον, δυνατὸς ἰσχύι καρδίας
vulg: Deus potentes non abicit cum et ipse sit potens
clem: Deus potentes non abjicit, cum et ipse sit potens:
kjv: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

wlc: לֹא־יְחַיֶּה רָשָׁע וּמִשְׁפַּט עֲנִיִּים יִתֵּן ׃
lxx: ἀσεβῆ οὐ μὴ ζωοποιήσει, καὶ κρίμα πτωχῶν δώσει.
vulg: sed non salvat impios et iudicium pauperibus tribuit
clem: sed non salvat impios, et judicium pauperibus tribuit.
kjv: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.

wlc: לֹא־יִגְרַע מִצַּדִּיק עֵינָיו וְאֶת־מְלָכִים לַכִּסֵּא וַיֹּשִׁיבֵם לָנֶצַח וַיִּגְבָּהוּ ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἀφελεῖ ἀπὸ δικαἰου ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ μετὰ βασιλέων εἰς θρόνον καὶ καθιεῖ αὐτοὺς εἰς νῖκος, καὶ ὑψωθήσονται.
vulg: non aufert a iusto oculos suos et reges in solio conlocat in perpetuum et illi eriguntur
clem: Non auferet a justo oculos suos: et reges in solio collocat in perpetuum, et illi eriguntur.
kjv: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

wlc: וְאִם־אֲסוּרִים בַּזִּקִּים יִלָּכְדוּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹנִי ׃
lxx: καὶ οἱ πεπεδημένοι ἐν χειροπέδαις συσχεθήσονται ἐν σχοινίοις πενίας·
vulg: et si fuerint in catenis et vinciantur funibus paupertatis
clem: Et si fuerint in catenis, et vinciantur funibus paupertatis,
kjv: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

wlc: וַיַּגֵּד לָהֶם פָּעֳלָם וּפִשְׁעֵיהֶם כִּי יִתְגַּבָּרוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ αὐτοῖς τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ παραπτώματα αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἰσχύσουσιν.
vulg: indicabit eis opera eorum et scelera eorum quia violenti fuerint
clem: indicabit eis opera eorum, et scelera eorum, quia violenti fuerunt.
kjv: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

wlc: וַיִּגֶל אָזְנָם לַמּוּסָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־יְשֻׁבוּן מֵאָוֶן ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ τοῦ δικαίου εἰσακούσεται· καὶ εἶπεν ὅτι ἐπιστραφήσονται ἐξ ἀδικίας.
vulg: revelabit quoque aurem eorum ut corripiat et loquetur ut revertantur ab iniquitate
clem: Revelabit quoque aurem eorum, ut corripiat: et loquetur, ut revertantur ab iniquitate.
kjv: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

wlc: אִם־יִשְׁמְעוּ וְיַעֲבֹדוּ יְכַלּוּ יְמֵיהֶם בַּטּוֹב וּשְׁנֵיהֶם בַּנְּעִימִים ׃
lxx: ἐὰν ἀκούσωσιν καὶ δουλεύσωσιν, συντελέσουσιν τὰς ἡμέρας αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγαθοῖς, καὶ τὰ ἔτη αὐτῶν ἐν εὐπρεπείαις.
vulg: si audierint et observaverint conplebunt dies suos in bono et annos suos in gloria
clem: Si audierint et observaverint, complebunt dies suos in bono, et annos suos in gloria:
kjv: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

wlc: וְאִם־לֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁלַח יַעֲבֹרוּ וְיִגְוְעוּ כִּבְלִי־דָעַת ׃
lxx: ἀσεβεῖς δὲ οὐ διασώζει, παρὰ τὸ μὴ βούλεσθαι εἰδέναι αὐτοὺς τὸν κύριον, καὶ διότι νουθετούμενοι ἀνήκοοι ἦσαν.
vulg: si autem non audierint transibunt per gladium et consumentur in stultitia
clem: si autem non audierint, transibunt per gladium, et consumentur in stultitia.
kjv: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

wlc: וְחַנְפֵי־לֵב יָשִׂימוּ אָף לֹא יְשַׁוְּעוּ כִּי אֲסָרָם ׃
lxx: καὶ ὑποκριταὶ καρδίᾳ τάξουσιν θυμόν· οὐ βοήσονται, ὅτι ἔδησεν αὐτούς.
vulg: simulatores et callidi provocant iram Dei neque clamabunt cum vincti fuerint
clem: Simulatores et callidi provocant iram Dei, neque clamabunt cum vincti fuerint.
kjv: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

wlc: תָּמֹת בַּנֹּעַר נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם בַּקְּדֵשִׁים ׃
lxx: ἀποθάνοι τοίνυν ἐν νεότητι ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν, ἡ δὲ ζωὴ αὐτῶν τιτρωσκομένη ὑπὸ ἀγγέλων,
vulg: morietur in tempestate anima eorum et vita eorum inter effeminatos
clem: Morietur in tempestate anima eorum, et vita eorum inter effeminatos.
kjv: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

wlc: יְחַלֵּץ עָנִי בְעָנְיוֹ וְיִגֶל בַּלַּחַץ אָזְנָם ׃
lxx: ἀνθ᾿ ὧν ἔδλιψαν ἀσθενῆ καὶ ἀδύνατον· κρίμα δὲ πρᾳέων ἐκθήσει.
vulg: eripiet pauperem de angustia sua et revelabit in tribulatione aurem eius
clem: Eripiet de angustia sua pauperem, et revelabit in tribulatione aurem ejus.
kjv: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

wlc: וְאַף הֲסִיתְךָ מִפִּי־צָר רַחַב לֹא־מוּצָק תַּחְתֶּיהָ וְנַחַת שֻׁלְחָנְךָ מָלֵא דָשֶׁן ׃
lxx: καὶ προσεπιηπάτησέν σε ἐκ στόματος ἐχθροῦ ἄβυσσος, κατάχυσις ὑποκάτω αὐτῆς, καὶ κατέβη τράπεζά σου πλήρης πιότητος.
vulg: igitur salvabit te de ore angusto latissime et non habentis fundamentum subter se requies autem mensae tuae erit plena pinguedine
clem: Igitur salvabit te de ore angusto latissime, et non habente fundamentum subter se: requies autem mens tu erit plena pinguedine.
kjv: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

wlc: וְדִין־רָשָׁע מָלֵאתָ דִּין וּמִשְׁפָּט יִתְמֹכוּ ׃
lxx: οὐχ ὑστερήσει δὲ ἀπὸ δικαίων κρίμα.
vulg: causa tua quasi impii iudicata est causam iudiciumque recipies
clem: Causa tua quasi impii judicata est: causam judiciumque recipies.
kjv: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.

wlc: כִּי־חֵמָה פֶּן־יְסִיתְךָ בְסָפֶק וְרָב־כֹּפֶר אַל־יַטֶּךָּ ׃
lxx: θυμὸς δὲ ἐπʼ ἀσεβεῖς ἔσται, δι ἀσέβειαν δώρων ὧν ἐδέχοντο ἐπʼ ἀδικίαις.
vulg: non te ergo superet ira ut aliquem opprimas nec multitudo donorum inclinet te
clem: Non te ergo superet ira ut aliquem opprimas: nec multitudo donorum inclinet te.
kjv: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

wlc: הֲיַעֲרֹךְ שׁוּעֲךָ לֹא בְצָר וְכֹל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹחַ ׃
lxx: μή σε ἐκκλινάτω ἑκὼν ὁ νοῦς δεήσεως ἐν ἀνάγκῃ ὄνταων ἀδυνάτων, καὶ πάντας τοὺς κραταιοῦντας ἰσχύν.
vulg: depone magnitudinem tuam absque tribulatione et omnes robustos fortitudine
clem: Depone magnitudinem tuam absque tribulatione, et omnes robustos fortitudine.
kjv: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

wlc: אַל־תִּשְׁאַף הַלָּיְלָה לַעֲלוֹת עַמִּים תַּחְתָּם ׃
lxx: μὴ ἐξελκύσῃς τὴν νύκτα, τοῦ ἀναβῆναι λαοὺς ἀντʼ αὐτῶν·
vulg: ne protrahas noctem ut ascendant populi pro eis
clem: Ne protrahas noctem, ut ascendant populi pro eis.
kjv: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

wlc: הִשָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּפֶן אֶל־אָוֶן כִּי־עַל־זֶה בָּחַרְתָּ מֵעֹנִי ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ φύλαξαι μὴ πράξῃς ἄδικα· ἐπὶ τοῦτον γὰρ ἐξείλω ἀπὸ πτωχείας.
vulg: cave ne declines ad iniquitatem hanc enim coepisti sequi post miseriam
clem: Cave ne declines ad iniquitatem: hanc enim cpisti sequi post miseriam.
kjv: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

wlc: הֶן־אֵל יַשְׂגִּיב בְּכֹחוֹ מִי כָמֹהוּ מוֹרֶה ׃
lxx: δοῦ ὁ ἰσχυρὸς κραταιώσει ἐν ἰσχύι αὐτοῦ· τίς γάρ ἐστιν κατʼ αὐτὸν δυνάστης;
vulg: ecce Deus excelsus in fortitudine sua et nullus ei similis in legislatoribus
clem: Ecce Deus excelsus in fortitudine sua, et nullus ei similis in legislatoribus.
kjv: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

wlc: מִי־פָקַד עָלָיו דַּרְכּוֹ וּמִי־אָמַר פָּעַלְתָּ עַוְלָה ׃
lxx: τἰε δέ ἐστιν ὁ ἐτάζων αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργας ἡ τίς ὁ εἴπας Ἔπραξεν ἄδικα;
vulg: quis poterit scrutari vias eius aut quis ei dicere operatus es iniquitatem
clem: Quis poterit scrutari vias ejus? aut quis potest ei dicere: Operatus es iniquitatem?
kjv: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

wlc: זְכֹר כִּי־תַשְׂגִּיא פָעֳלוֹ אֲשֶׁר שֹׁרְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים ׃
lxx: μνήσθητι ὅτι μεγάλα ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ὧν ρξαν ἄνδρες·
vulg: memento quod ignores opus eius de quo cecinerunt viri
clem: Memento quod ignores opus ejus, de quo cecinerunt viri.
kjv: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

wlc: כָּל־אָדָם חָזוּ־בוֹ אֱנוֹשׁ יַבִּיט מֵרָחוֹק ׃
lxx: πᾶς ἄνθρωπος εἶδεν ἐν ἑαυτῷ, ὅσοι τιτρωσκόμενοί εἰσιν βροτοί.
vulg: omnes homines vident eum unusquisque intuetur procul
clem: Omnes homines vident eum: unusquisque intuetur procul.
kjv: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

wlc: הֶן־אֵל שַׂגִּיא וְלֹא נֵדָע מִסְפַּר שָׁנָיו וְלֹא־חֵקֶר ׃
lxx: δοῦ ὁ ἰσχυρὸς πολύς, καὶ οὐ γνωσόμεθαἀριθμὸς ἐτῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέραντος.
vulg: ecce Deus magnus vincens scientiam nostram numerus annorum eius inaestimabilis
clem: Ecce Deus magnus vincens scientiam nostram: numerus annorum ejus instimabilis.
kjv: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

wlc: כִּי יְגָרַע נִטְפֵי־מָיִם יָזֹקּוּ מָטָר לְאֵדוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀριθμηταὶ δὲ αὐτῷ σταγόνες ὑετοῦ, καὶ ἐπιχυθήσονται ὑετῷ εἰς νεφέλην·
vulg: qui aufert stillas pluviae et effundit imbres ad instar gurgitum
clem: Qui aufert stillas pluvi, et effundit imbres ad instar gurgitum,
kjv: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־יִזְּלוּ שְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ עֲלֵי אָדָם רָב ׃
lxx: ὄυήσονται παλαιώματα, ἐσκίασεν δὲ νέφη ἐπὶ ἀμυθήτῳ βροτῷ.
vulg: qui de nubibus fluunt quae praetexunt cuncta desuper
clem: qui de nubibus fluunt qu prtexunt cuncta desuper.
kjv: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

wlc: אַף אִם־יָבִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָב תְּשֻׁאוֹת סֻכָּתוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐὰν συνῇ ἀπεκτάσεις νεφέλης, ἰσότητα σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ,
vulg: si voluerit extendere nubes quasi tentorium suum
clem: Si voluerit extendere nubes quasi tentorium suum,
kjv: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

wlc: הֵן־פָּרַשׂ עָלָיו אוֹרוֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁי הַיָּם כִּסָּה ׃
lxx: ἰδοὸ ἐκτενεῖ ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἡ ᾠδή, καὶ ῥιζώματα τῆς θαλάσσης ἐκάλυψεν.
vulg: et fulgurare lumine suo desuper cardines quoque maris operiet
clem: et fulgurare lumine suo desuper, cardines quoque maris operiet.
kjv: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

wlc: כִּי־בָם יָדִין עַמִּים יִתֶּן־אֹכֶל לְמַכְבִּיר ׃
lxx: ἐν γὰρ αὐτοῖς κρινεῖ λαούς, δώσει τροφὴν τῷ ἀκούοντι.
vulg: per haec enim iudicat populos et dat escas multis mortalibus
clem: Per hc enim judicat populos, et dat escas multis mortalibus.
kjv: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

wlc: עַל־כַּפַּיִם כִּסָּה־אוֹר וַיְצַו עָלֶיהָ בְמַפְגִּיעַ ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἐκάλυψεν φῶς, καὶ ἐνετείλατο περὶ αὐτῆς ἐν ἀπαντῶντι·
vulg: in manibus abscondit lucem et praecipit ei ut rursus adveniat
clem: In manibus abscondit lucem, et prcepit ei ut rursus adveniat.
kjv: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

wlc: יַגִּיד עָלָיו רֵעוֹ מִקְנֶה אַף עַל־עוֹלֶה ׃
lxx: ἀναγγελεῖ περὶ αὐτοῦ φίλον αὐτοῦ· Κύριος κτῆσις καὶ περὶ ἀδικίας.
vulg: adnuntiat de ea amico suo quod possessio eius sit et ad eam possit ascendere
clem: Annuntiat de ea amico suo, quod possessio ejus sit, et ad eam possit ascendere.]
kjv: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.

wlc: אַף־לְזֹאת יֶחֱרַד לִבִּי וְיִתַּר מִמְּקוֹמוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ταύτης ἐταράχθη ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἀπερρύη ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῆς.
vulg: super hoc expavit cor meum et emotum est de loco suo
clem: [Super hoc expavit cor meum, et emotum est de loco suo.
kjv: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.

wlc: שִׁמְעוּ שָׁמוֹעַ בְּרֹגֶז קֹלוֹ וְהֶגֶה מִפִּיו יֵצֵא ׃
lxx: ἄκουε ἀκοὴν ἐν ὀργῇ θυμοῦ Κυρίου. καὶ μελέτη ἐκ στόματος αὐτοῦ ἐξελεύσεται.
vulg: audite auditionem in terrore vocis eius et sonum de ore illius procedentem
clem: Audite auditionem in terrore vocis ejus, et sonum de ore illius procedentem.
kjv: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

wlc: תַּחַת־כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁרֵהוּ וְאוֹרוֹ עַל־כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ὑποκάτω παντὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀρχὴ αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ φῶς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πτερύγων τῆς γῆς.
vulg: subter omnes caelos ipse considerat et lumen illius super terminos terrae
clem: Subter omnes clos ipse considerat, et lumen illius super terminos terr.
kjv: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

wlc: אַחֲרָיו יִשְׁאַג־קוֹל יַרְעֵם בְּקוֹל גְּאוֹנוֹ וְלֹא יְעַקְּבֵם כִּי־יִשָּׁמַע קוֹלוֹ ׃
lxx: ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ βοήσεται φωνῇ. βροντήσει ἐν φωνῇ ὕβρεως αὐτοῦ· καὶ οὐκ ἀνταλλάξει αὐτούς, ὅτι ἀκούσῃ φωνὴν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: post eum rugiet sonitus tonabit voce magnitudinis suae et non investigabitur cum audita fuerit vox eius
clem: Post eum rugiet sonitus; tonabit voce magnitudinis su: et non investigabitur, cum audita fuerit vox ejus.
kjv: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

wlc: יַרְעֵם אֵל בְּקוֹלוֹ נִפְלָאוֹת עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת וְלֹא נֵדָע ׃
lxx: βροντήσει ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ἐν φωνῇ αὐτοῦ θαυμάσια, ἐποἰησεν γὰρ μεγάλα ἃ οὐκ ἤδειμεν·
vulg: tonabit Deus in voce sua mirabiliter qui facit magna et inscrutabilia
clem: Tonabit Deus in voce sua mirabiliter, qui facit magna et inscrutabilia;
kjv: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

wlc: כִּי לַשֶּׁלַג יֹאמַר הֱוֵא אָרֶץ וְגֶשֶׁם מָטָר וְגֶשֶׁם מִטְרוֹת עֻזּוֹ ׃
lxx: συντάσσων χιόνι Γἰνου ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς. καὶ χειμὼν ὑετός, καὶ χειμὼν ὑετῶν δυναστείας αὐτοῦ.
vulg: qui praecipit nivi ut descendat in terram et hiemis pluviis et imbri fortitudinis suae
clem: qui prcipit nivi ut descendat in terram, et hiemis pluviis, et imbri fortitudinis su;
kjv: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

wlc: בְּיַד־כָּל־אָדָם יַחְתּוֹם לָדַעַת כָּל־אַנְשֵׁי מַעֲשֵׂהוּ ׃
lxx: ἐν χειρὶ παντὸς ἀνθρώπου κατασφραγίζει, ἴνα γνῷ πᾶς ἄνθρωπος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀσθένειαν.
vulg: qui in manu omnium hominum signat ut noverint singuli opera sua
clem: qui in manu omnium hominum signat, ut noverint singuli opera sua.
kjv: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

wlc: וַתָּבֹא חַיָּה בְמוֹ־אָרֶב וּבִמְעוֹנֹתֶיהָ תִשְׁכֹּן ׃
lxx: εοῆλθεν δὲ θηρία ὑπὸ σκέπην. ἡσύχασαν δὲ ἐπὶ κοίτης.
vulg: ingredietur bestia latibulum et in antro suo morabitur
clem: Ingredietur bestia latibulum, et in antro suo morabitur.
kjv: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

wlc: מִן־הַחֶדֶר תָּבוֹא סוּפָה וּמִמְּזָרִים קָרָה ׃
lxx: ἐκ ταμείων ἐπέρχονται ὀδύναι, ἀπὸ δὲ ἀκρωτηρίων ψῦχος.
vulg: ab interioribus egreditur tempestas et ab Arcturo frigus
clem: Ab interioribus egredietur tempestas, et ab Arcturo frigus.
kjv: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.

wlc: מִנִּשְׁמַת־אֵל יִתֶּן־קָרַח וְרֹחַב מַיִם בְּמוּצָק ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ πνοῆς Ἰσχυροῦ δώσει πάγος, οἰακίζει δὲ τὸ ὕδωρ ὡς ἐὰν βούληται·
vulg: flante Deo concrescit gelu et rursum latissimae funduntur aquae
clem: Flante Deo, concrescit gelu, et rursum latissim funduntur aqu.
kjv: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

wlc: אַף־בְּרִי יַטְרִיחַ עָב יָפִיץ עֲנַן אוֹרוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐκλεκτὸν καταπλάσσει νεφέλη. διασκορπιεῖ νέφος φῶς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: frumentum desiderat nubes et nubes spargunt lumen suum
clem: Frumentum desiderat nubes, et nubes spargunt lumen suum.
kjv: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:

wlc: וְהוּא מְסִבּוֹת מִתְהַפֵּךְ בְּתַחְבּוּלָתוֹ לְפָעֳלָם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֵּם עַל־פְּנֵי תֵבֵל אָרְצָה ׃
lxx: καὶ αὐτὸς κυλκώματα διαστρέψει, ἐν θεεβουλαθὼθ εἰς ἔργα αὐτῶν· πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἐντείληται αὐτοῖς, ταῦτα συντέτακται παρʼ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς,
vulg: quae lustrant per circuitum quocumque eas voluntas gubernantis duxerit ad omne quod praeceperit illis super faciem orbis terrarum
clem: Qu lustrant per circuitum, quocumque eas voluntas gubernantis duxerit, ad omne quod prceperit illis super faciem orbis terrarum:
kjv: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.

wlc: אִם־לְשֵׁבֶט אִם־לְאַרְצוֹ אִם־לְחֶסֶד יַמְצִאֵהוּ ׃
lxx: ἐάν εἰς παιδείαν, ἐὰν εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ, ἐὰν εἰς ἔλεος εὑρήσει αὐτόν.
vulg: sive in una tribu sive in terra sua sive in quocumque loco misericordiae suae eas iusserit inveniri
clem: sive in una tribu, sive in terra sua, sive in quocumque loco misericordi su eas jusserit inveniri.
kjv: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.

wlc: הַאֲזִינָה זֹּאת אִיּוֹב עֲמֹד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵן נִפְלְאוֹת אֵל ׃
lxx: ἐνωτίζου ταῦτα, Ἰὼβ· στῆθι, νουθετούμενος δύναμιν Κυρίου.
vulg: ausculta haec Iob sta et considera miracula Dei
clem: Ausculta hc, Job: sta, et considera mirabilia Dei.
kjv: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

wlc: הֲתֵדַע בְּשׂוּם־אֱלוֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶם וְהוֹפִיעַ אוֹר עֲנָנוֹ ׃
lxx: οἴδαμεν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἔθετο ἔργα αὐτοῦ, φῶς ποιήσας ἐκ σκότους.
vulg: numquid scis quando praeceperit Deus pluviis ut ostenderent lucem nubium eius
clem: Numquid scis quando prceperit Deus pluviis, ut ostenderent lucem nubium ejus?
kjv: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

wlc: הֲתֵדַע עַל־מִפְלְשֵׂי־עָב מִפְלְאוֹת תְּמִים דֵּעִים ׃
lxx: ἐπίσταται δὲ διάκρισιν νεφῶν, ἐξαίσια δὲ πτώματα πονηρῶν.
vulg: numquid nosti semitas nubium magnas et perfectas scientias
clem: Numquid nosti semitas nubium magnas, et perfectas scientias?
kjv: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־בְּגָדֶיךָ חַמִּים בְּהַשְׁקִט אֶרֶץ מִדָּרוֹם ׃
lxx: σοῦ δὲ ἡ στολὴ θερμή· ἡσυχάζεται δὲ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
vulg: nonne vestimenta tua calida sunt cum perflata fuerit terra austro
clem: Nonne vestimenta tua calida sunt, cum perflata fuerit terra austro?
kjv: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

wlc: תַּרְקִיעַ עִמּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִים חֲזָקִים כִּרְאִי מוּצָק ׃
lxx: στερεώσεις μετʼ αὐτοῦ εἰς παλαιώματα, ἰσχυραὶ ὡς ὅρασις ἐπιχύσεως.
vulg: tu forsitan cum eo fabricatus es caelos qui solidissimi quasi aere fusi sunt
clem: Tu forsitan cum eo fabricatus es clos, qui solidissimi quasi re fusi sunt.
kjv: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

wlc: הוֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה־נֹּאמַר לוֹ לֹא־נַעֲרֹךְ מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ ׃
lxx: διὰ τἰ δἰδαξόν με, τί ἐροῦμεν αὐτῷ· καὶ παυσώμεθα πολλὰ λέγοντες.
vulg: ostende nobis quid dicamus illi nos quippe involvimur tenebris
clem: Ostende nobis quid dicamus illi: nos quippe involvimur tenebris.
kjv: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

wlc: הַיְסֻפַּר־לוֹ כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אִם־אָמַר אִישׁ כִּי יְבֻלָּע ׃
lxx: μὴ βίβλος ἢ γραμματεύς μοι παρέστηκεν, ἴνα ἄνθρωπον ἑστηκὼς κατασιωπήσω;
vulg: quis narrabit ei quae loquor etiam si locutus fuerit homo devorabitur
clem: Quis narrabit ei qu loquor? etiam si locutus fuerit homo, devorabitur.
kjv: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

wlc: וְעַתָּה לֹא רָאוּ אוֹר בָּהִיר הוּא בַּשְּׁחָקִים וְרוּחַ עָבְרָה וַתְּטַהֲרֵם ׃
lxx: πᾶσιν δʼ οὐχ ὁρατὸν τὸ φῶς, τηλαυγές ἐστιν ἐν τοῖς παλαιώμασιν, ὥσπερ τὸ παρʼ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ νεφῶν.
vulg: at nunc non vident lucem subito aer cogitur in nubes et ventus transiens fugabit eas
clem: At nunc non vident lucem: subito ar cogetur in nubes, et ventus transiens fugabit eas.
kjv: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

wlc: מִצָּפוֹן זָהָב יֶאֱתֶה עַל־אֱלוֹהַּ נוֹרָא הוֹד ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ βορρᾶ νέφη χρυσαυγοῦντα· ἐπὶ τούτοις μεγάλη ἡ δόξα καὶ τιμὴ Παντοκράτορος.
vulg: ab aquilone aurum venit et ad Deum formidolosa laudatio
clem: Ab aquilone aurum venit, et ad Deum formidolosa laudatio.
kjv: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.

wlc: שַׁדַּי לֹא־מְצָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא־כֹחַ וּמִשְׁפָּט וְרֹב־צְדָקָה לֹא יְעַנֶּה ׃
lxx: καὶ οὐχ εὑρίσκομεν ἄλλον ὅμοιον τῇ ἰσχύι αὐτοῦ· ὁ τὰ δίκαια κρίνων, οὐκ οἴει ἐπακούειν αὐτόν;
vulg: digne eum invenire non possumus magnus fortitudine et iudicio et iustitia et enarrari non potest
clem: Digne eum invenire non possumus: magnus fortitudine, et judicio, et justitia: et enarrari non potest.
kjv: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

wlc: לָכֵן יְרֵאוּהוּ אֲנָשִׁים לֹא־יִרְאֶה כָּל־חַכְמֵי־לֵב ׃ פ
lxx: διὸ φοβηθήσονται αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνθρωπο. φοβηθήσονται δὲ αὐτὸν καὶ οἱ σοφοί καρδίᾳ.
vulg: ideo timebunt eum viri et non audebunt contemplari omnes qui sibi videntur esse sapientes
clem: Ideo timebunt eum viri, et non audebunt contemplari omnes qui sibi videntur esse sapientes.]
kjv: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.

wlc: וַיַּעַן־יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב מִנ *הַסְּעָרָה וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: Μετὰ δὲ τὸ παύσασθαι Ἐλιοῦν τῆς λέξεως εἶπεν ὁ κύριος τῷ Ἰὼβ διὰ λαἰλαπος καὶ νεφῶν
vulg: respondens autem Dominus Iob de turbine dixit
clem: Respondens autem Dominus Job de turbine, dixit:
kjv: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

wlc: מִי זֶה מַחְשִׁיךְ עֵצָה בְמִלִּין בְּלִי־דָעַת ׃
lxx: Τἰς οὗτος ὁ κρύπτων με βουλήν, συνέχων δὲ ῥήματα ἐν καρδία, ἐμὲ δὲ οἴεται κρύπτειν;
vulg: quis est iste involvens sententias sermonibus inperitis
clem: [Quis est iste involvens sententias sermonibus imperitis?
kjv: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

wlc: אֱזָר־נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ וְאֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי ׃
lxx: ζῶσαι ὥσπερ ἀνὴρ τὴν ὀσφύν σου. ἐρωτήσω δέ, σὺ δέ μοι ἀποκρίθητι.
vulg: accinge sicut vir lumbos tuos interrogabo te et responde mihi
clem: Accinge sicut vir lumbos tuos: interrogabo te, et responde mihi.
kjv: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.

wlc: אֵיפֹה הָיִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי־אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם־יָדַעְתָּ בִינָה ׃
lxx: ποῦ ἧς ἐν τῷ θεμελιοῦν με τὴν γῆν; ἀπάγγειλον δέ μοι, εἰ ἐπίστῃ σύνεσιν.
vulg: ubi eras quando ponebam fundamenta terrae indica mihi si habes intellegentiam
clem: Ubi eras quando ponebam fundamenta terr? indica mihi, si habes intelligentiam.
kjv: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

wlc: מִי־שָׂם מְמַדֶּיהָ כִּי תֵדָע אוֹ מִי־נָטָה עָלֶיהָ קָּו ׃
lxx: τις ἔθτο τὰ μέτρα αὐτῆς, εἰ οἶδας; ἢ τίς ὁ ἐπαγαγὼν σπαρτίον ἐπʼ αὐτῆς;
vulg: quis posuit mensuras eius si nosti vel quis tetendit super eam lineam
clem: Quis posuit mensuras ejus, si nosti? vel quis tetendit super eam lineam?
kjv: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?

wlc: עַל־מָה אֲדָנֶיהָ הָטְבָּעוּ אוֹ מִי־יָרָה אֶבֶן פִּנָּתָהּ ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ τίος οἱ κρίκοι αὐτῆς πεπήγασινς τἰς δέ ἐστιν ὁ βαλὼν λίθον γωνιαῖον ἐπʼ αὐτῆς;
vulg: super quo bases illius solidatae sunt aut quis dimisit lapidem angularem eius
clem: Super quo bases illius solidat sunt? aut quis demisit lapidem angularem ejus,
kjv: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

wlc: בְּרָן־יַחַד כּוֹכְבֵי בֹקֶר וַיָּרִיעוּ כָּל־בְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים ׃
lxx: ὅτε ἐγενήθησαν ἄστρα, ᾔνεσάν με φωνῇ μεγάλῃ πάντες ἄγγελοί μου.
vulg: cum me laudarent simul astra matutina et iubilarent omnes filii Dei
clem: cum me laudarent simul astra matutina, et jubilarent omnes filii Dei?
kjv: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

wlc: וַיָּסֶךְ בִּדְלָתַיִם יָם בְּגִיחוֹ מֵרֶחֶם יֵצֵא ׃
lxx: ἔφραξα δὲ θάλασσαν πύλαις, ὅτε ἐμαίμασσεν ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτὴ ἐκπορευομένη·
vulg: quis conclusit ostiis mare quando erumpebat quasi de vulva procedens
clem: Quis conclusit ostiis mare, quando erumpebat quasi de vulva procedens;
kjv: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

wlc: בְּשׂוּמִי עָנָן לְבֻשׁוֹ וַעֲרָפֶל חֲתֻלָּתוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐθέμην δὲ αὐτῇ νέφος ἀμφἰασιν. ὁμἰχλῃ δὲ αὐτὴν ἐσπαργάνωσα·
vulg: cum ponerem nubem vestimentum eius et caligine illud quasi pannis infantiae obvolverem
clem: cum ponerem nubem vestimentum ejus, et caligine illud quasi pannis infanti obvolverem?
kjv: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

wlc: וָאֶשְׁבֹּר עָלָיו חֻקִּי וָאָשִׂים בְּרִיחַ וּדְלָתָיִם ׃
lxx: ἐθέμην δὲ αὐτῇ ὅρια, περιθεὶς κλεῖθρα καὶ πύλας·
vulg: circumdedi illud terminis meis et posui vectem et ostia
clem: Circumdedi illud terminis meis, et posui vectem et ostia,
kjv: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,

wlc: וָאֹמַר עַד־פֹּה תָבוֹא וְלֹא תֹסִיף וּפֹא־יָשִׁית בִּגְאוֹן גַּלֶּיךָ ׃
lxx: εἶπα δὲ αὐτῇ Μέχρι τούτου ἐλεύσῃ, καὶ οὐχ ὑπερβήσῃ, ἀλλ ἐν σεαυτῇ συντριβήσεταί σου τὰ κύματα.
vulg: et dixi usque huc venies et non procedes amplius et hic confringes tumentes fluctus tuos
clem: et dixi: Usque huc venies, et non procedes amplius, et hic confringes tumentes fluctus tuos.
kjv: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

wlc: הְמִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּיתָ בֹּקֶר יִדַּעְתָּהַ שַּׁחַר מְקֹמוֹ ׃
lxx: ἡ ἐπὶ σοῦ συντέταχα φέγγος πρωινόν, ἑωσφόρος δὲ ἴδεν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ τάξιν,
vulg: numquid post ortum tuum praecepisti diluculo et ostendisti aurorae locum suum
clem: Numquid post ortum tuum prcepisti diluculo, et ostendisti auror locum suum?
kjv: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

wlc: לֶאֱחֹז בְּכַנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ וְיִנָּעֲרוּ רְשָׁעִים מִמֶּנָּה ׃
lxx: ἐπύλαβέσθαι πτερύγων γῆς, ἐκτινάξαι ἀσεβεῖς ἐξ αὐτῆς
vulg: et tenuisti concutiens extrema terrae et excussisti impios ex ea
clem: Et tenuisti concutiens extrema terr, et excussisti impios ex ea?
kjv: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

wlc: תִּתְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹמֶר חוֹתָם וְיִתְיַצְּבוּ כְּמוֹ לְבוּשׁ ׃
lxx: ἢ σὺ λαβὼν γῆν πηλὸν ἔπλασας ζῶον, καὶ λαλητὸν αὐτὸν ἔθου ἐπὶ γῆς;
vulg: restituetur ut lutum signaculum et stabit sicut vestimentum
clem: Restituetur ut lutum signaculum, et stabit sicut vestimentum:
kjv: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

wlc: וְיִמָּנַע מֵרְשָׁעִים אוֹרָם וּזְרוֹעַ רָמָה תִּשָּׁבֵר ׃
lxx: ἀφεῖλας δὲ ἀπὸ ἀσεβῶν τὸ φῶς, βραχίονα δὲ ὑπερηφάνων συνέτριψας;
vulg: auferetur ab impiis lux sua et brachium excelsum confringetur
clem: auferetur ab impiis lux sua, et brachium excelsum confringetur.
kjv: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

wlc: הֲבָאתָ עַד־נִבְכֵי־יָם וּבְחֵקֶר תְּהוֹם הִתְהַלָּכְתָּ ׃
lxx: ᾖλθες δὲ ἐπὶ πηγὴν θαλάσσης, ἐν δὲ ἵχνεσιν ἀβύσσου περιεπάτησας
vulg: numquid ingressus es profunda maris et in novissimis abyssis deambulasti
clem: Numquid ingressus es profunda maris, et in novissimis abyssi deambulasti?
kjv: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

wlc: הֲנִגְלוּ לְךָ שַׁעֲרֵי־מָוֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵי צַלְמָוֶת תִּרְאֶה ׃
lxx: ἀνοἰγονται δέ σοι φόβῳ πύλαι θανάτου, πυλωροὶ δὲ ἄδου ἰδόντες σε ἔπτηξαν;
vulg: numquid apertae tibi sunt portae mortis et ostia tenebrosa vidisti
clem: Numquid apert sunt tibi port mortis, et ostia tenebrosa vidisti?
kjv: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

wlc: הִתְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד־רַחֲבֵי־אָרֶץ הַגֵּד אִם־יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּהּ ׃
lxx: νενουθέτησαι δὲ τὸ εὖρος τῆς ὑπʼ οὐρανόν; ἀνάγγειλον δή μοι πόση τίς ἐστιν.
vulg: numquid considerasti latitudines terrae indica mihi si nosti omnia
clem: Numquid considerasti latitudinem terr? indica mihi, si nosti, omnia:
kjv: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.

wlc: אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן־אוֹר וְחֹשֶׁךְ אֵי־זֶה מְקֹמוֹ ׃
lxx: ποἰᾳ δὲ γῆ αὐλἰζεται τὸ φῶς, σκότους δὲ ποῖος ὁ τόπος;
vulg: in qua via habitet lux et tenebrarum quis locus sit
clem: in qua via lux habitet, et tenebrarum quis locus sit:
kjv: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

wlc: כִּי תִקָּחֶנּוּ אֶל־גְּבוּלוֹ וְכִי־תָבִין נְתִיבוֹת בֵּיתוֹ ׃
lxx: εἰ ἀγάγοις με εἰς ὄρια αὐτῶν; εἰ δὲ καὶ ἐπίστασαι τρίβους αὐτῶν
vulg: ut ducas unumquodque ad terminos suos et intellegas semitas domus eius
clem: ut ducas unumquodque ad terminos suos, et intelligas semitas domus ejus.
kjv: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

wlc: יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־אָז תִּוָּלֵד וּמִסְפַּר יָמֶיךָ רַבִּים ׃
lxx: οἶδα ἄρα ὅτι τότε γεγέννησαι, ἀριθμὸς δὲ ἐτῶν σου πολύς.
vulg: sciebas tunc quod nasciturus esses et numerum dierum tuorum noveras
clem: Sciebas tunc quod nasciturus esses, et numerum dierum tuorum noveras?
kjv: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?

wlc: הֲבָאתָ אֶל־אֹצְרוֹת שָׁלֶג וְאֹצְרוֹת בָּרָד תִּרְאֶה ׃
lxx: ἦλθες δὲ ἐπὶ θησαυροὺς χιόνος, θησαυροὺς δὲ χαλάζης ἑόρακας;
vulg: numquid ingressus es thesauros nivis aut thesauros grandinis aspexisti
clem: Numquid ingressus es thesauros nivis, aut thesauros grandinis aspexisti,
kjv: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־חָשַׂכְתִּי לְעֶת־צָר לְיוֹם קְרָב וּמִלְחָמָה ׃
lxx: ἀπόκειται δέ σοι εἰς ὥραν ἐχθρῶν, εἰς ἡμέραν πολέμων καὶ μάχης;
vulg: quae praeparavi in tempus hostis in diem pugnae et belli
clem: qu prparavi in tempus hostis, in diem pugn et belli?
kjv: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

wlc: אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ יֵחָלֶק אוֹר יָפֵץ קָדִים עֲלֵי־אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: πόθεν δὲ ἐκπορεύεται πάχνη, ἢ διασκεδάννυται νότος εἰς τὴν ὑπʼ οὐρανόν;
vulg: per quam viam spargitur lux dividitur aestus super terram
clem: Per quam viam spargitur lux, dividitur stus super terram?
kjv: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

wlc: מִי־פִלַּג לַשֶּׁטֶף תְּעָלָה וְדֶרֶךְ לַחֲזִיז קֹלוֹת ׃
lxx: τἰς δὲ ἡτοἴμασεν ὑετῷ λάβρῳ ῥύσιν, ὁδὸν δὲ κυδοιμῶν,
vulg: quis dedit vehementissimo imbri cursum et viam sonantis tonitrui
clem: Quis dedit vehementissimo imbri cursum, et viam sonantis tonitrui,
kjv: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

wlc: לְהַמְטִיר עַל־אֶרֶץ לֹא־אִישׁ מִדְבָּר לֹא־אָדָם בּוֹ ׃
lxx: τοῦ ὑετίσαι ἐπὶ γῆν οὗ οὐκ ἀνήρ, ἔρημον οὗ οὐχ ὑπάρχει ἄνθρωπος ἐν αὐτῇ,
vulg: ut plueret super terram absque homine in deserto ubi nullus mortalium commoratur
clem: ut plueret super terram absque homine in deserto, ubi nullus mortalium commoratur;
kjv: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

wlc: לְהַשְׂבִּיעַ שֹׁאָה וּמְשֹׁאָה וּלְהַצְמִיחַ מֹצָא דֶשֶׁא ׃
lxx: τοῦ χορτάσαι ἄβατον καὶ ἀοίκητον, καὶ τοῦ ἐκβλαστῆσαι ἔξοδον χλόης;
vulg: ut impleret inviam et desolatam et produceret herbas virentes
clem: ut impleret inviam et desolatam, et produceret herbas virentes?
kjv: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

wlc: הֲיֵשׁ־לַמָּטָר אָב אוֹ מִי־הוֹלִיד אֶגְלֵי־טָל ׃
lxx: τἰς ἐστιν ὑετοῦ πατήρ; τίς δέ ἐστιν ὁ τετοκὼς βώλους δρόσου;
vulg: quis est pluviae pater vel quis genuit stillas roris
clem: Quis est pluvi pater? vel quis genuit stillas roris?
kjv: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

wlc: מִבֶּטֶן מִי יָצָא הַקָּרַח וּכְפֹר שָׁמַיִם מִי יְלָדוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐκ γαστρὸς δὲ τίνος ἐκπορεύεται ὁ κρύσταλλος; πάχνην δὲ ἐν οὐρανῷ τίς τέτοκεν
vulg: de cuius utero egressa est glacies et gelu de caelo quis genuit
clem: De cujus utero egressa est glacies? et gelu de clo quis genuit?
kjv: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

wlc: כָּאֶבֶן מַיִם יִתְחַבָּאוּ וּפְנֵי תְהוֹם יִתְלַכָּדוּ ׃
lxx: ἢ καταβαίνει ὥσπερ ὕδωρ ῥέον; πρόσωπον δὲ ἀσεβοῦς τἰς ἔπτηξεν;
vulg: in similitudinem lapidis aquae durantur et superficies abyssi constringitur
clem: In similitudinem lapidis aqu durantur, et superficies abyssi constringitur.
kjv: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

wlc: הַתְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּוֹת כִּימָה אוֹ־מֹשְׁכוֹת כְּסִיל תְּפַתֵּחַ ׃
lxx: συνῆκας δὲ δεσμὸν Πλειάδος, καὶ φραγμὸν Ὠρἰωνος ἤνοιξας
vulg: numquid coniungere valebis micantes stellas Pliadis aut gyrum Arcturi poteris dissipare
clem: Numquid conjungere valebis micantes stellas Pleiadas, aut gyrum Arcturi poteris dissipare?
kjv: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

wlc: הֲתֹצִיא מַזָּרוֹת בְּעִתּוֹ וְעַיִשׁ עַל־בָּנֶיהָ תַנְחֵם ׃
lxx: ἢ διανοίξεις Μαζουρὼθ ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ἕσπερον ἐπὶ κόμης αὐτοῦ, ἄξεις αὐτά
vulg: numquid producis luciferum in tempore suo et vesperum super filios terrae consurgere facis
clem: Numquid producis luciferum in tempore suo, et vesperum super filios terr consurgere facis?
kjv: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?

wlc: הֲיָדַעְתָּ חֻקּוֹת שָׁמָיִם אִם־תָּשִׂים מִשְׁטָרוֹ בָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ἐπίστασαι δὲ τροπὰς οὐρανοῦ ἢ τὰ ὑπʼ οὐρανὸν ὁμοθυμαδὸν γινόμενα;
vulg: numquid nosti ordinem caeli et pones rationem eius in terra
clem: Numquid nosti ordinem cli, et pones rationem ejus in terra?
kjv: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

wlc: הֲתָרִים לָעָב קוֹלֶךָ וְשִׁפְעַת־מַיִם תְּכַסֶּךָּ ׃
lxx: καλέσεις δὲ νέφος φωνῇ, καὶ τρόμῳ ὕδατος λάβρῳ ὑπακούσεταί σου;
vulg: numquid elevabis in nebula vocem tuam et impetus aquarum operiet te
clem: Numquid elevabis in nebula vocem tuam, et impetus aquarum operiet te?
kjv: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

wlc: הַתְשַׁלַּח בְּרָקִים וְיֵלֵכוּ וְיֹאמְרוּ לְךָ הִנֵּנוּ ׃
lxx: ἀποστελεῖς δὲ κεραυνοὺς καὶ πορεύσονται ἐροῦσν δέ σοι Τί ἐστιν;
vulg: numquid mittes fulgura et ibunt et revertentia dicent tibi adsumus
clem: Numquid mittes fulgura, et ibunt, et revertentia dicent tibi: Adsumus?
kjv: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go and say unto thee, Here we are?

wlc: מִי־שָׁת בַּטֻּחוֹת חָכְמָה אוֹ מִי־נָתַן לַשֶּׂכְוִי בִינָה ׃
lxx: τίς δὲ ἔδωκεν γυναιξὶν ὑφάσματος σοφίαν ἢ ποικιλτικὴν ἐπιστήμηνς
vulg: quis posuit in visceribus hominis sapientiam vel quis dedit gallo intellegentiam
clem: Quis posuit in visceribus hominis sapientiam? vel quis dedit gallo intelligentiam?
kjv: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?

wlc: מִי־יְסַפֵּר שְׁחָקִים בְּחָכְמָה וְנִבְלֵי שָׁמַיִם מִי יַשְׁכִּיב ׃
lxx: τίς δὲ ὁ ἀριθμῶν νέφη σοφίᾳ. οὐρανὸν δὲ εἰς γἢν ἔκλαενς
vulg: quis enarravit caelorum rationem et concentum caeli quis dormire faciet
clem: Quis enarrabit clorum rationem? et concentum cli quis dormire faciet?
kjv: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,

wlc: בְּצֶקֶת עָפָר לַמּוּצָק וּרְגָבִים יְדֻבָּקוּ ׃
lxx: κέχυται δὲ ὥσπερ γῆ κονία. κεκόλληκα δὲ αὐτὸν ὥσπερ λίθῳ κύβον.
vulg: quando fundebatur pulvis in terram et glebae conpingebantur
clem: Quando fundebatur pulvis in terra, et gleb compingebantur?
kjv: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?

wlc: הֲתָצוּד לְלָבִיא טָרֶף וְחַיַּת כְּפִירִים תְּמַלֵּא ׃
lxx: θηρεύσεις δὲ λέουσν βοράν, ψυχὰς δὲ δρακόντων ἐμπλήσεις
vulg: numquid capies leaenae praedam et animam catulorum eius implebis
clem: Numquid capies len prdam, et animam catulorum ejus implebis,
kjv: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,

wlc: כִּי־יָשֹׁחוּ בַמְּעוֹנוֹת יֵשְׁבוּ בַסֻּכָּה לְמוֹ־אָרֶב ׃
lxx: δεδοικόσιν γὰρ ἐν κοίταις αὐτῶν, κάθηνται δὲ ἐν ὕλαις ἐνεδρεύοντες
vulg: quando cubant in antris et in specubus insidiantur
clem: quando cubant in antris, et in specubus insidiantur?
kjv: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

wlc: מִי יָכִין לָעֹרֵב צֵידוֹ כִּי־יְלָדוֹ אֶל־אֵל יְשַׁוֵּעוּ יִתְעוּ לִבְלִי־אֹכֶל ׃
lxx: τἰς δὲ ἡτοίμασεν κόρακι βοράν; νεοσσοὶ γὰρ αὐτοῦ πρὸς Κύριον κεκράγασιν, πλανώμενοι τὰ σῖτα ζητοῦντες.
vulg: quis praeparat corvo escam suam quando pulli eius ad Deum clamant vagantes eo quod non habeant cibos
clem: Quis prparat corvo escam suam, quando pulli ejus clamant ad Deum, vagantes, eo quod non habeant cibos?]
kjv: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.

wlc: הֲיָדַעְתָּ עֵת לֶדֶת יַעֲלֵי־סָלַע חֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת תִּשְׁמֹר ׃
lxx: εἰ ἔγνως καιρὸν τοκετοῦ τραγελάφων πέτρας, ἐφύλαξας δὲ ὠδίνας ἐλάφων;
vulg: numquid nosti tempus partus hibicum in petris vel parturientes cervas observasti
clem: [Numquid nosti tempus partus ibicum in petris, vel parturientes cervas observasti?
kjv: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

wlc: תִּסְפֹּר יְרָחִים תְּמַלֶּאנָה וְיָדַעְתָּ עֵת לִדְתָּנָה ׃
lxx: ἠρίθμησας δέ μῆνας αὐτῶν πλήρεις τοκετοῦ, ὠδίνας δὲ αὐτῶν ἔλυσας
vulg: dinumerasti menses conceptus earum et scisti tempus partus earum
clem: Dinumerasti menses conceptus earum, et scisti tempus partus earum?
kjv: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

wlc: תִּכְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵיהֶן תְּפַלַּחְנָה חֶבְלֵיהֶם תְּשַׁלַּחְנָה ׃
lxx: ἐξέθρεψας δὲ αὐτῶν τὰ παιδἰα ἔξω φόβου ὠδῖνας αὐτῶν ἐξαποστελεῖς;
vulg: incurvantur ad fetum et pariunt et rugitus emittunt
clem: Incurvantur ad ftum, et pariunt, et rugitus emittunt.
kjv: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.

wlc: יַחְלְמוּ בְנֵיהֶם יִרְבּוּ בַבָּר יָצְאוּ וְלֹא־שָׁבוּ לָמוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀπορρήξουσιν τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν, πληθυνθήσονται ἐν γενήματι· ἐξελεύσονται, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀνακάμψουσιν αὐτοῖς.
vulg: separantur filii earum pergunt ad pastum egrediuntur et non revertuntur ad eas
clem: Separantur filii earum, et pergunt ad pastum: egrediuntur, et non revertuntur ad eas.
kjv: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.

wlc: מִי־שִׁלַּח פֶּרֶא חָפְשִׁי וּמֹסְרוֹת עָרוֹד מִי פִתֵּחַ ׃
lxx: τς δέ ἐστιν ὁ ἀφεὶς ὄνον ἄγριον ἐλεύθερον, δεσμοὺς δὲ αὐτοῦ τἰς ἔλοσεν;
vulg: quis dimisit onagrum liberum et vincula eius quis solvit
clem: Quis dimisit onagrum liberum, et vincula ejus quis solvit?
kjv: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?

wlc: אֲשֶׁר־שַׂמְתִּי עֲרָבָה בֵיתוֹ וּמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו מְלֵחָה ׃
lxx: ἐθέμην δὲ τὴν δίαιταν αὐτοῦ ἔρημον, καὶ τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτοῦ ἁλμυρίδα.
vulg: cui dedi in solitudine domum et tabernacula eius in terra salsuginis
clem: cui dedi in solitudine domum, et tabernacula ejus in terra salsuginis.
kjv: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.

wlc: יִשְׂחַק לַהֲמוֹן קִרְיָה תְּשֻׁאוֹת נוֹגֵשׂ לֹא יִשְׁמָע ׃
lxx: καταγελῶν πολυοχλίας πόλεως, μέμψιν δὲ φορολόγου οὐκ ἀκούων,
vulg: contemnit multitudinem civitatis clamorem exactoris non audit
clem: Contemnit multitudinem civitatis: clamorem exactoris non audit.
kjv: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.

wlc: יְתוּר הָרִים מִרְעֵהוּ וְאַחַר כָּל־יָרוֹק יִדְרוֹשׁ ׃
lxx: κατασκέψεται ὄρη, νομὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὀπίσω παντὸς χλωροῦ ζητεῖ.
vulg: circumspicit montes pascuae suae et virentia quaeque perquirit
clem: Circumspicit montes pascu su, et virentia quque perquirit.
kjv: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

wlc: הֲיֹאבֶה רֵּים עָבְדֶךָ אִם־יָלִין עַל־אֲבוּסֶךָ ׃
lxx: βουλήσεται δέ σοι μονόκερως δουλεῦσαι, ἢ κοιμηθῆναι ἐπὶ φάτνης σους;
vulg: numquid volet rinoceros servire tibi aut morabitur ad praesepe tuum
clem: Numquid volet rhinoceros servire tibi, aut morabitur ad prsepe tuum?
kjv: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?

wlc: הֲתִקְשָׁר־רֵים בְּתֶלֶם עֲבֹתוֹ אִם־יְשַׂדֵּד עֲמָקִים אַחֲרֶיךָ ׃
lxx: δήσεις δὲ ἐν ἱμᾶσι ζυγὸν αὐτοῦ, ἢ ἑλκύσει σου αὔλακας ἐν πεδίῳ;
vulg: numquid alligabis rinocerota ad arandum loro tuo aut confringet glebas vallium post te
clem: Numquid alligabis rhinocerota ad arandum loro tuo, aut confringet glebas vallium post te?
kjv: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

wlc: הֲתִבְטַח־בּוֹ כִּי־רַב כֹּחוֹ וְתַעֲזֹב אֵלָיו יְגִיעֶךָ ׃
lxx: πέποιθας δὲ ἐπʼ αὐτῷ, ὅτι πολλὴ ἰσχὺς αὐτοῦ, ἐπαφήσεις δὲ αὐτῷ τὰ ἔργα σου;
vulg: numquid fiduciam habebis in magna fortitudine eius et derelinques ei labores tuos
clem: Numquid fiduciam habebis in magna fortitudine ejus, et derelinques ei labores tuos?
kjv: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

wlc: הֲתַאֲמִין בּוֹ כִּי־יָשׁוּב זַרְעֶךָ וְגָרְנְךָ יֶאֱסֹף ׃
lxx: πιστεύσεις δὲ ὅτι ἀποδώσει σοι τὸν σπόρον, εἰσοίσει δέ σου τὸν ἄλωνα;
vulg: numquid credes ei quoniam reddat sementem tibi et aream tuam congreget
clem: Numquid credes illi quod sementem reddat tibi, et aream tuam congreget?
kjv: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?

wlc: כְּנַף־רְנָנִים נֶעֱלָסָה אִם־אֶבְרָה חֲסִידָה וְנֹצָה ׃
lxx: πτέρυξ τερπομένων, ἐὰν συλλάβῃ ἀσίδα καὶ νεσσά·
vulg: pinna strutionum similis est pinnis herodii et accipitris
clem: Penna struthionis similis est pennis herodii et accipitris.
kjv: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?

wlc: כִּי־תַעֲזֹב לָאָרֶץ בֵּצֶיהָ וְעַל־עָפָר תְּחַמֵּם ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἀφήσει εἰς γῆν τὰ ᾠὰ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπὶ χοῦν θάλψει
vulg: quando derelinquit in terra ova sua tu forsitan in pulvere calefacis ea
clem: Quando derelinquit ova sua in terra, tu forsitan in pulvere calefacies ea?
kjv: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,

wlc: וַתִּשְׁכַּח כִּי־רֶגֶל תְּזוּרֶהָ וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה תְּדוּשֶׁהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπελάθοντο ὅτι ποὺς σκορπιεῖ καὶ θηρία ἀγροῦ καταπατήσει.
vulg: obliviscitur quod pes conculcet ea aut bestiae agri conterant
clem: Obliviscitur quod pes conculcet ea, aut bestia agri conterat.
kjv: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.

wlc: הִקְשִׁיחַ בָּנֶיהָ לְּלֹא־לָהּ לְרִיק יְגִיעָהּ בְּלִי־פָחַד ׃
lxx: ἀπεσκλήρυνεν τὰ τέκνα ἑαυτῆς, ὥστε μὴ ἑαυτήν· εἰς κενὸν ἐκοπίασεν ἄνευ φόβου.
vulg: duratur ad filios suos quasi non sint sui frustra laboravit nullo timore cogente
clem: Duratur ad filios suos, quasi non sint sui: frustra laboravit, nullo timore cogente.
kjv: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not her's: her labour is in vain without fear;

wlc: כִּי־הִשָּׁהּ אֱלוֹהַּ חָכְמָה וְלֹא־חָלַק לָהּ בַּבִּינָה ׃
lxx: ὅτι κατεσιώπησεν αὐτῇ ὁ θεὸς σοφίαν, καὶ οὐκ ἐμέρισεν αὐτῇ ἐν τῇ συνέσει.
vulg: privavit enim eam Deus sapientia nec dedit illi intellegentiam
clem: Privavit enim eam Deus sapientia, nec dedit illi intelligentiam.
kjv: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

wlc: כָּעֵת בַּמָּרוֹם תַּמְרִיא תִּשְׂחַק לַסּוּס וּלְרֹכְבוֹ ׃
lxx: κατὰ καιρὸν ἐν ὕψει ὑψώσει, καταγελάσεται ἵππου καὶ τοῦ ἐπιβάτου αὐτοῦ.
vulg: cum tempus fuerit in altum alas erigit deridet equitem et ascensorem eius
clem: Cum tempus fuerit, in altum alas erigit: deridet equum et ascensorem ejus.
kjv: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.

wlc: הֲתִתֵּן לַסּוּס גְּבוּרָה הֲתַלְבִּישׁ צַוָּארוֹ רַעְמָה ׃
lxx: ἢ σὺ περιέθηκας ἵππῳ δύναμιν. ἐνέδυσας δὲ τραχήλῳ αὐτοῦ φόβον;
vulg: numquid praebebis equo fortitudinem aut circumdabis collo eius hinnitum
clem: Numquid prbebis equo fortitudinem, aut circumdabis collo ejus hinnitum?
kjv: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?

wlc: הְתַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּה הוֹד נַחְרוֹ אֵימָה ׃
lxx: περιέθηκας δὲ αὐτῷ πανοπλίαν, δόξαν δὲ στηθέων αὐτοῦ τόλμης
vulg: numquid suscitabis eum quasi lucustas gloria narium eius terror
clem: Numquid suscitabis eum quasi locustas? gloria narium ejus terror.
kjv: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.

wlc: יַחְפְּרוּ בָעֵמֶק וְיָשִׂישׂ בְּכֹחַ יֵצֵא לִקְרַאת־נָשֶׁק ׃
lxx: ἀνορύσσων ἐν πεδίῳ γαυρξ. ἐκπορεύεται δὲ εἰς πεδίον ἐν ἰσχύι
vulg: terram ungula fodit exultat audacter in occursum pergit armatis
clem: Terram ungula fodit; exultat audacter: in occursum pergit armatis.
kjv: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.

wlc: יִשְׂחַק לְפַחַד וְלֹא יֵחָת וְלֹא־יָשׁוּב מִפְּנֵי־חָרֶב ׃
lxx: συναντῶν βασιλεῖ καταγελῶ, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποστραφῇ ἀπὸ σιδήρου.
vulg: contemnit pavorem nec cedit gladio
clem: Contemnit pavorem, nec cedit gladio.
