kjv: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.

wlc: עָלָיו תִּרְנֶה אַשְׁפָּה לַהַב חֲנִית וְכִידוֹן ׃
lxx: ἐπʼ αὐτῷ γαυριᾷ τόξον καὶ μάχαιρα.
vulg: super ipsum sonabit faretra vibrabit hasta et clypeus
clem: Super ipsum sonabit pharetra; vibrabit hasta et clypeus:
kjv: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

wlc: בְּרַעַשׁ וְרֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא־אָרֶץ וְלֹא־יַאֲמִין כִּי־קוֹל שׁוֹפָר ׃
lxx: καὶ ὀργῇ ἀφανιεῖ τὴν γῆν· καὶ οὐ μὴ πιστεύσῃ ἕως ἂν σημάνῃ σάλπιγξ.
vulg: fervens et fremens sorbet terram nec reputat tubae sonare clangorem
clem: fervens et fremens sorbet terram, nec reputat tub sonare clangorem.
kjv: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.

wlc: בְּדֵי שֹׁפָר יֹאמַר הֶאָח וּמֵרָחוֹק יָרִיחַ מִלְחָמָה רַעַם שָׂרִים וּתְרוּעָה ׃
lxx: σάλπιγγος δέ σημαινούσης λέγει Εὖγε· πόρρωθεν δὲ ὀσφραίνεται πολέμου σὺν ἄλματι καὶ κραυγῇ
vulg: ubi audierit bucinam dicet va procul odoratur bellum exhortationem ducum et ululatum exercitus
clem: Ubi audierit buccinam, dicit: Vah! procul odoratur bellum: exhortationem ducum, et ululatum exercitus.
kjv: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

wlc: הֲמִבִּינָתְךָ יַאֲבֶר־נֵץ יִפְרֹשׂ כְּנָפוֹ לְתֵימָן ׃
lxx: ἐκ δὲ τῆς σῆς ἐπιστήμης ἔστηκεν ἱέραξ, ἀναπετάσας τὰς πτέρυγας ἀκίνητος, καθορῶν τὰ πρὸς νότον
vulg: numquid per sapientiam tuam plumescit accipiter expandens alas suas ad austrum
clem: Numquid per sapientiam tuam plumescit accipiter, expandens alas suas ad austrum?
kjv: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?

wlc: אִם־עַל־פִּיךָ יַגְבִּיהַּ נָשֶׁר וְכִי יָרִים קִנּוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ δὲ σῷ προστάγματι ὑψοῦται ἀετός, γὺψ δὲ ἐπὶ νοσσιᾶς αὐτου (28)καθεσθεὶς αὐλἰζεται,
vulg: aut ad praeceptum tuum elevabitur aquila et in arduis ponet nidum suum
clem: Numquid ad prceptum tuum elevabitur aquila, et in arduis ponet nidum suum?
kjv: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?

wlc: סֶלַע יִשְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָן עַל־שֶׁן־סֶלַע וּמְצוּדָה ׃
lxx: ἐπ᾿ ἐξοχῇ πέτρας καὶ ἀποκρύφω;
vulg: in petris manet et in praeruptis silicibus commoratur atque inaccessis rupibus
clem: In petris manet, et in prruptis silicibus commoratur, atque inaccessis rupibus.
kjv: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.

wlc: מִשָּׁם חָפַר־אֹכֶל לְמֵרָחוֹק עֵינָיו יַבִּיטוּ ׃
lxx: ἐκεῖσε ὢν ζητεῖ τὰ σῖτα, πόρρωθεν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ σκοπεύουσιν·
vulg: inde contemplatur escam et de longe oculi eius prospiciunt
clem: Inde contemplatur escam, et de longe oculi ejus prospiciunt.
kjv: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.

wlc: וְאֶפְרֹחוֹ יְעַלְעוּ־דָם וּבַאֲשֶׁר חֲלָלִים שָׁם הוּא ׃ פ
lxx: νεοσσοὶ δὲ αὐτοῦ φύρονται ἐν αἵματι, οὗ δ᾿ ἂν ὦσι τεθνεῶτες παραχρῆμα εὑρίσκονται.
vulg: pulli eius lambent sanguinem et ubicumque cadaver fuerit statim adest
clem: Pulli ejus lambent sanguinem: et ubicumque cadaver fuerit, statim adest.]
kjv: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.

lxx: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῷ Ἰὼβ καὶ εἶπεν
vulg: et adiecit Dominus et locutus est ad Iob
clem: Et adjecit Dominus, et locutus est ad Job:

lxx: Μὴ κρίσιν μετὰ Ἱκανοῦ ἐκκλινεῖς ἐλέγχων δὲ θεὸν ἀποκριθήσεται αὐτήν;
vulg: numquid qui contendit cum Deo tam facile conquiescit utique qui arguit Deum debet respondere ei
clem: [Numquid qui contendit cum Deo, tam facile conquiescit? utique qui arguit Deum, debet respondere ei.]

lxx: Ὑπολαβὼν δὲ Ἰὼβ λέγει τῷ κυρίῳ
vulg: respondens autem Iob Domino dixit
clem: Respondens autem Job Domino, dixit:

lxx: Τί ἔτι ἐγὼ κρίνομαι, νουθετούμενος καὶ ἐλέγχων Κύριων. ἀκούων τοιαῦτα οὐθὲν ὤν; ἐγὼ δὲ τίνα ἀπόκρισιν δώσω πρὸς ταῦτα; χεῖρα θήσω ἐπὶ στόματί μου.
vulg: qui leviter locutus sum respondere quid possum manum meam ponam super os meum
clem: [Qui leviter locutus sum, respondere quid possum? manum meam ponam super os meum.

lxx: ἅπαξ λελάληκα, ἐπὶ δὲ τῷ δευτέρῳ οὐ προσθήσω.
vulg: unum locutus sum quod utinam non dixissem et alterum quibus ultra non addam
clem: Unum locutus sum, quod utinam non dixissem: et alterum, quibus ultra non addam.]

wlc: וַיַּעַן יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: Ἔτι δὲ ὑπολαβὼν ὁ κύριος εἶπεν τῷ Ἰὼβ ἐκ τοῦ νέφους
vulg: respondens autem Dominus Iob de turbine ait
clem: Respondens autem Dominus Job de turbine, dixit:
kjv: Moreover the Lord answered Job, and said,

wlc: הֲרֹב עִם־שַׁדַּי יִסּוֹר מוֹכִיחַ אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲנֶנָּה ׃ פ
lxx: Μή, ἀλλὰ ζῶσαι ὥσπερ ἀνὴρ τὴν ὀσφύν σου. ἐρωτήσω δέ σε, σὺ δέ μοι ἀπόκριναι·
vulg: accinge sicut vir lumbos tuos interrogabo te et indica mihi
clem: [Accinge sicut vir lumbos tuos: interrogabo te, et indica mihi.
kjv: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.

wlc: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: μὴ ἀποποιοῦ μου τὸ κρίμα. οἴει δέ με ἄλλως σοι κεχρηματικέναι ἡ ἵνα ἀναφανῇς δίκαιος
vulg: numquid irritum facies iudicium meum et condemnabis me ut tu iustificeris
clem: Numquid irritum facies judicium meum, et condemnabis me, ut tu justificeris?
kjv: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,

wlc: הֵן קַלֹּתִי מָה אֲשִׁיבֶךָּ יָדִי שַׂמְתִּי לְמוֹ־פִי ׃
lxx: ἣ βραχίων σοί ἐστιν κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου, ἢ φωνῇ κατʼ αὐτοῦ βροντᾶς;
vulg: et si habes brachium sicut Deus et si voce simili tonas
clem: Et si habes brachium sicut Deus? et si voce simili tonas?
kjv: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.

wlc: אַחַת דִּבַּרְתִּי וְלֹא אֶעֱנֶה וּשְׁתַּיִם וְלֹא אוֹסִיף ׃ פ
lxx: ἀνάλαβε δὴ ὕψος καὶ δύναμιν. δόξαν δὲ καὶ τιμὴν ἀμφίεσαι.
vulg: circumda tibi decorem et in sublime erigere et esto gloriosus et speciosis induere vestibus
clem: Circumda tibi decorem, et in sublime erigere, et esto gloriosus, et speciosis induere vestibus.
kjv: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.

wlc: וַיַּעַן־יְהוָה אֶת־אִיּוֹב מִנ *סְעָרָה וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: ἀπόστειλον δὲ ἀγγέλους ὀργῇ. πᾶν δὲ ὑβριστὴν ταπείνωσον,
vulg: disperge superbos furore tuo et respiciens omnem arrogantem humilia
clem: Disperge superbos in furore tuo, et respiciens omnem arrogantem humilia.
kjv: Then answered the Lord unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

wlc: אֱזָר־נָא כְגֶבֶר חֲלָצֶיךָ אֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי ׃
lxx: ὑπερήφανον δὲ σβέσον· σῆψον δὲ ἀσεβεῖς παραχρῆμα.
vulg: respice cunctos superbos et confunde eos et contere impios in loco suo
clem: Respice cunctos superbos, et confunde eos, et contere impios in loco suo.
kjv: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

wlc: הַאַף תָּפֵר מִשְׁפָּטִי תַּרְשִׁיעֵנִי לְמַעַן תִּצְדָּק ׃
lxx: κρύψον δὲ εἰς γῆν ὁμοθυμαδόν, τὰ δὲ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν ἀτιμίας ἔμπλησον·
vulg: absconde eos in pulvere simul et facies eorum demerge in foveam
clem: Absconde eos in pulvere simul, et facies eorum demerge in foveam.
kjv: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?

wlc: וְאִם־זְרוֹעַ כָּאֵל לָךְ וּבְקוֹל כָּמֹהוּ תַרְעֵם ׃
lxx: ὁμολογήσω ὅτι δύναται ἡ δεξιά σου σῶ
vulg: et ego confitebor quod salvare te possit dextera tua
clem: Et ego confitebor quod salvare te possit dextera tua.
kjv: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

wlc: עֲדֵה נָא גָאוֹן וָגֹבַהּ וְהוֹד וְהָדָר תִּלְבָּשׁ ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ δὴ ἰδοὺ δὴ θηρία παρὰ σοί, χόρτον ἴσα βουσὶν ἐσθίουσιν.
vulg: ecce Behemoth quem feci tecum faenum quasi bos comedet
clem: Ecce behemoth quem feci tecum, fnum quasi bos comedet.
kjv: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.

wlc: הָפֵץ עֶבְרוֹת אַפֶּךָ וּרְאֵה כָל־גֵּאֶה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵהוּ ׃
lxx: ἰδοὸ δὴ ἰσχὺς αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ ὀσφύι. ἡ δὲ δύναμις ἐπʼ ὀμφαλοῦ γαστρός·
vulg: fortitudo eius in lumbis eius et virtus illius in umbilicis ventris eius
clem: Fortitudo ejus in lumbis ejus, et virtus illius in umbilico ventris ejus.
kjv: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.

wlc: רְאֵה כָל־גֵּאֶה הַכְנִיעֵהוּ וַהֲדֹךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּחְתָּם ׃
lxx: ἔστησεν οὐρὰν ὡς κυπάρισσον, τὰ δὲ νεῦρα αὐτοῦ συμπέπλεκται·
vulg: constringit caudam suam quasi cedrum nervi testiculorum eius perplexi sunt
clem: Stringit caudam suam quasi cedrum; nervi testiculorum ejus perplexi sunt.
kjv: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

wlc: טָמְנֵם בֶּעָפָר יָחַד פְּנֵיהֶם חֲבֹשׁ בַּטָּמוּן ׃
lxx: αἱ πλευραὶ αὐτοῦ πλευραὶ χάλκειαι, ἡ δὲ ῥάχις αὐτοῦ σίδηρος χυτός.
vulg: ossa eius velut fistulae aeris cartilago illius quasi lamminae ferreae
clem: Ossa ejus velut fistul ris; cartilago illius quasi lamin ferre.
kjv: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

wlc: וְגַם־אֲנִי אוֹדֶךָּ כִּי־תוֹשִׁעַ לְךָ יְמִינֶךָ ׃
lxx: τοῦτ᾿ ἔστιν ἀρχὴ πλάσματος Κυρίου, πεποιημένον ἐνκαταπαίζεσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ.
vulg: ipse principium est viarum Dei qui fecit eum adplicabit gladium eius
clem: Ipse est principium viarum Dei: qui fecit eum applicabit gladium ejus.
kjv: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.

wlc: הִנֵּה־נָא בְהֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי עִמָּךְ חָצִיר כַּבָּקָר יֹאכֵל ׃
lxx: ἐπελθὰλν δὲ ἐπʼ ὄρος ἀκρότομον ἐποίησεν χαρμονὴν τετράποσιν ἐν τῷ ταρτάρῳ·
vulg: huic montes herbas ferunt omnes bestiae agri ludent ibi
clem: Huic montes herbas ferunt: omnes besti agri ludent ibi.
kjv: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.

wlc: הִנֵּה־נָא כֹחוֹ בְמָתְנָיו וְאֹנוֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵי בִטְנוֹ ׃
lxx: ὑπὸ παντοδαπὰ δένδρα κοιμᾶται. παρὰ πάπυρον καὶ κάλαμον καὶ βούτομον·
vulg: sub umbra dormit in secreto calami et locis humentibus
clem: Sub umbra dormit in secreto calami, et in locis humentibus.
kjv: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.

wlc: יַחְפֹּץ זְנָבוֹ כְמוֹ־אָרֶז גִּידֵי פַחֲדוֹ יְשֹׂרָגוּ ׃
lxx: σκιάζονται δὲ ἐν αὐτῷ δένδρα μεγάλα σὺν ῥαδάμνοις. καὶ κλῶνες ἀγροῦ.
vulg: protegunt umbrae umbram eius circumdabunt eum salices torrentis
clem: Protegunt umbr umbram ejus: circumdabunt eum salices torrentis.
kjv: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.

wlc: עֲצָמָיו אֲפִיקֵי נְחוּשָׁה גְּרָמָיו כִּמְטִיל בַּרְזֶל ׃
lxx: ἐὰν γένηται πλήμμυρα. οὐ μὴ ασθηθῆ, πέποιθευ ὅτι προσκρούσει ὁ Ἰορδάνης εἰς τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ·
vulg: ecce absorbebit fluvium et non mirabitur habet fiduciam quod influat Iordanis in os eius
clem: Ecce absorbebit fluvium, et non mirabitur, et habet fiduciam quod influat Jordanis in os ejus.
kjv: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.

wlc: הוּא רֵאשִׁית דַּרְכֵי־אֵל הָעֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּשׁ חַרְבּוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐν τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ αὐτοῦ δέξεται αὐτόν ἐνσκολιευόμενος τρήσει ῤῖνα;
vulg: in oculis eius quasi hamo capiet eum et in sudibus perforabit nares eius
clem: In oculis ejus quasi hamo capiet eum, et in sudibus perforabit nares ejus.
kjv: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.

wlc: כִּי־בוּל הָרִים יִשְׂאוּ־לוֹ וְכָל־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה יְשַׂחֲקוּ־שָׁם ׃
lxx: ἄξεις δὲ δράκοντα ἐν ἀγκίστοῳ. περιθήσεις δὲ φορβεάν περὶ ῥἴνα αὐτοῦ;
vulg: an extrahere poteris Leviathan hamo et fune ligabis linguam eius
clem: An extrahere poteris leviathan hamo, et fune ligabis linguam ejus?
kjv: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.

wlc: תַּחַת־צֶאֱלִים יִשְׁכָּב בְּסֵתֶר קָנֶה וּבִצָּה ׃
lxx: εἰ δήσεις κρίκον ἐν τῷ μυκτῆρι αὐτοῦ, ψελίῳ δὲ τρυπήσεις τὸ χεῖλος αὐτοῦς
vulg: numquid pones circulum in naribus eius et armilla perforabis maxillam eius
clem: Numquid pones circulum in naribus ejus, aut armilla perforabis maxillam ejus?
kjv: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

wlc: יְסֻכֻּהוּ צֶאֱלִים צִלֲלוֹ יְסֻבּוּהוּ עַרְבֵי־נָחַל ׃
lxx: λαλήσει δέ σοι δεήσει, ἱκετηρίᾳ μαλακῶς
vulg: numquid multiplicabit ad te preces aut loquetur tibi mollia
clem: Numquid multiplicabit ad te preces, aut loquetur tibi mollia?
kjv: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

wlc: הֵן יַעֲשֹׁק נָהָר לֹא יַחְפּוֹז יִבְטַח כִּי־יָגִיחַ יַרְדֵּן אֶל־פִּיהוּ ׃
lxx: θήσεται διαθήκην μετὰ σοῦ; λήμψῃ δὲ αὐτὸν δοῦλον αἰώνιον;
vulg: numquid feriet tecum pactum et accipies eum servum sempiternum
clem: Numquid feriet tecum pactum, et accipies eum servum sempiternum?
kjv: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.

wlc: בְּעֵינָיו יִקָּחֶנּוּ בְּמוֹקְשִׁים יִנְקָב־אָף ׃
lxx: παίξῃ δὲ ἐν αὐτῷ ὥσπερ ὀρνέῳ, ἢ δήσεις αὐτὸν ὥσπερ στρουθίον παιδίῳς
vulg: numquid inludes ei quasi avi aut ligabis illum ancillis tuis
clem: Numquid illudes ei quasi avi, aut ligabis eum ancillis tuis?
kjv: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.

wlc: תִּמְשֹׁךְ לִוְיָתָן בְּחַכָּה וּבְחֶבֶל תַּשְׁקִיעַ לְשֹׁנוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐνσιτοῦνται δὲ ἐν αὐτῷ ἔθνη, μεριτεύονται δὲ αὐτὸν Φοινίκων ἔθνη;
vulg: concident eum amici divident illum negotiatores
clem: Concident eum amici? divident illum negotiatores?

wlc: הֲתָשִׂים אַגְמוֹן בְּאַפּוֹ וּבְחוֹחַ תִּקּוֹב לֶחֱיוֹ ׃
lxx: χῆν δὲ πλωτὸν συνελθὸν οὐ μὴ ἐνέγκαοσιν βύρσαν μίαν οὐρᾶς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν πλοίοις ἀλιέαων κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: numquid implebis sagenas pelle eius et gurgustium piscium capite illius
clem: Numquid implebis sagenas pelle ejus, et gurgustium piscium capite illius?

wlc: הֲיַרְבֶּה אֵלֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִים אִם־יְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ רַכּוֹת ׃
lxx: ἐπιθήσει δὲ αὐτῷ χείρα, μνησθεὶς πόλεμον τὸν γινόμενον ἐν σώματι αὐτοῦ.
vulg: pone super eum manum tuam memento belli nec ultra addas loqui
clem: Pone super eum manum tuam: memento belli, nec ultra addas loqui.

wlc: הֲיִכְרֹת בְּרִית עִמָּךְ תִּקָּחֶנּוּ לְעֶבֶד עוֹלָם ׃
vulg: ecce spes eius frustrabitur eum et videntibus cunctis praecipitabitur
clem: Ecce spes ejus frustrabitur eum, et videntibus cunctis prcipitabitur.]

wlc: הַתְשַׂחֶק־בּוֹ כַּצִּפּוֹר וְתִקְשְׁרֶנּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶיךָ ׃
יִכְרוּ עָלָיו חַבָּרִים יֶחֱצוּהוּ בֵּין כְּנַעֲנִים ׃
הַתְמַלֵּא בְשֻׂכּוֹת עוֹרוֹ וּבְצִלְצַל דָּגִים רֹאשׁוֹ ׃
שִׂים־עָלָיו כַּפֶּךָ זְכֹר מִלְחָמָה אַל־תּוֹסַף ׃
הֵן־תֹּחַלְתּוֹ נִכְזָבָה הֲגַם אֶל־מַרְאָיו יֻטָל ׃
lxx: οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τοῖς λεγομένοις τεθαύμακας (²) οὐδὲ δέδοικας ὅτι ἡτοίμασταί μοι
vulg: non quasi crudelis suscitabo eum quis enim resistere potest vultui meo
clem: [Non quasi crudelis suscitabo eum: quis enim resistere potest vultui meo?
kjv: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?

wlc: לֹא־אַכְזָר כִּי יְעוּרֶנּוּ וּמִי הוּא לְפָנַי יִתְיַצָּב ׃
lxx: τίς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ἐμοὶ ἀντιστάς; ἢ τίς ἀντιστήσεταί μοι καὶ ὑπομενεῖ; εἰ πᾶσα ἡ ὑπʼ οὐρανὸν ἐμή ἐστιν,
vulg: quis ante dedit mihi ut reddam ei omnia quae sub caelo sunt mea sunt
clem: Quis ante dedit mihi, ut reddam ei? omnia qu sub clo sunt, mea sunt.
kjv: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?

wlc: מִי הִקְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּם תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם לִי־הוּא ׃
lxx: οὐ σιωπήσομαι διʼ αὐτόν, καὶ λόγον δυνάμεως ἐλεήσει τὸν ἴσον αὐτοῦ.
vulg: non parcam ei et verbis potentibus et ad deprecandum conpositis
clem: Non parcam ei, et verbis potentibus, et ad deprecandum compositis.
kjv: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?

wlc: לֹא־אַחֲרִישׁ בַּדָּיו וּדְבַר־גְּבוּרוֹת וְחִין עֶרְכּוֹ ׃
lxx: τίς ἀποκαλύψει πρόσωπον ἐνδύσεαος αὐτοῦ; εἰς δὲ πτύξιν θώρακος αὐτοῦ τίς ἂν εἰσέλθοι;
vulg: quis revelavit faciem indumenti eius et in medium oris eius quis intrabit
clem: Quis revelabit faciem indumenti ejus? et in medium oris ejus quis intrabit?
kjv: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?

wlc: מִי־גִלָּה פְּנֵי לְבוּשׁוֹ בְּכֶפֶל רִסְנוֹ מִי יָבוֹא ׃
lxx: πύλας προσώπου αὐτοῦ τίς ἀνοίξει; κύκλῳ ὀδόντων αὐτοῦ φόβος.
vulg: portas vultus eius quis aperiet per gyrum dentium eius formido
clem: Portas vultus ejus quis aperiet? per gyrum dentium ejus formido.
kjv: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

wlc: דַּלְתֵי פָנָיו מִי פִתֵּחַ סְבִיבוֹת שִׁנָּיו אֵימָה ׃
lxx: τὰ ἔγκατα αὐτοῦ ἀσπίδες χάλκειαι, σύνδεσμος αὐτοῦ ὥσπερ σμιρίτης λίθος·
vulg: corpus illius quasi scuta fusilia et conpactum squamis se prementibus
clem: Corpus illius quasi scuta fusilia, compactum squamis se prementibus.
kjv: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?

wlc: גַּאֲוָה אֲפִיקֵי מָגִנִּים סָגוּר חוֹתָם צָר ׃
lxx: εἰς τοῦ ἑνὸς κολλῶνται, πνεῦμα δὲ οὐ μὴ διέλθῃ αὐτόν·
vulg: una uni coniungitur et ne spiraculum quidem incedit per eas
clem: Una uni conjungitur, et ne spiraculum quidem incedit per eas.
kjv: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?

wlc: אֶחָד בְּאֶחָד יִגַּשׁוּ וְרוּחַ לֹא־יָבוֹא בֵינֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ προσκολληθήσεται· συνέχονται, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποσπασθῶσιν.
vulg: una alteri adherebunt et tenentes se nequaquam separabuntur
clem: Una alteri adhrebit, et tenentes se nequaquam separabuntur.
kjv: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.

wlc: אִישׁ־בְּאָחִיהוּ יְדֻבָּקוּ יִתְלַכְּדוּ וְלֹא יִתְפָּרָדוּ ׃
lxx: ἐν πταρμῷ αὐτοῦ ἐπιφαύσκεται φέγγος. οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ εἶδος ἑωσφόρου.
vulg: sternutatio eius splendor ignis et oculi eius ut palpebrae diluculi
clem: Sternutatio ejus splendor ignis, et oculi ejus ut palpebr diluculi.
kjv: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

wlc: עֲטִישֹׁתָיו תָּהֶל אוֹר וְעֵינָיו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי־שָׁחַר ׃
lxx: ἐκ στόματος αὐτοῦ ἐκπορεύονται λαμπάδες καιόμεναι, καὶ διαρριπτοῦνται ἐσχάραι πυρός.
vulg: de ore eius lampades procedunt sicut taedae ignis accensae
clem: De ore ejus lampades procedunt, sicut td ignis accens.
kjv: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?

wlc: מִפִּיו לַפִּידִים יַהֲלֹכוּ כִּידוֹדֵי אֵשׁ יִתְמַלָּטוּ ׃
lxx: ἐκ μυκτήρων αὐτοῦ ἐκπορεύεται καπνὸς καμίνου καιομένης πυρὶ ἀνθράκων·
vulg: de naribus eius procedit fumus sicut ollae succensae atque ferventis
clem: De naribus ejus procedit fumus, sicut oll succens atque ferventis.
kjv: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.

wlc: מִנְּחִירָיו יֵצֵא עָשָׁן כְּדוּד נָפוּחַ וְאַגְמֹן ׃
lxx: ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ ἄνθρακες. φλὸξ δὲ ἐκ στόματος αὐτοῦ ἐκπορεύεται
vulg: halitus eius prunas ardere facit et flamma de ore eius egreditur
clem: Halitus ejus prunas ardere facit, et flamma de ore ejus egreditur.
kjv: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.

wlc: נַפְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִים תְּלַהֵט וְלַהַב מִפִּיו יֵצֵא ׃
lxx: ἐν δὲ τραχήλῳ αὐτοῦ αὐλἰζεται δύναμις. ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ τρέχει ἀπωλία.
vulg: in collo eius morabitur fortitudo et faciem eius praecedet egestas
clem: In collo ejus morabitur fortitudo, et faciem ejus prcedit egestas.
kjv: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?

wlc: בְּצַוָּארוֹ יָלִין עֹז וּלְפָנָיו תָּדוּץ דְּאָבָה ׃
lxx: σάρκες δὲ σώματος αὐτοῦ κεκόλληνται καταχέει ἐπʼ αὐτόν, οὐ σαλευθήσεται.
vulg: membra carnium eius coherentia sibi mittet contra eum fulmina et ad locum alium non ferentur
clem: Membra carnium ejus cohrentia sibi: mittet contra eum fulmina, et ad locum alium non ferentur.
kjv: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.

wlc: מַפְּלֵי בְשָׂרוֹ דָבֵקוּ יָצוּק עָלָיו בַּל־יִמּוֹט ׃
lxx: ἡ καρδἰα αὐτοῦ πέπηγεν ὡς λίθος, ἕστηκεν δὲ ὥσπερ ἄκμων ἀνήλατος.
vulg: cor eius indurabitur quasi lapis et stringetur quasi malleatoris incus
clem: Cor ejus indurabitur tamquam lapis, et stringetur quasi malleatoris incus.
kjv: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.

wlc: לִבּוֹ יָצוּק כְּמוֹ־אָבֶן וְיָצוּק כְּפֶלַח תַּחְתִּית ׃
lxx: στραφέντος δὲ αὐτοῦ φόβος θηρίοις τετράποσιν ἐπὶ γῆς ἁλλομένοις.
vulg: cum sublatus fuerit timebunt angeli et territi purgabuntur
clem: Cum sublatus fuerit, timebunt angeli, et territi purgabuntur.
kjv: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

wlc: מִשֵּׂתוֹ יָגוּרוּ אֵלִים מִשְּׁבָרִים יִתְחַטָּאוּ ׃
lxx: ἐὰν συναντήσωσιν αὐτῷ λόγχαι, οὐδὲν μὴ ποιήσωσιν δόρυ καὶ θώρακα·
vulg: cum adprehenderit eum gladius subsistere non poterit neque hasta neque torax
clem: Cum apprehenderit eum gladius, subsitere non poterit, neque hasta, neque thorax:
kjv: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

wlc: מַשִּׂיגֵהוּ חֶרֶב בְּלִי תָקוּם חֲנִית מַסָּע וְשִׁרְיָה ׃
lxx: ἤγηται μὶν γὰρ σίδηρον ἄχυρα. χαλκὸν δὲ ὥσπερ ξύλον σαθρόν.
vulg: reputabit enim quasi paleas ferrum et quasi lignum putridum aes
clem: reputabit enim quasi paleas ferrum, et quasi lignum putridum s.
kjv: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

wlc: יַחְשֹׁב לְתֶבֶן בַּרְזֶל לְעֵץ רִקָּבוֹן נְחוּשָׁה ׃
lxx: οὐ μὴ τρώσῃ αὐτὸν τόξον χάλκειον· ἥγηται μέν πετροβόλον χόρθον,
vulg: non fugabit eum vir sagittarius in stipulam versi sunt ei lapides fundae
clem: Non fugabit eum vir sagittarius: in stipulam versi sunt ei lapides fund.
kjv: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.

wlc: לֹא־יַבְרִיחֶנּוּ בֶן־קָשֶׁת לְקַשׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ־לוֹ אַבְנֵי־קָלַע ׃
lxx: ὡς καλάμη ἐλογίσθησαν σφυρά, καταγελῶ δὲ σεισμοῦ πυρφόρου.
vulg: quasi stipulam aestimabit malleum et deridebit vibrantem hastam
clem: Quasi stipulam stimabit malleum, et deridebit vibrantem hastam.
kjv: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.

wlc: כְּקַשׁ נֶחְשְׁבוּ תוֹתָח וְיִשְׂחַק לְרַעַשׁ כִּידוֹן ׃
lxx: ἡ στρωμνὴ αὐτοῦ ὀβελίσκοι ὀξεῖς. πᾶς δέ χρυσὸς θαλάσσης ὑπʼ αὐτὸν ὥσπερ πηλὸς ἀμύθητος.
vulg: sub ipso erunt radii solis sternet sibi aurum quasi lutum
clem: Sub ipso erunt radii solis, et sternet sibi aurum quasi lutum.
kjv: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

wlc: תַּחְתָּיו חַדּוּדֵי חָרֶשׂ יִרְפַּד חָרוּץ עֲלֵי־טִיט ׃
lxx: ἀναζεῖ τὴν ἄβυσσον ὥσπερ χαλκεῖον· ἥγηται δὲ τὴν θάλασσαν ὥσπερ ἐξάλιπτρον,
vulg: fervescere faciet quasi ollam profundum mare ponet quasi cum unguenta bulliunt
clem: Fervescere faciet quasi ollam profundum mare, et ponet quasi cum unguenta bulliunt.
kjv: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.

wlc: יַרְתִּיחַ כַּסִּיר מְצוּלָה יָם יָשִׂים כַּמֶּרְקָחָה ׃
lxx: τὸν δὲ τάρταρον τῆς ἀβύσσου ὥσπερ αἰχμάλωτον· λογίσατο ἄβυσσον εἰς περίπατον.
vulg: post eum lucebit semita aestimabit abyssum quasi senescentem
clem: Post eum lucebit semita: stimabit abyssum quasi senescentem.
kjv: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.

wlc: אַחֲרָיו יָאִיר נָתִיב יַחְשֹׁב תְּהוֹם לְשֵׂיבָה ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἔστιν οὐδὲν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὅμοιον αὐτῷ, πεποιημένον ἐνκαταπαίζεσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀγγέλων μου·
vulg: non est super terram potestas quae conparetur ei qui factus est ut nullum timeret
clem: Non est super terram potestas qu comparetur ei, qui factus est ut nullum timeret.
kjv: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.

wlc: אֵין־עַל־עָפָר מָשְׁלוֹ הֶעָשׂוּ לִבְלִי־חָת ׃
lxx: πᾶν ὑψηλὸν ὁρᾷ, αὐτὸς δὲ βασιλεὺς πάντων τῶν ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν.
vulg: omne sublime videt ipse est rex super universos filios superbiae
clem: Omne sublime videt: ipse est rex super universos filios superbi.]
kjv: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.

wlc: אֵת־כָּל־גָּבֹהַּ יִרְאֶה הוּא מֶלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־בְּנֵי־שָׁחַץ ׃ ס
kjv: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.

wlc: וַיַּעַן אִיּוֹב אֶת־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר ׃
lxx: ‘Υπολαβὼν δὲ Ἰὰὼβ λέγει τῷ κυρίῳ
vulg: respondens autem Iob Domino dixit
clem: Respondens autem Job Domino, dixit:
kjv: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,

wlc: יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־כֹל תּוּכָל וְלֹא־יִבָּצֵר מִמְּךָ מְזִמָּה ׃
lxx: Οὐδα ὅτι πάντα δύνασαι, ἀδυνατεῖ δέ σοι οὐθέν.
vulg: scio quia omnia potes et nulla te latet cogitatio
clem: [Scio quia omnia potes, et nulla te latet cogitatio.
kjv: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

wlc: מִי זֶה מַעְלִים עֵצָה בְּלִי דָעַת לָכֵן הִגַּדְתִּי וְלֹא אָבִין נִפְלָאוֹת מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא אֵדָע ׃
lxx: τίς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ κρύπταανν σε βουλήν; φειδόμενος δέ ῥημάτων, καὶ σέ οἴεται κρύπτειν; τἰς δὲ ἀναγγελεῖ μοι ἃ οὐκ ᾔδειν, μεγάλα καὶ θαυμαστὰ ἃ οὐκ ἡπιστάμηνς
vulg: quis est iste qui celat consilium absque scientia ideo insipienter locutus sum et quae ultra modum excederent scientiam meam
clem: Quis est iste qui celat consilium absque scientia? ideo insipienter locutus sum, et qu ultra modum excederent scientiam meam.
kjv: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

wlc: שְׁמַע־נָא וְאָנֹכִי אֲדַבֵּר אֶשְׁאָלְךָ וְהוֹדִיעֵנִי ׃
lxx: ἄκουσον δέ μου, Κύριε, ἵνα κἀγὼ λαλήσω· ἐρωτήσω δέ, σὺ δέ με δἰδαξον.
vulg: audi et ego loquar interrogabo et ostende mihi
clem: Audi, et ego loquar: interrogabo te, et responde mihi.
kjv: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

wlc: לְשֵׁמַע־אֹזֶן שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ וְעַתָּה עֵינִי רָאָתְךָ ׃
lxx: ἀκοὴν μὲν ὠτὸς ἤκουόν σου τὸ πρότερον, νυνὶ δὲ ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἑόρακέν σε.
vulg: auditu auris audivi te nunc autem oculus meus videt te
clem: Auditu auris audivi te: nunc autem oculus meus videt te.
kjv: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.

wlc: עַל־כֵּן אֶמְאַס וְנִחַמְתִּי עַל־עָפָר וָאֵפֶר ׃ פ
lxx: διὸ ἐφαύλισα ἐμαυτὸν καὶ ἐτάκην· ἥγημαι δὲ ἐγὼ ἐμαυτὸν γῆν καὶ σποδόν.
vulg: idcirco ipse me reprehendo et ago paenitentiam in favilla et cinere
clem: Idcirco ipse me reprehendo, et ago pnitentiam in favilla et cinere.]
kjv: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.

wlc: וַיְהִי אַחַר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־אִיּוֹב וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי חָרָה אַפִּי בְךָ וּבִשְׁנֵי רֵעֶיךָ כִּי לֹא דִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלַי נְכוֹנָה כְּעַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב ׃
lxx: Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὸ λαλῆσαι τὸν κύριον πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα τῷ Ἰὼβ, εἶπεν ὁ κύριος Ἐλειφὰς τῷ βαιμανείτῃ Ἰμαρτες σὺ καὶ οἱ φίλοι σου·, οὐ γὰρ ἐλαλήσατε ἐνώπιόν μου ἀληθὲς οὐδέν, ὥσπερ ὁ θεράπων μου Ἰὼβ.
vulg: postquam autem locutus est Dominus verba haec ad Iob dixit ad Eliphaz Themaniten iratus est furor meus in te et in duos amicos tuos quoniam non estis locuti coram me rectum sicut servus meus Iob
clem: Postquam autem locutus est Dominus verba hc ad Job, dixit ad Eliphaz Themanitem: Iratus est furor meus in te, et in duos amicos tuos, quoniam non estis locuti coram me rectum, sicut servus meus Job.
kjv: And it was so, that after the Lord had spoken these words unto Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.

wlc: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־לָכֶם שִׁבְעָה־פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים וּלְכוּ אֶל־עַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב וְהַעֲלִיתֶם עוֹלָה בַּעַדְכֶם וְאִיּוֹב עַבְדִּי יִתְפַּלֵּל עֲלֵיכֶם כִּי אִם־פָּנָיו אֶשָּׂא לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת עִמָּכֶם נְבָלָה כִּי לֹא דִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלַי נְכוֹנָה כְּעַבְדִּי אִיּוֹב ׃
lxx: νῦν δὲ λάβετε ἑπτὰ μόσχους καὶ ἑπτὰ κριούς, καὶ πορεύθητε πρὸς τὸν θεράποντά μου Ἰὼβ, καὶ ποιήσει καρπώσεις περὶ ὑμῶν. Ἰὼβ δὲ ὁ θεράπων μου εὔξεται περὶ ὑμῶν. ὅτι εἰ μὴ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ λήμψομαι· εἰ μὴ γὰρ δι᾿ αὐτόν, ἀπώλεσα ἂν ὑμᾶς· οὐ γὰρ ἐλαλήσατε κατὰ τοῦ θεράποντός μου Ἰὼβ ἀληθές.
vulg: sumite igitur vobis septem tauros et septem arietes et ite ad servum meum Iob et offerte holocaustum pro vobis Iob autem servus meus orabit pro vobis faciem eius suscipiam ut non vobis inputetur stultitia neque enim locuti estis ad me recta sicut servus meus Iob
clem: Sumite ergo vobis septem tauros et septem arietes, et ite ad servum meum Job, et offerte holocaustum pro vobis: Job autem servus meus orabit pro vobis. Faciem ejus suscipiam, ut non vobis imputetur stultitia: neque enim locuti estis ad me recta, sicut servus meus Job.
kjv: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.

wlc: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֱלִיפַז הַתֵּימָנִי וּבִלְדַּד הַשּׁוּחִי צֹפַר הַנַּעֲמָתִי וַיַּעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֲלֵיהֶם יְהוָה וַיִּשָּׂא יְהוָה אֶת־פְּנֵי אִיּוֹב ׃
lxx: ἐπορεύθη δὲ Ἐλειφὰς ὁ Φαιμανείτης καὶ Βαλδὰδ ὁ Σαυχίτης καὶ Σαωφὰρ ὁ Μειναῖος, καὶ ἐποίησαν καθὼς συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ κύριος· καὶ ἔλυσεν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν αὐτοῖς διὰ Ἰώβ.
vulg: abierunt ergo Eliphaz Themanites et Baldad Suites et Sophar Naamathites et fecerunt sicut locutus fuerat ad eos Dominus et suscepit Dominus faciem Iob
clem: Abierunt ergo Eliphaz Themanites, et Baldad Suhites, et Sophar Naamathites, et fecerunt sicut locutus fuerat Dominus ad eos: et suscepit Dominus faciem Job.
kjv: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the Lord commanded them: the Lord also accepted Job.

wlc: וַיהוָה שָׁב אֶת־שְׁבִית אִיּוֹב בְּהִתְפַּלְלוֹ בְּעַד רֵעֵהוּ וַיֹּסֶף יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לְאִיּוֹב לְמִשְׁנֶה ׃
lxx: ὁ δὲ κύριος ηὔξησεν τὸν Ἰώβ· εὐξαμένου δὲ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ τῶν φίλων ἀφῆκεν αὐτοῖς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν· ἔδωκεν δὲ ὁ κύριος διπλᾶ ὅσα ἧν ἔμπροσθεν Ἰὼβ εἰς διπλασιασμόν.
vulg: Dominus quoque conversus est ad paenitentiam Iob cum oraret ille pro amicis suis et addidit Dominus omnia quaecumque fuerant Iob duplicia
clem: Dominus quoque conversus est ad pnitentiam Job, cum oraret ille pro amicis suis: et addidit Dominus omnia qucumque fuerant Job, duplicia.
kjv: And the Lord turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.

wlc: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵלָיו כָּל־אֶחָיו וְכָל־אַחְיֹתָיו וְכָל־יֹדְעָיו לְפָנִים וַיֹּאכְלוּ עִמּוֹ לֶחֶם בְּבֵיתוֹ וַיָּנֻדוּ לוֹ וַיְנַחֲמוּ אֹתוֹ עַל כָּל־הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא יְהוָה עָלָיו וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ אִישׁ קְשִׂיטָה אֶחָת וְאִישׁ נֶזֶם זָהָב אֶחָד ׃ ס
lxx: ἤκουσαν δὲ πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ ἀδελφαὶ αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ συμβεβηκότα αὐτῷ, καὶ ᾖλθον πρὸς αὐτόν. καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ᾔδεισαν αὐτὸν ἐκ πρώτου· φαγόντες δὲ καὶ πιόντες παρʼ αὐτῷ παρεκάλεσαν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐθαύμασαν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπήγαγεν αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος· ἔδωκεν δὲ αὐτῷ ἕκαστος ἀμνάδα μίαν καὶ τετράδραχμον χρυσοῦ καὶ ἀσήμου.
vulg: venerunt autem ad eum omnes fratres sui et universae sorores suae et cuncti qui noverant eum prius et comederunt cum eo panem in domo eius et moverunt super eum caput et consolati sunt eum super omni malo quod intulerat Dominus super eum et dederunt ei unusquisque ovem unam et inaurem auream unam
clem: Venerunt autem ad eum omnes fratres sui, et univers sorores su, et cuncti qui noverant eum prius, et comederunt cum eo panem in domo ejus: et moverunt super eum caput, et consolati sunt eum super omni malo quod intulerat Dominus super eum: et dederunt ei unusquisque ovem unam, et inaurem auream unam.
kjv: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

wlc: וַיהוָה בֵּרַךְ אֶת־אַחֲרִית אִיּוֹב מֵרֵאשִׁתוֹ וַיְהִי־לוֹ אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף צֹאן וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים גְּמַלִּים וְאֶלֶף־צֶמֶד בָּקָר וְאֶלֶף אֲתוֹנוֹת ׃
lxx: ὁ δὲ κύριος εὐλόγησεν τὰ ἔσχατα Ἰὼβ ἢ τὰ ἔμπροσθεν· ἦν δὲ τὰ κτήνη αὐτοῦ πρόβατα μύρια τετρακισχίλια, κάμηλοι ἐξακισχίλιαι, ζεύγε βοῶν χίλια, ὄνοι θήλειαι νομάδες χίλωι.
vulg: Dominus autem benedixit novissimis Iob magis quam principio eius et facta sunt ei quattuordecim milia ovium et sex milia camelorum et mille iuga boum et mille asinae
clem: Dominus autem benedixit novissimis Job magis quam principio ejus: et facta sunt ei quatuordecim millia ovium, et sex millia camelorum, et mille juga boum, et mille asin.
kjv: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

wlc: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שִׁבְעָנָה בָנִים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ בָּנוֹת ׃
lxx: γεννῶνται δὲ αὐτῷ υἱρὶ ἑππὰ καὶ θυγατέρες τρεῖς·
vulg: et fuerunt ei septem filii et filiae tres
clem: Et fuerunt ei septem filii, et tres fili.
kjv: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

wlc: וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם־הָאַחַת יְמִימָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית קְצִיעָה וְשֵׁם הַשְּׁלִישִׁית קֶרֶן הַפּוּךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὴν ρέν πρώτην Ἱμέραν, τὴν δὲ δευτέρου Κασίαν, τὴν δὲ τρίτην Ἀμαλθείας κέρας·
vulg: et vocavit nomen unius Diem et nomen secundae Cassia et nomen tertiae Cornu stibii
clem: Et vocavit nomen unius Diem, et nomen secund Cassiam, et nomen terti Cornustibii.
kjv: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.

wlc: וְלֹא נִמְצָא נָשִׁים יָפוֹת כִּבְנוֹת אִיּוֹב בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲבִיהֶם נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶם ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθησαν κατὰ τὰς θυγατέρας Ἰὼβ βελτίους αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ὑπʼ οὐρανόν· ἔδωκεν δὲ αὐταῖς ὁ πατὴρ κληρονομίαν ἐν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς.
vulg: non sunt autem inventae mulieres speciosae sicut filiae Iob in universa terra deditque eis pater suus hereditatem inter fratres earum
clem: Non sunt autem invent mulieres specios sicut fili Job in universa terra: deditque eis pater suus hreditatem inter fratres earum.
kjv: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

wlc: וַיְחִי אִיּוֹב אַחֲרֵי־זֹאת מֵאָה וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיַּרְא אֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־בְּנֵי בָנָיו אַרְבָּעָה דֹּרוֹת ׃
lxx: ἔζησεν δὲ Ἰὼβ μεπὰ τὴν πληγὴν ἔτη ἑκατὸν ἑβδομήκοντα, τὰ δὲ πάντα ἔτη ἔζησεν διακόσια τεσσεράκοντα· καὶ ἴδεν Ἰὼβ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ, τετάρτην γενεάυ·
vulg: vixit autem Iob post haec centum quadraginta annis et vidit filios suos et filios filiorum suorum usque ad quartam generationem et mortuus est senex et plenus dierum
clem: Vixit autem Job post hc centum quadraginta annis, et vidit filios suos, et filios filiorum suorum usque ad quartam generationem: et mortuus est senex, et plenus dierum.
kjv: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.

wlc: וַיָּמָת אִיּוֹב זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν Ἰὼβ πρεσβύτερος καὶ πλήρης ἡμερῶν.
kjv: So Job died, being old and full of days.
